rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

This course is suitable for climbers who are confident leading around f6b level. From intermediate to advanced climbers, our experienced team will plan each day so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from the airport at a time to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about people's abilities, ambitions, and the week ahead.

Day 2 - Introduction to the local style of climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

Day 4 - Discussion and practice on redpointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing with their technique.

Day 5 - Refinement of newly learnt techniques, including video analysis. Finding and working onsight and redpoint projects.

Day 6 - Focus on achieving projects. Additional personal coaching from Klemen.

Day 7 - Consolidation of the week’s work. Finishing projects and locking in new skills. Finally, a farewell dinner and a party for those with any remaining energy!

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport and we say goodbye. Until next time!

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. We invite you to listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Sport climbing performance, technique & mental coaching (Cloned)
rows.body:
Rockbusters have joined forces with one of the world's best climbers Klemen Bečan to help you climb BETTER and HARDER. This camp is specially tailored for those searching for a big push to speed up their progress towards a better climbing technique, a more efficient mindset, and a harder grade. There is no better way to do so than in a group of motivated climbers sharing the same goals and being helped out by professional coaches and guides led by one of the best climbers in the world. Our team will make sure everybody gets what they need, not only through intensive one on one coaching on the crag but also through recording and analyzing your climbing performance.

 

Sport climbing performance & mental coaching takes place in Rodellar, one of the world's best sport climbing venues and Rockbusters' top destinations. Rodellar in Spain is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. During this two-week stretch, we welcome all motivated climbers searching to progress, from beginners to experts. With two guides/coaches, we are able to adjust our approach and coaching individually to your needs and will.

 

We decided to set up Klemen's coaching camp in Rodellar so that everybody (no matter the level) can push their climbing to another level. Rodellar mekka of sport climbing in Aragon, Spain. It is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. During this two-week stretch, we welcome all motivated climbers searching to progress, from beginners to experts. With two guides/coaches, we are able to adjust our approach and coaching individually to your needs and will. 

 

Climbing course highlights:

 

Maximum quality and quantity of climbing.

  • 12 full days of intensive climbing with Klemen Becan, a professional climber, guide, and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 
Physical & technical requirements:

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. RP grade 6b/6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
rows.eventText:
There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

Our course will offer you the opportunity to maximise your potential and develop your climbing skills at a very high pace. During the trip we will help you push your grade while teaching you how to maintain sustainable, long-term progress beyond our time together.

Klemen Becan’s coaching focuses on balance and movement, which will help both your physical and mental development as a climber. Whether you are a complete rookie or an experienced cranker, analyzing your movement patterns and attitude will instantaneously boost your skills and help you break through any plateau.

Whatever your level, with plenty of time to practice newly learned techniques, you will increase your confidence and perform better than ever. After just one week of coaching you to head home with a completely new, advanced skillset. The aim of our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop is to allow you to learn from the best and use their well tested techniques to progress your climbing.

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join our Klemen Becan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop:

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn to find balance and use the most efficient and effective ways to propel your body up the rock without wasting energy. You will learn how to work with friction, make delicate steps and calculated, technical moves.

Overhangs

You’ll develop and practise skills to help you handle climbing steeper rock faces. We will cover footwork and techniques such as drop knees, heel and toe hooks. A lot of time will be dedicated to the fine art of resting while climbing, as well as fighting “the pump”, both mentally and physically.

Onsight vs redpoint techniques

Climbing onsight and projecting more difficult lines differs both physically and mentally. Klemen Bečan will cover the most effective strategies for success while onsighting or working a route over many days. You will have plenty of time to practice these and internalise the new skills.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

Maximum 4 clients per instructor!

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

This course is suitable for climbers who are confident leading around f6b level. From intermediate to advanced climbers, our experienced team will plan each day so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from the airport at a time to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about people's abilities, ambitions, and the week ahead.

Day 2 - Introduction to the local style of climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

Day 4 - Discussion and practice on redpointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing with their technique.

Day 5 - Refinement of newly learnt techniques, including video analysis. Finding and working onsight and redpoint projects.

Day 6 - Focus on achieving projects. Additional personal coaching from Klemen.

Day 7 - Consolidation of the week’s work. Finishing projects and locking in new skills. Finally, a farewell dinner and a party for those with any remaining energy!

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport and we say goodbye. Until next time!

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. We invite you to listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Advanced Sport Climbing - Patxi Usobiaga Climbing Experience (Cloned)
rows.body:
Patxi Usobiaga, the renowned Spanish pro climber, achieved great success in his climbing career. In 2009, he emerged victorious in the World Championship held in Qinghai. Furthermore, he holds the distinction of being one of the few individuals to win two consecutive overall Lead Climbing World Cup competitions. Patxi's path to triumph has always been characterized by a sophisticated and exceptionally rigorous training regimen.

 

Notably, Patxi made history as the first climber ever to on-sight an 8c+ route. He has also successfully redpointed numerous routes with grades ranging from 9a to 9a+. Given his exceptional skills and experience, there are few coaches who can match his expertise in leading our Advanced Sport Climbing Course.

 

By enrolling in this sport climbing course led by Patxi, participants will gain access to a comprehensive set of techniques and strategies to conquer challenging routes at their maximum potential. In addition, they will develop essential mental skills to effectively manage pressure, fears, and stress. At Rockbusters, we adhere to the "LEARN by DOING" philosophy, which means that our climbing trips and courses provide hands-on coaching while scaling top-notch routes at renowned crags. Our primary goal is to maximize your climbing experience through ample practice time on the rock. With our expert guidance in both climbing technique coaching and mental coaching, you can expect significant improvements in your abilities.

 

Sport climbing course highlights
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi Usobiaga, a professional guide, and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. On-Sight 7a (5.11d), or Red-Point 7b (5.12b) grade
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
rows.eventText:
For those who do not know, Patxi Usobiaga is Spanish pro climber who has as a first ever won two overall Lead Climbing World Cups in row. In 2009 he won the  Lead Climbing World Championships in Qinghai and is very well known as a master of unbelievably hard training methods. Patxi was the first climber ever to on-sight 8c+ and red-pointed various 9a and 9a+. Do you know anybody better to coach this Advance Sport Climbing Course?

 

To the pack of all the tricks and mental skills how to approach, project and climb hard routes above your limits, how to handle mental pressure, fears and stress, Patxi will also measure your pure strength, point out your strong point and weaknesses and suggest a plan for training with possibility to lead you through your progress in long term.

 

Of course as on any Rockbusters climbing trips and courses we bring our philosophy to "LEARN by DOING" so  you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters we think only practice makes you better so the goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

 
Sport climbing course highlights
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed, min. RP grade 6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
 
 
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course
 
All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Analysis of your strength and weaknesses + basic training plan proposal
  • Choosing the right hard project and strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, knee bars, ...)
  • Red point and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course
 

All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes at your limits (or beyond your imaginary limits) such as:

 

  • Analysis of your strengths and weaknesses
  • Choosing the right hard project and a strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebar, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers
  • Choosing the right equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, plus advice on how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks
  • Proper lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically

 

Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components: mental power, physical power, and technique skills. We will be discussing how big a part each component has in your climbing performance. For a performance climber, the goal is to approach mastery in all these areas in order to reach their potential. And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

There is no one better qualified than Patxi Usobiaga to lead this course. Patxi, an ex-world champ, and a “training monster” say that his “talent is to be able to suffer”. He is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods to name just a few.

Pair up with Patxi for a week of climbing and training sessions, send some cool on-sights, flashes, or red points in his home destination of Oliana, and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance. Simply climb BETTER, HARDER and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Physical power (maximum power, resistance power, stamina, explosiveness, weaknesses vs strengths, …)

Technical skills (footwork, balance, proper use of techniques such as sidestep, drop knee, flagging, resting, breathing, how to grip properly - crimp, open hand, pinch, …)

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

Elevate Your Climbing: The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience

 

Are you stuck at a plateau in your climbing journey? Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience with Patxi Usobiaga might be exactly what you need to break through to the next level.

Training with Patxi Usobiaga — a World Champion and the first climber to onsight 8c+ — offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from one of the sport's greatest talents. What makes this experience exceptional isn't just Patxi's impressive resume, but his methodical approach to climbing improvement.

The program begins with a comprehensive assessment at Patxi's climbing gym in Coll de Nargo, where he analyzes your strengths and weaknesses. This personalized approach ensures that every participant receives tailored guidance, whether you need to improve power, endurance, technique, or mental focus.

Unlike basic climbing courses, this advanced experience is designed for climbers comfortable with at least 6c routes who are looking to push beyond their current limits. Participants receive individualized attention as Patxi carefully selects routes that challenge your specific weaknesses while building on their strengths.

Perhaps most valuable is the mental training aspect. As one participant noted, "Improving your mental game is low-hanging fruit" when physical gains become harder to achieve. This course helps you realize "that the impossible is possible, but only if you push yourself to your limits, and beyond."

The benefits extend beyond the week-long experience itself. Participants receive a free one-month training plan designed by Patxi, with options for long-term follow-up coaching. This continued support helps ensure that the progress made during the course translates into lasting improvement.

Beyond the technical benefits, participants consistently highlight the community aspect—spending a week climbing world-class routes with fellow enthusiasts from around the globe creates lasting connections and a supportive network of climbers with similar goals.

And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer, or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

  • Nail down the proper footwork, balance, and efficient movement

  • Climb the best routes in your grade in the area

rows.eventText:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks and to a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and coahing.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Local transport (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for total NOVICES, transitioning from GYM to ROCK. For total beginner to people looking for first rock experience, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

rows.eventText:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks and to a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climb such as:
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely everyday)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Climbing outdoors is a whole new experience. Learn all the skills and logistics you need to get out on your own and climb confidently on single-pitch sport climbs. You are granted to improve your technique, learn to use all the equipment properly, lead-climb, and lead-belay safely. This course is the perfect choice for total beginners as well as for those making the transition from indoor to outdoor climbing.

 

This Beginner Climbing Course is a great way to catch the climbing bug. Whether you’re a complete rookie or just looking to make the step from indoor to outdoor climbing, this course will tick all your boxes. Tackle the basics head-on, master technique, and learn to climb safely. Get your head around all the gear and equipment you’ll need to stay safe and crank your way up the face.

 

At the end of the beginner climbing course, our aim is to have transformed you into a competent independent climber tackling routes you would not have believed yourself capable of. You’ll be moving like a mountain leading. Plus you’ll know all the relevant communication and climbing terminology.

 

This course is a great way into climbing culture. It’s intense for sure, but this means you’ll develop your skills quickly and progress way faster than you thought possible. Join the Rockbusters beginner climbing course and you’ll quickly reach new heights and be ready to take on epic routes you could only dream of.

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climb such as:
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely everyday)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Climbing outdoors is a whole new experience. Learn all the skills and logistics you need to get out on your own and climb confidently on single-pitch sport climbs. You are granted to improve your technique, learn to use all the equipment properly, lead-climb, and lead-belay safely. This course is the perfect choice for total beginners as well as for those making the transition from indoor to outdoor climbing.

 

This Beginner Climbing Course is a great way to catch the climbing bug. Whether you’re a complete rookie or just looking to make the step from indoor to outdoor climbing, this course will tick all your boxes. Tackle the basics head-on, master technique, and learn to climb safely. Get your head around all the gear and equipment you’ll need to stay safe and crank your way up the face.

 

At the end of the beginner climbing course, our aim is to have transformed you into a competent independent climber tackling routes you would not have believed yourself capable of. You’ll be moving like a mountain leading. Plus you’ll know all the relevant communication and climbing terminology.

 

This course is a great way into climbing culture. It’s intense for sure, but this means you’ll develop your skills quickly and progress way faster than you thought possible. Join the Rockbusters beginner climbing course and you’ll quickly reach new heights and be ready to take on epic routes you could only dream of.

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and coahing.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Local transport (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for total NOVICES, transitioning from GYM to ROCK. For total beginner to people looking for first rock experience, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and leading belay technique.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 4 - First lead climbs on easy terrain. Cleaning anchors safely.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Rapeling techniques. 

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

rows.title: Sport Climbing Course in Dolomites (Cloned)
rows.body:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

For the Rockbusters team climbing is not just a sport, it’s what we eat, drink, breathe and sleep - it’s what we live for. Our Sport Climbing Camp gives you the opportunity to get a taste of what we mean and become part of our climbing crew.

The main focus of our Sport Climbing Camp is on quality climbing, so it’s aimed at climbers with some experience but we are not pushing fit and motivated beginners away. We will provide all necessary coaching and go through all safety and technical details so everyone is able to do as much climbing as possible and enjoy climbing with each other. We will push you to achieve more during your stay, arming you with all the necessary techniques and safety measures before you try anything new.

During the week we will turn you into a confident leader of any sport climbing routes and make you a better climber overall no matter your current grade or level. Our professional guides and coaches will show you all the sport climbing tricks you may use to stay safe and to be happy trying routes beyond your comfort zone.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programs. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.title: BIG WALL CLIMBING Chamonix (Cloned)
rows.body:
Looking to put your climbing skills to the test? Then it’s time to step up to the big wall. Alpine climbing is all about using the skills you’ve developed on more accessible walls, and applying them to the face in a high mountain environment. Challenge yourself and your climbing skills in the World Class venue for mountaineering, alpine climbing, big wall rock climbing, and long multi-pitch routes. Rockbusters and Pablo Ruiz Seco, UIAGM mountain guide are inviting you to this epic journey on Alpine granite in mekka of extreme sports CHAMONIX.

 

The Rockbusters Alpine Rock Climbing week in Chamonix is six days of big wall climbing in an awe-inspiring location. And while it’s suitable for a range of levels, it’s not for beginners. You’ll use many aspects of trad and multi-pitch climbing, but also develop a range of new skills.

 

We recommend that you’re in top condition and able to climb at least 6b level. With that as your base, all you’ll need is enthusiasm and the nerve to push yourself. Try your best and this will be some of the most rewarding climbing you’ve experienced.

 

Climbing course highlights:

Maximum quality and quantity of climbing.

  • 5 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 2:1 client/coach ratio
  • One-on-one coaching

 
Physical & technical requirements:

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. RP grade 6b/6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or couples of friends
  • Physical intensity: high

 
Detailed technical specification of the climbing course:

  • Building safe belays/stands on multi-pitch routes
  • Rope management and handling
  • Abseils and retreats for returning to the ground
  • Communication techniques when climbing a multi-pitch route
  • Hanging belays
  • Self-rescue skills - worth knowing if you want to make it home safely
  • Trip planning: how to use a guidebook effectively
  • Risk assessment and management
  • Equipment education
  • Climbing techniques – efficient movement
  • Fear management – fear of falling, fear of failure
  • Mental preparation, concentration
  • Choosing the right strategy before and when on the wall
  • Evening analysis of the day, tips, consultations
  • Basic mountaineering and alpine climibng skills
  • Individual coaching and guiding

Approximate itinerary for the week. The final program will be adjusted according to your level, experience, weather, and your agreement with the guide:

 

Day 1: Single pitch sport/trad climbing

The team will cover some essential skills and assess your level for the week to come. Don’t feel pressured or try too hard, it’s important to get an accurate idea of your level. Day 1 is also your chance to hire any extra gear you need.

 

Day 2: Skills day

You’ll learn some glacial techniques and how to use your Alpine gear correctly. Accessing some of the routes this week involves walking on glaciers and negotiating crevasses, so it’s important this is done safely. Suitable locations for this alpine skills day include Mer de Glacé, Col du Midi, and the Italian side of Vallee Blanche.

 

Day 3: Big high rock route

Today you’ll try to climb your first big rock routes, taking on numerous faces at sites like Brevent, Aiguille Rouge cliffs, or less Perrons de Vallorcine. Usually, this happens at around the 2500+ meter mark to help your acclimatization.

 

Day 4: Big rock route in high mountain

Building on your growing skills and confidence, it’s another big multi-pitch climb. If you’re ready, it’ll be without bolts and include a glacial approach. The South Face of the Aiguille du Midi, pt. Lachenal, or the Chamonix Aiguilles are possible locations.

 

Days 5 and 6: High mountain refuge

Staying in a refuge enables two quality days of climbing above the snowline, meaning you pack a lot into 48 hours. A potential itinerary would be to base from the Cabane d'Orny and climb on the Aiguille d'Orny or Aiguille Dorèes. Alternatively, we may overnight at the Torino hut on the Italian side of Mont Blanc to climb the amazing granite spires.

rows.eventText:
Looking to put your climbing skills to the test? Then it’s time to step up to the big wall. Alpine climbing is all about using the skills you’ve developed on more accessible walls, and applying them to the face in a high mountain environment.

The Rockbusters Alpine Rock Climbing week in Chamonix is six days of big wall climbing in an awe-inspiring location. And while it’s suitable for a range of levels, it’s not for beginners. You’ll use many aspects of trad and multi-pitch climbing, but also develop a range of new skills.

We recommend that you’re in top condition and able to climb at least to 6b level. With that as your base, all you’ll need is enthusiasm and the nerve to push yourself. Try your best and this will be some of the most rewarding climbing you’ve experienced.
rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specifications of the climbing course:

  • Building safe belays/stands on multi-pitch routes
  • Rope management and handling
  • Abseils and retreats for returning to the ground
  • Communication techniques when climbing a multi-pitch route
  • Hanging belays
  • Self-rescue skills - worth knowing if you want to make it home safely
  • Trip planning: how to use a guidebook effectively
  • Risk assessment and management
  • Equipment education
  • Climbing techniques – efficient movement
  • Fear management – fear of falling, fear of failure
  • Mental preparation, concentration
  • Choosing the right strategy before and when on the wall
  • Evening analysis of the day, tips, consultations
  • Basic mountaineering and alpine climbing skills
  • Individual coaching and guiding

 

Approximate itinerary for the week. The final program will be adjusted according to your level, experience, weather, and your agreement with the guide:

 

Day 1: Single pitch sport/trad climbing

The team will cover some essential skills and assess your level for the week to come. Don’t feel pressured or try too hard, it’s important to get an accurate idea of your level. Day 1 is also your chance to hire any extra gear you need.

 

Day 2: Skills day

You’ll learn some glacial techniques and how to use your Alpine gear correctly. Accessing some of the routes this week involves walking on glaciers and negotiating crevasses, so it’s important this is done safely. Suitable locations for this alpine skills day include Mer de Glacé, Col du Midi, and the Italian side of Vallee Blanche.

 

Day 3: Big high rock route

Today you’ll try to climb your first big rock routes, taking on numerous faces at sites like Brevent, Aiguille Rouge cliffs, or less Perrons de Vallorcine. Usually, this happens at around the 2500+ meter mark to help your acclimatization.

 

Day 4: Big rock route in high mountain

Building on your growing skills and confidence, it’s another big multi-pitch climb. If you’re ready, it’ll be without bolts and include a glacial approach. The South Face of the Aiguille du Midi, pt. Lachenal, or the Chamonix Aiguilles are possible locations.

 

Days 5 and 6: High mountain refuge

Staying in a refuge enables two quality days of climbing above the snowline, meaning you pack a lot into 48 hours. A potential itinerary would be to base from the Cabane d'Orny and climb on the Aiguille d'Orny or Aiguille Dorèes. Alternatively, we may overnight at the Torino hut on the Italian side of Mont Blanc to climb the amazing granite spires.

rows.title: Sport Climbing Holidays in Dolomites (Cloned)
rows.body:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

For the Rockbusters team climbing is not just a sport, it’s what we eat, drink, breathe and sleep - it’s what we live for. Our Sport Climbing Camp gives you the opportunity to get a taste of what we mean and become part of our climbing crew.

The main focus of our Sport Climbing Camp is on quality climbing, so it’s aimed at climbers with some experience but we are not pushing fit and motivated beginners away. We will provide all necessary coaching and go through all safety and technical details so everyone is able to do as much climbing as possible and enjoy climbing with each other. We will push you to achieve more during your stay, arming you with all the necessary techniques and safety measures before you try anything new.

During the week we will turn you into a confident leader of any sport climbing routes and make you a better climber overall no matter your current grade or level. Our professional guides and coaches will show you all the sport climbing tricks you may use to stay safe and to be happy trying routes beyond your comfort zone.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programs. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

For the Rockbusters team climbing is not just a sport, it’s what we eat, drink, breathe and sleep - it’s what we live for. Our Sport Climbing Camp gives you the opportunity to get a taste of what we mean and become part of our climbing crew.

The main focus of our Sport Climbing Camp is on quality climbing, so it’s aimed at climbers with some experience but we are not pushing fit and motivated beginners away. We will provide all necessary coaching and go through all safety and technical details so everyone is able to do as much climbing as possible and enjoy climbing with each other. We will push you to achieve more during your stay, arming you with all the necessary techniques and safety measures before you try anything new.

During the week we will turn you into a confident leader of any sport climbing routes and make you a better climber overall no matter your current grade or level. Our professional guides and coaches will show you all the sport climbing tricks you may use to stay safe and to be happy trying routes beyond your comfort zone.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programs. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Yo, rock junkies! Ready to get your climb on? Join our badass sport climbing course and push your limits on Europe's TOP crags. We're talking finger-shredding action, top-notch coaching, and a chance to level up your skills like never before.

 

Our motto? CLIMB or DIE. Okay, not literally, but you get the idea. We're all about MAXING OUT YOUR ROCK TIME. No boring lectures here - just pure, unadulterated climbing. You'll be scaling walls like a pro before you know it.

 

This ain't your grandma's climbing course. It's perfect for anyone looking to refresh their safety game, nail that leading technique, and become a total rock star. Trust us, you'll be itching to book your spot.

 

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to eat, sleep, and breathe climbing. Your fingers won't know what hit 'em!

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

Our motto? CLIMB or DIE. Okay, not literally, but you get the idea. We're all about MAXING OUT YOUR ROCK TIME. No boring lectures here - just pure, unadulterated climbing. You'll be scaling walls like a pro before you know it.

 

This ain't your grandma's climbing course. It's perfect for anyone looking to refresh their safety game, nail that leading technique, and become a total rock star. Trust us, you'll be itching to book your spot.

 

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to eat, sleep, and breathe climbing. Your fingers won't know what hit 'em!

  • Video analysis

  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

rows.title: SPORT CLIMBING ROCK TRIP in SPAIN (Cloned) (Cloned) (Cloned) (Cloned)
rows.body:
The Rockbusters Spanish road trip is always one of our most popular events each year. It’s a tour that gives you a unique chance to discover the best Spanish crags. These are notoriously some of the best in the world so do yourself a favor and don't miss out. Trust us on this one. It’s an intense and epic tour that every climbing freak should experience.

 

Apart from getting a great introduction to great climbing areas all around Spain, you’ll also benefit from some world-class guidance. Our top performance coaches will help you develop your skills and you’ll have a blast with a great climbing company. We guarantee you a varied month full of fun and loads of new climbing experiences. Try out a massive range of different styles too, from vertical fingery lines in Sella and Siurana to overhanging pumpy routes in Margalef – plus plenty more.

 

Join the tour for as many weeks as you want. At the weekends we stop at nearby airports to drop off and pick up clients who can't make it for the whole trip. Although we’d love it if you could come from beginning to end and think you will too.

 

Europe Rock Trip highlights

 

  • The best crags and the best routes in Europe
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
