rows.title: Christmas Sport Climbing Course (2 weeks) (Cloned)
rows.body:
Yo, rock junkies! Ready to get your climb on? Join our badass sport climbing course and push your limits on Europe's TOP crags. We're talking finger-shredding action, top-notch coaching, and a chance to level up your skills like never before.

 

Our motto? CLIMB OR DIE. Okay, not literally, but you get the idea. We're all about MAXING OUT YOUR ROCK TIME. No boring lectures here - just pure, unadulterated climbing. You'll be scaling walls like a pro before you know it.

 

This ain't your grandma's climbing course. It's perfect for anyone looking to refresh their safety game, nail that leading technique, and become a total rock star. Trust us, you'll be itching to book your spot.

 

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to eat, sleep, and breathe climbing. Your fingers won't know what hit 'em!

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
Get festive on our Christmas Climbing Holiday based in Sella. Here you will climb some of Europe’s best crags and routes with no crackers or turkeys in sight. Our Christmas climbing camp is a great opportunity to take advantage of the empty crags during December. Treat yourself to some of the best rock and sport climbing Europe has to offer.

Christmas is that festive time of year; unwanted presents, annoying family members, board games and over-indulgence. Fortunately at Rockbusters we can't offer you anything like that. Instead, We can offer intensive climbing in Europe's best crags.

Sella, the location of the Rockbusters Christmas Climbing Holiday is a special place for rock climbers. It is a unique climbing area in the Costa Blanca region with hundreds of sport routes and slabs to explore. In the summer the climbing can be slightly crowded. However, during December and the Christmas period the crags are empty and peaceful. You will be spoilt for choice when it comes to choosing the route to climb.

Climb as much as you want and we’ll provide you with our expert one-on-one coaching, video and photo analysis. The focus is on developing and improving technique and will provide a great opportunity to give you a good headstart for the new climbing year.

If you already have some climbing experience (or none at all but are bursting with enthusiasm!) and are looking to take it to the next level then this is the perfect time to do it.

Our Christmas camp focuses on:

Coaching with slab/vertical ground to improve footwork and climbing efficiency

Balance and foot placement to develop better technique for more confident climbing (leading comfortably F5 or more)

Intensive coaching on overhangs and steep sections to develop strength and confidence (leading comfortably F6c or more)

On-sight/red point aimed at climbers who are confident enough with their balance, footwork and have already acquired the basics of climbing technique

Beginners will be taught the basics and fast tracked by our coaches.

Guiding you to some of the best crags and climbing Sella has to offer.

On the Christmas Climbing Camp we focus on having fun and racking up as much face time at Sella's climbing crags. Whatever your level we will set challenging routes to improve and develop skills for climbing.

This is a Rockbusters course so you it’s all about the climbing. We live and breathe the sport but we also know how to have a good time. However as this is Christmas it’s an extra special reason to party. Rockbusters is more like a family than a tour company so you’ll feel right at home at this special time of year.

We promise not to give you any unwanted presents!
rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specifications of this climbing course

 

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers


Eat, sleep, and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit, with top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our "LEARN by DOING" approach you get coached while actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

The main focus of our Sport Climbing Camp is quality climbing, so it’s aimed at climbers with some experience but we are not pushing fit and motivated beginners away. We will provide all necessary coaching and go through all safety and technical details so everyone is able to do as much climbing as possible and enjoy climbing with each other. We will push you to achieve more during your stay, arming you with all the necessary techniques and safety measures before you try anything new.


During the week we will turn you into a confident leader of any sport climbing routes and make you a better climber overall no matter your current grade or level. Our professional guides and coaches will show you all the sport climbing tricks you may use to stay safe and to be happy trying routes beyond your comfort zone.
rows.perex:
• Improve your climbing performance, technique & mental game
  • Climb the best routes in your grade in the area
  • Enjoy a great climbing community and vibe
  • Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage, common dining area with gas stove, fire place, common sleeping area, outside hot shower and dry toilet(FREE of CHARGE).

              

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from Alicante airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing on the awesome limestone in Sella. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it

rows.eventText:
Get festive on our Christmas Climbing Holiday based in Sella. Here you will climb some of Europe’s best crags and routes with no crackers or turkeys in sight. Our Christmas climbing camp is a great opportunity to take advantage of the empty crags during December. Treat yourself to some of the best rock and sport climbing Europe has to offer.

Christmas is that festive time of year; unwanted presents, annoying family members, board games and over-indulgence. Fortunately at Rockbusters we can't offer you anything like that. Instead, We can offer intensive climbing in Europe's best crags.

Sella, the location of the Rockbusters Christmas Climbing Holiday is a special place for rock climbers. It is a unique climbing area in the Costa Blanca region with hundreds of sport routes and slabs to explore. In the summer the climbing can be slightly crowded. However, during December and the Christmas period the crags are empty and peaceful. You will be spoilt for choice when it comes to choosing the route to climb.

Climb as much as you want and we’ll provide you with our expert one-on-one coaching, video and photo analysis. The focus is on developing and improving technique and will provide a great opportunity to give you a good headstart for the new climbing year.

If you already have some climbing experience (or none at all but are bursting with enthusiasm!) and are looking to take it to the next level then this is the perfect time to do it.

Our Christmas camp focuses on:

Coaching with slab/vertical ground to improve footwork and climbing efficiency

Balance and foot placement to develop better technique for more confident climbing (leading comfortably F5 or more)

Intensive coaching on overhangs and steep sections to develop strength and confidence (leading comfortably F6c or more)

On-sight/red point aimed at climbers who are confident enough with their balance, footwork and have already acquired the basics of climbing technique

Beginners will be taught the basics and fast tracked by our coaches.

Guiding you to some of the best crags and climbing Sella has to offer.

On the Christmas Climbing Camp we focus on having fun and racking up as much face time at Sella's climbing crags. Whatever your level we will set challenging routes to improve and develop skills for climbing.

This is a Rockbusters course so you it’s all about the climbing. We live and breathe the sport but we also know how to have a good time. However as this is Christmas it’s an extra special reason to party. Rockbusters is more like a family than a tour company so you’ll feel right at home at this special time of year.

We promise not to give you any unwanted presents!

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage, common dining area with gas stove, fire place, common sleeping area, outside hot shower and dry toilet(FREE of CHARGE).

              

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from Alicante airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing on the awesome limestone in Sella. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it

rows.body:
Patxi Usobiaga, the renowned Spanish pro climber, achieved great success in his climbing career. In 2009, he emerged victorious in the World Championship held in Qinghai. Furthermore, he holds the distinction of being one of the few individuals to win two consecutive overall Lead Climbing World Cup competitions. Patxi's path to triumph has always been characterized by a sophisticated and exceptionally rigorous training regimen.

 

Notably, Patxi made history as the first climber ever to on-sight an 8c+ route. He has also successfully redpointed numerous routes with grades ranging from 9a to 9a+. Given his exceptional skills and experience, there are few coaches who can match his expertise in leading our Advanced Sport Climbing Course.

 

By enrolling in this sport climbing course led by Patxi, participants will gain access to a comprehensive set of techniques and strategies to conquer challenging routes at their maximum potential. In addition, they will develop essential mental skills to effectively manage pressure, fears, and stress. At Rockbusters, we adhere to the "LEARN by DOING" philosophy, which means that our climbing trips and courses provide hands-on coaching while scaling top-notch routes at renowned crags. Our primary goal is to maximize your climbing experience through ample practice time on the rock. With our expert guidance in both climbing technique coaching and mental coaching, you can expect significant improvements in your abilities.

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi Usobiaga, a professional guide, and coach

rows.bodyMore:
Elevate Your Climbing: The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience

 

Are you stuck at a plateau in your climbing journey? Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience with Patxi Usobiaga might be exactly what you need to break through to the next level.

Training with Patxi Usobiaga — a World Champion and the first climber to onsight 8c+ — offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from one of the sport's greatest talents. What makes this experience exceptional isn't just Patxi's impressive resume, but his methodical approach to climbing improvement.

The program begins with a comprehensive assessment at Patxi's climbing gym in Coll de Nargo, where he analyzes your strengths and weaknesses. This personalized approach ensures that every participant receives tailored guidance, whether you need to improve power, endurance, technique, or mental focus.

Unlike basic climbing courses, this advanced experience is designed for climbers comfortable with at least 6c routes who are looking to push beyond their current limits. Participants receive individualized attention as Patxi carefully selects routes that challenge your specific weaknesses while building on their strengths.

Perhaps most valuable is the mental training aspect. As one participant noted, "Improving your mental game is low-hanging fruit" when physical gains become harder to achieve. This course helps you realize "that the impossible is possible, but only if you push yourself to your limits, and beyond."

The benefits extend beyond the week-long experience itself. Participants receive a free one-month training plan designed by Patxi, with options for long-term follow-up coaching. This continued support helps ensure that the progress made during the course translates into lasting improvement.

Beyond the technical benefits, participants consistently highlight the community aspect—spending a week climbing world-class routes with fellow enthusiasts from around the globe creates lasting connections and a supportive network of climbers with similar goals.

 

Patxi sport climbing & bouldering performance analysis


Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components: mental power, physical power, and technical skills. We will be discussing how big a part each component has in your climbing performance. For a performance climber, the goal is to approach mastery in all these areas to reach their potential. And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer, or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

There is no one better qualified than Patxi Usobiaga to lead this course. Patxi, an ex-world champ and a “training monster”, says that his “talent is to be able to suffer”. He is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods, to name just a few.

Pair up with Patxi for a week of climbing and training sessions, send some cool on-sights, flashes, or red points in his home destination of Oliana, and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance. Simply climb BETTER, HARDER, and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Physical power (maximum power, resistance power, stamina, explosiveness, weaknesses vs strengths, …)

Technical skills (footwork, balance, proper use of techniques as sidestep, drop knee, flagging, resting, breathing, how to grip properly - crimp, open hand, pinch, …)

rows.title: Sport climbing performance, technique & mental coaching (2 weeks) (Cloned)
rows.body:
Rockbusters have joined forces with one of the world's best climbers Klemen Bečan to help you climb BETTER and HARDER. This camp is specially tailored for those searching for a big push to speed up their progress towards a better climbing technique, a more efficient mindset, and a harder grade. There is no better way to do so than in a group of motivated climbers sharing the same goals and being helped out by professional coaches and guides led by one of the best climbers in the world. Our team will make sure everybody gets what they need, not only through intensive one on one coaching on the crag but also through recording and analyzing your climbing performance.

 

Sport climbing performance & mental coaching takes place in Rodellar, one of the world's best sport climbing venues and Rockbusters' top destinations. Rodellar in Spain is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

Our course will offer you the opportunity to maximise your potential and develop your climbing skills at a very high pace. During the trip we will help you push your grade while teaching you how to maintain sustainable, long-term progress beyond our time together.

Klemen Becan’s coaching focuses on balance and movement, which will help both your physical and mental development as a climber. Whether you are a complete rookie or an experienced cranker, analyzing your movement patterns and attitude will instantaneously boost your skills and help you break through any plateau.

Whatever your level, with plenty of time to practice newly learned techniques, you will increase your confidence and perform better than ever. After just one week of coaching you to head home with a completely new, advanced skillset. The aim of our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop is to allow you to learn from the best and use their well tested techniques to progress your climbing.

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join our Klemen Becan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop:

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn to find balance and use the most efficient and effective ways to propel your body up the rock without wasting energy. You will learn how to work with friction, make delicate steps and calculated, technical moves.

Overhangs

You’ll develop and practise skills to help you handle climbing steeper rock faces. We will cover footwork and techniques such as drop knees, heel and toe hooks. A lot of time will be dedicated to the fine art of resting while climbing, as well as fighting “the pump”, both mentally and physically.

Onsight vs redpoint techniques

Climbing onsight and projecting more difficult lines differs both physically and mentally. Klemen Bečan will cover the most effective strategies for success while onsighting or working a route over many days. You will have plenty of time to practice these and internalise the new skills.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

Maximum 4 clients per instructor!

WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

rows.title: Multi-pitch Climbing Course
rows.bodyMore:
Elevate Your Climbing: The Benefits of Rockbusters' Multipitch Climbing Course

Are you ready to take your climbing skills to new heights? Rockbusters' Multipitch Climbing Course offers the perfect opportunity to safely advance your climbing journey while enjoying spectacular routes under expert guidance.

 

Learn from Elite Climbers

Rockbusters provides coaching from professional climbers who bring their wealth of experience directly to you. This observational learning accelerates your development far beyond what's possible on your own. Their coaches understand not just the technical aspects of climbing, but also the psychological factors that contribute to success on the wall.

 

Comprehensive Skill Development

The course delivers thorough instruction on critical multipitch techniques, including anchor systems, belaying from above, route management, and efficient transitions between pitches. Unlike learning casually from friends, a structured course ensures no essential safety procedures are overlooked.


Mental Preparation and Confidence Building

Multipitch climbing requires significant mental fortitude. Rockbusters' training incorporates valuable mental preparation techniques, including visualization and stress management, helping you approach challenging routes with confidence. This psychological training is just as important as the physical skills when you're hundreds of feet off the ground.

 

Safety-Focused Approach

When it comes to multipitch climbing, proper training dramatically reduces risk. The comprehensive instruction from Rockbusters emphasizes safety protocols and emergency procedures that casual learning might miss, giving you peace of mind on exposed routes.

 

Community Experience

Join a supportive group of like-minded climbers who share your passion. The collaborative learning environment enhances your experience while building connections that often lead to future climbing partnerships and adventures.

ADVENTURE AWAITS: CONQUER THE LEGENDARY CZECH SANDSTONE!

 

Ever scaled British gritstone? Then prepare for Czech sandstone's thrilling cousin—only wilder and more spectacular! Never heard of either? You're about to discover why the majestic Elbe Mountains house some of the world's most coveted climbing terrain that elite climbers travel continents to experience!

 

This isn't just another climbing trip—it's your exclusive passport to Czech climbing paradise with guides who aren't just experts, they're local legends who've personally pioneered routes through this sandstone wonderland. Perfect for experienced climbers craving fresh challenges beyond the ordinary, yet welcoming to anyone confident in their belaying skills and basic technique.

 

Imagine yourself conquering ancient towers that have defied time itself, guided by passionate locals who know every hidden gem in this rock climber's paradise. The breathtaking Elbe River has carved an awe-inspiring gorge through the sandstone, creating a playground of cracks, crevices, and formations that will make your climbing soul sing with excitement!

 

Straddling the mystical borderlands between German Saxony and Czech Bohemia, these protected formations rise dramatically from lush forests in a national park so stunning it belongs on magazine covers. The vertical challenges here aren't just climbs—they're the stuff of climbing legend that will forever transform how you view the sport.

  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio

  • Technical climbing skills like how to belay, set up a top-rope, and lead climb (depending on your level)
  • Climbing calls and communication so that you can get your message across to your climbing buddies
  • Movement skills to help you climb more efficiently
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day
  • Cleaning the anchors so you can retrieve all your gear
  • Lead climbing technique
  • Work on balance so that you climb in a more efficient way
  • Time on slab and vertical ground to improve footwork for better climbing
  • Overhang work to build strength and confidence so you can take on tougher climbing challenges

rows.eventText:
If you’re familiar with British gritstone then Czech sandstone will be surprisingly similar. If you’ve got no idea what we’re talking about then all you need to know is that the Czech sandstone of the Elbe Mountains is one of the best rock types for climbing.

 

This is your chance to experience some of the most unique and exciting Czech climbing, accompanied by some of the finest guides you could ever wish to meet (even if we do say so ourselves). It’s perfect for climbers who’ve got a fair bit of experience under their belt looking for new challanges and bit more exotic climbing styles, but open to anyone who can belay safely and tie on without assistance.
rows.bodyMore:
The Unique Appeal of Rockbusters' Czech Sandstone Climbing Experience

Nestled in the stunning Elbe Mountains lies one of climbing's best-kept secrets – the extraordinary Czech sandstone formations. Joining Rockbusters' Czech Sandstone Climbing Experience offers climbers a truly distinctive adventure in this climbing paradise.

 

Expert Guidance in a Unique Setting

When you join Rockbusters, you'll be guided by local climbing experts and route developers who possess intimate knowledge of the Elbe sandstone region. These ancient rock formations, straddling the border between German Saxony and Czech Bohemia, create a national park filled with stunning cracks and crevices that serious climbers find irresistible.

 

Technical Growth and Skill Development

The program provides six full days of intensive climbing with professional guides and coaches who offer personalized instruction. With a maximum 7:1 client-coach ratio, you'll receive individualized attention to improve your climbing technique and mental game. The sandstone's unique properties demand extremely technical climbing styles – even the most challenging overhangs require delicate movement and finesse, making this experience invaluable for developing technical skills applicable to all climbing environments.

 

Immersion in Climbing Culture

Beyond the physical challenges, the Czech Sandstone Experience introduces you to a vibrant climbing community with its traditions and ethics. Local Czech climbers are technically accomplished, unafraid of challenging routes, and protective of their fragile sandstone environment while welcoming visitors who respect it. After conquering towers, you might find yourself celebrating at a local pub with some of the world's best (and most affordable) beer.

 

Breathtaking Scenery and Unique Terrain

Despite being just an hour from Prague, climbing in the Bohemian Paradise (Český ráj) offers a remote, wild atmosphere. The landscape features lush valleys, ancient castles, and those distinctive sandstone towers rising majestically from forests. With over 3,000 rock formations offering approximately 18,000 routes within a 40km range, the climbing possibilities are virtually endless.

Join Rockbusters for an experience that goes beyond mere climbing – it's an adventure that will transform your technical abilities, mental strength, and appreciation for one of the world's most unique climbing destinations.

rows.title: Czech Sandstone Climbing Experience (Cloned)
rows.body:
ADVENTURE AWAITS: CONQUER THE LEGENDARY CZECH SANDSTONE!

 

Ever scaled British gritstone? Then prepare for Czech sandstone's thrilling cousin—only wilder and more spectacular! Never heard of either? You're about to discover why the majestic Elbe Mountains house some of the world's most coveted climbing terrain that elite climbers travel continents to experience!

 

This isn't just another climbing trip—it's your exclusive passport to Czech climbing paradise with guides who aren't just experts, they're local legends who've personally pioneered routes through this sandstone wonderland. Perfect for experienced climbers craving fresh challenges beyond the ordinary, yet welcoming to anyone confident in their belaying skills and basic technique.

 

Imagine yourself conquering ancient towers that have defied time itself, guided by passionate locals who know every hidden gem in this rock climber's paradise. The breathtaking Elbe River has carved an awe-inspiring gorge through the sandstone, creating a playground of cracks, crevices, and formations that will make your climbing soul sing with excitement!

 

Straddling the mystical borderlands between German Saxony and Czech Bohemia, these protected formations rise dramatically from lush forests in a national park so stunning it belongs on magazine covers. The vertical challenges here aren't just climbs—they're the stuff of climbing legend that will forever transform how you view the sport.

 

 

Climbing course highlights:

 

Maximum quality and quantity of climbing.

  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching

 

 

Detailed technical specification of the climbing course:

 

  • What equipment do you need, and how to choose it so you have the best climbing experience while staying safe
  • Technical climbing skills like how to belay, set up a top-rope, and lead climb (depending on your level)
  • Climbing calls and communication so that you can get your message across to your climbing buddies
  • Movement skills to help you climb more efficiently
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day
  • Cleaning the anchors so you can retrieve all your gear
  • Lead climbing technique
  • Work on balance so that you climb in a more efficient way
  • Time on slab and vertical ground to improve footwork for better climbing
  • Overhang work to build strength and confidence so you can take on tougher climbing challenges
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

 

Physical & technical requirements:

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience recommended
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

 

Minimum of 3  participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
If you’re familiar with British gritstone then Czech sandstone will be surprisingly similar. If you’ve got no idea what we’re talking about then all you need to know is that the Czech sandstone of the Elbe Mountains is one of the best rock types for climbing.

 

This is your chance to experience some of the most unique and exciting Czech climbing, accompanied by some of the finest guides you could ever wish to meet (even if we do say so ourselves). It’s perfect for climbers who’ve got a fair bit of experience under their belt looking for new challanges and bit more exotic climbing styles, but open to anyone who can belay safely and tie on without assistance.
rows.bodyMore:
The Unique Appeal of Rockbusters' Czech Sandstone Climbing Experience

Nestled in the stunning Elbe Mountains lies one of climbing's best-kept secrets – the extraordinary Czech sandstone formations. Joining Rockbusters' Czech Sandstone Climbing Experience offers climbers a truly distinctive adventure in this climbing paradise.

 

Expert Guidance in a Unique Setting

When you join Rockbusters, you'll be guided by local climbing experts and route developers who possess intimate knowledge of the Elbe sandstone region. These ancient rock formations, straddling the border between German Saxony and Czech Bohemia, create a national park filled with stunning cracks and crevices that serious climbers find irresistible.

 

Technical Growth and Skill Development

The program provides six full days of intensive climbing with professional guides and coaches who offer personalized instruction. With a maximum 7:1 client-coach ratio, you'll receive individualized attention to improve your climbing technique and mental game. The sandstone's unique properties demand extremely technical climbing styles – even the most challenging overhangs require delicate movement and finesse, making this experience invaluable for developing technical skills applicable to all climbing environments.

 

Immersion in Climbing Culture

Beyond the physical challenges, the Czech Sandstone Experience introduces you to a vibrant climbing community with its traditions and ethics. Local Czech climbers are technically accomplished, unafraid of challenging routes, and protective of their fragile sandstone environment while welcoming visitors who respect it. After conquering towers, you might find yourself celebrating at a local pub with some of the world's best (and most affordable) beer.

 

Breathtaking Scenery and Unique Terrain

Despite being just an hour from Prague, climbing in the Bohemian Paradise (Český ráj) offers a remote, wild atmosphere. The landscape features lush valleys, ancient castles, and those distinctive sandstone towers rising majestically from forests. With over 3,000 rock formations offering approximately 18,000 routes within a 40km range, the climbing possibilities are virtually endless.

Join Rockbusters for an experience that goes beyond mere climbing – it's an adventure that will transform your technical abilities, mental strength, and appreciation for one of the world's most unique climbing destinations.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our all female team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Pick up and drop off at closest airport. Other locations can be accommodated on request (FREE CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

From sporty non-climbers and beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Benjamin M’s experience exemplifies the effectiveness of this approach: “The best 3 climbing weeks ever! Europe’s Premier Climbing Destinations at Your Fingertips

 

One of Rockbusters’ most compelling advantages is their carefully curated selection of European climbing destinations. Their 2025 calendar features courses in locations chosen not just for their world-class routes but for their optimal learning environments.

Each destination offers unique rock types, climbing styles, and cultural experiences that combine to create a comprehensive development environment impossible to replicate at a single crag or indoor gym. Three-Dimensional Skill Development

rows.eventText:
Yo, rock junkies! Ready to get your climb on? Join our badass sport climbing course and push your limits on Europe's TOP crags. We're talking finger-shredding action, top-notch coaching, and a chance to level up your skills like never before.

 

Our motto? CLIMB OR DIE. Okay, not literally, but you get the idea. We're all about MAXING OUT YOUR ROCK TIME. No boring lectures here - just pure, unadulterated climbing. You'll be scaling walls like a pro before you know it.

 

This ain't your grandma's climbing course. It's perfect for anyone looking to refresh their safety game, nail that leading technique, and become a total rock star. Trust us, you'll be itching to book your spot.

 

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to eat, sleep, and breathe climbing. Your fingers won't know what hit 'em!

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended, minimum grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 

Detailed technical specifications of this climbing course

 

All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Andalucia Rock Trip 2025
rows.bodyMore:
DISCOVER THE ULTIMATE SPORT CLIMBING ROAD TRIP THROUGH SOUTHERN SPAIN

 

Embark on an unforgettable month-long journey through Andalucía's sun-drenched limestone paradise with Rockbusters' exclusive camper van climbing adventure. Our carefully crafted itinerary samples the finest sport climbing crags in southern Spain, offering an authentic climbing experience for enthusiasts seeking Mediterranean perfection.

 

Your home on wheels provides the ultimate flexibility to chase perfect conditions across Andalucía's diverse climbing terrain. Wake up to breathtaking views at the foot of world-class crags, with the freedom to extend your stay at favorite spots or move on to new challenges.

 

 

THE JOURNEY

 

Begin your adventure in the climbing mecca of El Chorro, where impressive limestone walls rise dramatically from the gorge. Test yourself on the stellar multi-pitch routes at Frontales and the athletic overhangs of Desplomilandia and El Makinodromo.

 

As the journey continues, discover the hidden gems of Málaga province – Cañete la Real, the imposing Tajo de los Rojos in Teba, and the north-facing walls of Archidona perfect for warmer days.

 

Venture further to the tranquil crags of Grazalema, Turon, and El Cahorros, where you'll find world-class routes with significantly fewer crowds. Our knowledgeable guides will lead you to sectors suited to all abilities, from beginner-friendly 5s to challenging 8-grade test pieces.
 

 

THE EXPERIENCE

 

Your fully-equipped camper van provides comfortable accommodation throughout the journey. Every evening, gather around for communal meals, route planning, and stories under star-filled Andalucían skies. On rest days, explore whitewashed villages, historic cities like Granada and Córdoba, or relax on Mediterranean beaches.

 

Our expert local guides ensure you experience the best climbing conditions each day, sharing their intimate knowledge of hidden crags, local beta, and authentic Spanish culture. With maximum flexibility and minimal logistics, this road trip delivers the perfect balance of world-class climbing and authentic Spanish adventure.

 

Space is limited to ensure an intimate experience and sustainable impact on these precious climbing areas. Book now to secure your spot on Rockbusters' most anticipated climbing journey of the year!

 

 

CLIMBER TESTIMONIALS


“The perfect combination of climbing freedom and local knowledge. Waking up beneath the crag with coffee brewing is something I’ll never forget!” — Maria, 38, Germany


“My third trip with Rockbusters and the best. The camper van format allowed us to chase perfect conditions across the region.” — James, 42, UK

rows.bodyMore:
The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' 4-Week Spanish Climbing Adventure

 

Joining Rockbusters' 4-week sport climbing road trip across Spain offers climbers a transformative experience that goes far beyond ordinary climbing vacations. The journey through Spain's premier climbing destinations—Sella, Chulilla, Siurana, and Margalef—provides unparalleled access to diverse limestone routes perfectly suited to challenge and develop your skills.

 

The personalized coaching is perhaps the most valuable aspect of the trip, with expert guides helping you climb "BETTER, HARDER & MORE" through individualized instruction tailored to your specific needs. Many participants report dramatic improvements, with some advancing from feeling intimidated on 6a routes to confidently tackling 7a climbs within just weeks.

 

The trip's flexible format allows you to join for a single week or the entire month-long adventure, making it accessible regardless of your schedule constraints. Beyond technical skills, you'll gain invaluable mental training—overcoming fear of falling, building endurance for longer routes, and developing strategies for resting effectively during climbs.

 

Perhaps most uniquely, Rockbusters offers an authentic community experience rather than a typical commercial climbing package. The relaxed, organic approach creates deep connections among participants, with many returning for multiple trips. This supportive environment accelerates your progression while creating lasting friendships with fellow climbers who share your passion.

rows.eventText:
The Rockbusters Spanish road trip is always one of our most popular events each year. It’s a tour that gives you a unique chance to discover the best Spanish crags. These are notoriously some of the best in the world so do yourself a favor and don't miss out. Trust us on this one. It’s an intense and epic tour that every climbing freak should experience.

 

Apart from getting a great introduction to great climbing areas all around Spain, you’ll also benefit from some world-class guiding. Our top performance coaches will help you develop your skills and you’ll have a blast with a great climbing company. We guarantee you a varied month full of fun and loads of new climbing experiences. Try out a massive range of different styles too, from vertical fingery lines in Montserrat to overhanging boulders in Albarracin – plus plenty more.

 

Join the tour for as many weeks as you want. At the weekends we stop at nearby airports to drop off and pick up clients who can't make it for the whole trip. Although we’d love it if you could come from beginning to end and think you will too.

 

Europe Rock Trip highlights

 

  • The best crags and the best routes in Europe
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' 4-Week Spanish Climbing Adventure

 

Joining Rockbusters' 4-week sport climbing road trip across Spain offers climbers a transformative experience that goes far beyond ordinary climbing vacations. The journey through Spain's premier climbing destinations—Sella, Chulilla, Siurana, and Margalef—provides unparalleled access to diverse limestone routes perfectly suited to challenge and develop your skills.

 

The personalized coaching is perhaps the most valuable aspect of the trip, with expert guides helping you climb "BETTER, HARDER & MORE" through individualized instruction tailored to your specific needs. Many participants report dramatic improvements, with some advancing from feeling intimidated on 6a routes to confidently tackling 7a climbs within just weeks.

 

The trip's flexible format allows you to join for a single week or the entire month-long adventure, making it accessible regardless of your schedule constraints. Beyond technical skills, you'll gain invaluable mental training—overcoming fear of falling, building endurance for longer routes, and developing strategies for resting effectively during climbs.

 

Perhaps most uniquely, Rockbusters offers an authentic community experience rather than a typical commercial climbing package. The relaxed, organic approach creates deep connections among participants, with many returning for multiple trips. This supportive environment accelerates your progression while creating lasting friendships with fellow climbers who share your passion.
rows.perex: Step into a climbing legend at Siurana, where Week 3 elevates your technique on the same sun-kissed limestone that shaped sport climbing history. Perched dramatically above Catalonia's wine country, this medieval village offers the perfect blend of technical crimps, delicate sequences, and rich climbing culture. Here, your Rockbusters coaches will transform your precision and problem-solving skills on world-class routes that reward finesse over power, completing your evolution into a more complete, efficient climber amid one of Spain's most breathtaking and historic climbing settings.
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.bodyMore:
5 Key Benefits of Joining Rockbusters' Winter Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio

 

Are you looking for the perfect winter climbing escape? Rockbusters' January 2026 Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio, Greece, offers an unbeatable combination of benefits that make it worth booking now. Here's why this event should be at the top of your climbing wish list:

 

1. Ideal Winter Climbing Conditions

 

While northern Europe shivers under winter's grip, Leonidio offers mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C) and abundant sunshine. The region's famous limestone dries quickly after rain, ensuring maximum climbing time even during the Mediterranean winter. This perfect weather window lets you climb comfortably when most European crags are too cold or wet.

 

2. World-Class Limestone Variety

 

Leonidio's vibrant red and orange limestone cliffs offer over 1,000 routes across multiple sectors, from gentle slabs to challenging overhangs. The course takes you to the area's best sectors like Twin Caves, Hot Rock, and Mars, where you'll experience diverse climbing styles including pockets, tufas, and crimps. Whatever your climbing preference or level, Leonidio delivers.

 

3. Expert Coaching to Elevate Your Skills

 

The true value of this course lies in the expert coaching from Rockbusters' international team, including world-renowned climber Klemen Bečan. Their "Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!" philosophy translates to personalized instruction that addresses your specific needs. With a small group size (maximum 8 climbers), you'll receive individualized attention to help break through plateaus and master new techniques.

 

4. Authentic Greek Cultural Experience

 

January offers the unique opportunity to experience Leonidio at its most authentic. Beyond the climbing, you'll immerse yourself in genuine Greek culture, cuisine, and hospitality away from the tourist crowds. The course includes welcome dinners, local recommendations, and rest-day cultural excursions that add a rich cultural dimension to your climbing trip.

 

5. Community and Connection

 

Perhaps the most unexpected benefit is the sense of community. Sharing this winter climbing adventure creates lasting connections with like-minded climbers from around the world. The course culminates in a celebration with the local climbing community, fostering international friendships that extend far beyond your week in Greece.

 

Don't miss this opportunity to transform your climbing while escaping winter's chill in one of Europe's most spectacular settings. Early booking is recommended as winter courses in Leonidio tend to fill quickly!

rows.title: Trad Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Imagine this: You are climbing a rock face some 100+ meters above the ground, tied into two cords, running your fingers through the gear on your harness, and trying to choose the right piece that will fit into a fissure in front of your face. Tall mountains around and a narrow valley behind you provide a backdrop to the scene. How far below me is my last solid protection, you wonder. I’m in good hands with my climbing partner, you reassure yourself.

 

This is exactly what trad climbing can be like: a complex mixture of emotions and physical effort. Fear, frustration, mental and physical fatigue... Satisfaction, pleasure… The experience can be super rewarding if everything goes well

 

 

Climbing course highlights:

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive trad climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 4:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 8 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 


Physical & technical requirements:

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. RP grade 6b
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

Detailed technical specification of the climbing course:

 

All skills and tricks needed to become an independent & self-confident climber on trad routes, such as:

 

  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and  how to treat and store it
  • Reading and understanding of guidebooks and topos, route finding, …
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Lead trad climbing techniques (efficient clipping, cleaning anchors, …)
  • Proper and fast placement of the right pieces of your gear
  • Stance management: how to handle the rope, hanging belays, ...
  • Building belay stances and anchors using trad gear
  • Abseils and retreats for getting yourself back down to terra firma
  • Self-rescue skills - worth knowing if you want to make it home safely
  • Choose a proper strategy (place a piece or climb further) to be fast, efficient, and safe
  • Fear management
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

5 Life-Changing Benefits of Mastering Trad Climbing in Bohuslän

 

Transitioning from sport climbing to traditional climbing isn't just learning new techniques—it's unlocking an entirely new dimension of the climbing experience. Here's why Rockbusters' Trad Climbing Course in Bohuslän delivers unparalleled value:

 

1. Freedom to Climb Anywhere

 

Traditional climbing skills open doors to legendary routes inaccessible to sport climbers. After this intensive course, you'll possess the rare ability to climb safely and confidently in remote areas without fixed protection—from Yosemite's iconic walls to untouched crags worldwide.

 

2. Accelerated Learning in World-Class Terrain

 

Bohuslän's perfect granite cracks provide the ideal classroom for trad climbing education. In just six days, you'll compress what might take years of self-teaching into one structured, comprehensive experience under expert guidance.

 

3. Confidence Through Expert Mentorship

 

The 4:1 client-coach ratio ensures personalized instruction from internationally certified guides who identify and correct your specific technical weaknesses. Video analysis of your climbing technique provides immediate, actionable feedback that rapidly elevates your performance.

 

4. Complete Mental Framework

 

Beyond physical techniques, you'll develop the critical mental skills essential for trad climbing—risk assessment, decision-making under pressure, and fear management strategies that transform intimidating situations into manageable challenges.

 

5. Community and Connections

 

Join a select group of climbers making the crucial sport-to-trad transition together. These shared experiences foster lasting relationships with like-minded adventurers who often become lifelong climbing partners and friends.

 

The true value of this course extends far beyond the week spent in Sweden. You're not just learning to place gear—you're gaining lifetime access to climbing's most rewarding experiences and joining an exclusive community of self-sufficient climbers capable of tackling the world's most magnificent rock formations.

rows.title: Patxi Usobiaga Masterclass: World Champion Sport Climbing Clinic (Cloned)
rows.body:
Patxi Usobiaga, the renowned Spanish pro climber, achieved great success in his climbing career. In 2009, he emerged victorious in the World Championship held in Qinghai. Furthermore, he holds the distinction of being one of the few individuals to win two consecutive overall Lead Climbing World Cup competitions. Patxi's path to triumph has always been characterized by a sophisticated and exceptionally rigorous training regimen.

 

Notably, Patxi made history as the first climber to onsight an 8c+ route. He has also successfully redpointed numerous routes with grades ranging from 9a to 9a+. Given his exceptional skills and experience, few coaches can match his expertise in leading our Advanced Sport Climbing Course.

 

By enrolling in this sport climbing course led by Patxi, participants will gain access to a comprehensive set of techniques and strategies to conquer challenging routes at their maximum potential. In addition, they will develop essential mental skills to effectively manage pressure, fears, and stress. At Rockbusters, we adhere to the "LEARN by DOING" philosophy, which means that our climbing trips and courses provide hands-on coaching while scaling top-notch routes at renowned crags. Our primary goal is to maximize your climbing experience through ample practice time on the rock. With our expert guidance in both climbing technique coaching and mental coaching, you can expect significant improvements in your abilities.

 

Sport climbing course highlights
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi Usobiaga, a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed, minimum On-Sight 6c (5.11b), or Red-Point 7a (5.11d) grade
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 

All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes at your limits (or beyond your imaginary limits), such as:

 

  • Analysis of your strengths and weaknesses
  • Choosing the right hard project and a strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebar, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers
  • Choosing the right equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, plus advice on how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks
  • Proper lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Elevate Your Climbing: The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience

 

Are you stuck at a plateau in your climbing journey? Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience with Patxi Usobiaga might be exactly what you need to break through to the next level.

Training with Patxi Usobiaga — a World Champion and the first climber to onsight 8c+ — offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from one of the sport's greatest talents. What makes this experience exceptional isn't just Patxi's impressive resume, but his methodical approach to climbing improvement.

The program begins with a comprehensive assessment at Patxi's climbing gym in Coll de Nargo, where he analyzes your strengths and weaknesses. This personalized approach ensures that every participant receives tailored guidance, whether you need to improve power, endurance, technique, or mental focus.

Unlike basic climbing courses, this advanced experience is designed for climbers comfortable with at least 6c routes who are looking to push beyond their current limits. Participants receive individualized attention as Patxi carefully selects routes that challenge your specific weaknesses while building on their strengths.

Perhaps most valuable is the mental training aspect. As one participant noted, "Improving your mental game is low-hanging fruit" when physical gains become harder to achieve. This course helps you realize "that the impossible is possible, but only if you push yourself to your limits, and beyond."

The benefits extend beyond the week-long experience itself. Participants receive a free one-month training plan designed by Patxi, with options for long-term follow-up coaching. This continued support helps ensure that the progress made during the course translates into lasting improvement.

Beyond the technical benefits, participants consistently highlight the community aspect—spending a week climbing world-class routes with fellow enthusiasts from around the globe creates lasting connections and a supportive network of climbers with similar goals.

 

Patxi sport climbing & bouldering performance analysis


Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components: mental power, physical power, and technical skills. We will be discussing how big a part each component has in your climbing performance. For a performance climber, the goal is to approach mastery in all these areas to reach their potential. And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer, or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

There is no one better qualified than Patxi Usobiaga to lead this course. Patxi, an ex-world champ and a “training monster”, says that his “talent is to be able to suffer”. He is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods, to name just a few.

Pair up with Patxi for a week of climbing and training sessions, send some cool on-sights, flashes, or red points in his home destination of Oliana, and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance. Simply climb BETTER, HARDER, and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Physical power (maximum power, resistance power, stamina, explosiveness, weaknesses vs strengths, …)

Technical skills (footwork, balance, proper use of techniques as sidestep, drop knee, flagging, resting, breathing, how to grip properly - crimp, open hand, pinch, …)

rows.included:

rows.whatToBring:
We provide most of the technical equipment, but for your comfort and safety, please bring the following personal items:
 

Core Climbing Gear

  • Climbing Shoes: Reasonably tight/technical (Bring 2 pairs for Deep Blue).
  • Harness: Comfortable and well-fitting.
  • Helmet: Lightweight and UIAA certified.
  • Belay Device: (e.g., ATC Guide or Reverso) with 2 screw-gate carabiners.
  • Personal Sling: One 60cm sling with a dedicated locking carabiner.

Apparel & Essentials

  • Approach Shoes: Comfortable, sticky-rubber shoes for the hike to the crag.
  • Insulation: A lightweight down or synthetic jacket for chilly evenings or wind.
  • Weather Protection: A reliable rain shell/jacket and a warm hat.
  • The "Extras": Headlamp (with fresh batteries), sleeping bag, and a backpack (30L–40L) large enough for your gear and lunch.
