  • Convenience: Local shops are close by if you need to replenish supplies during the week.

Full details and logistics will be provided after booking.
rows.included:
• Elite Coaching: Personalized, one-on-one technical instruction tailored to your specific goals and climbing level.
  • Pro Guiding: Expert local knowledge with daily recommendations for the best routes and hidden gems.
  • Technical Gear: Full access to high-quality climbing safety equipment and group hardware.
  • Basecamp: Shared accommodation in handpicked, climber-friendly hostels or cottages.
rows.excluded:
• Transportation: Flights and local travel are not included. We are happy to help coordinate shared rental cars within the group to split costs.
  • Insurance: You are responsible for your own travel and climbing accident insurance.
  • Food & Drinks: Meals and beverages are personal costs.
  • Group Dinners: For convenience, we can organize communal group dinners for €15 per meal.
rows.whatToBring:
We provide most of the technical equipment, but for your comfort and safety, please bring the following personal items:
 

Core Climbing Gear

  • Climbing Shoes: Reasonably tight/technical (Bring 2 pairs for Deep Blue).
  • Harness: Comfortable and well-fitting.
  • Helmet: Lightweight and UIAA certified.
  • Belay Device: (e.g., ATC Guide or Reverso) with 2 screw-gate carabiners.
  • Personal Sling: One 60cm sling with a dedicated locking carabiner.

Apparel & Essentials

  • Approach Shoes: Comfortable, sticky-rubber shoes for the hike to the crag.
  • Insulation: A lightweight down or synthetic jacket for chilly evenings or wind.
  • Weather Protection: A reliable rain shell/jacket and a warm hat.
  • The "Extras": Headlamp (with fresh batteries), sleeping bag, and a backpack (30L–40L) large enough for your gear and lunch.

rows.title: Patxi Usobiaga Masterclass: World Champion Sport Climbing Clinic (Cloned)
rows.body:
Patxi Usobiaga, the renowned Spanish pro climber, achieved great success in his climbing career. In 2009, he emerged victorious in the World Championship held in Qinghai. Furthermore, he holds the distinction of being one of the few individuals to win two consecutive overall Lead Climbing World Cup competitions. Patxi's path to triumph has always been characterized by a sophisticated and exceptionally rigorous training regimen.

 

Notably, Patxi made history as the first climber to onsight an 8c+ route. He has also successfully redpointed numerous routes with grades ranging from 9a to 9a+. Given his exceptional skills and experience, few coaches can match his expertise in leading our Advanced Sport Climbing Course.

 

By enrolling in this sport climbing course led by Patxi, participants will gain access to a comprehensive set of techniques and strategies to conquer challenging routes at their maximum potential. In addition, they will develop essential mental skills to effectively manage pressure, fears, and stress. At Rockbusters, we adhere to the "LEARN by DOING" philosophy, which means that our climbing trips and courses provide hands-on coaching while scaling top-notch routes at renowned crags. Our primary goal is to maximize your climbing experience through ample practice time on the rock. With our expert guidance in both climbing technique coaching and mental coaching, you can expect significant improvements in your abilities.

 

Sport climbing course highlights
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi Usobiaga, a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed, minimum On-Sight 6c (5.11b), or Red-Point 7a (5.11d) grade
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 

All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes at your limits (or beyond your imaginary limits), such as:

 

  • Analysis of your strengths and weaknesses
  • Choosing the right hard project and a strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebar, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers
  • Choosing the right equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, plus advice on how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks
  • Proper lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses in the same or higher value or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
For those who do not know, Patxi Usobiaga is Spanish pro climber who has as a first ever won two overall Lead Climbing World Cups in row. In 2009 he won the  Lead Climbing World Championships in Qinghai and is very well known as a master of unbelievably hard training methods. Patxi was the first climber ever to on-sight 8c+ and red-pointed various 9a and 9a+. Do you know anybody better to coach this Advance Sport Climbing Course?

 

To the pack of all the tricks and mental skills how to approach, project and climb hard routes above your limits, how to handle mental pressure, fears and stress, Patxi will also measure your pure strength, point out your strong point and weaknesses and suggest a plan for training with possibility to lead you through your progress in long term.

 

Of course as on any Rockbusters climbing trips and courses we bring our philosophy to "LEARN by DOING" so  you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters we think only practice makes you better so the goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

  • Video analysis

  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high

All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Analysis of your strength and weaknesses + basic training plan proposal
  • Choosing the right hard project and strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...

  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, knee bars, ...)

  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)

rows.bodyMore:
Elevate Your Climbing: The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience

 

Are you stuck at a plateau in your climbing journey? Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience with Patxi Usobiaga might be exactly what you need to break through to the next level.

Training with Patxi Usobiaga — a World Champion and the first climber to onsight 8c+ — offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from one of the sport's greatest talents. What makes this experience exceptional isn't just Patxi's impressive resume, but his methodical approach to climbing improvement.

The program begins with a comprehensive assessment at Patxi's climbing gym in Coll de Nargo, where he analyzes your strengths and weaknesses. This personalized approach ensures that every participant receives tailored guidance, whether you need to improve power, endurance, technique, or mental focus.

Unlike basic climbing courses, this advanced experience is designed for climbers comfortable with at least 6c routes who are looking to push beyond their current limits. Participants receive individualized attention as Patxi carefully selects routes that challenge your specific weaknesses while building on their strengths.

Perhaps most valuable is the mental training aspect. As one participant noted, "Improving your mental game is low-hanging fruit" when physical gains become harder to achieve. This course helps you realize "that the impossible is possible, but only if you push yourself to your limits, and beyond."

The benefits extend beyond the week-long experience itself. Participants receive a free one-month training plan designed by Patxi, with options for long-term follow-up coaching. This continued support helps ensure that the progress made during the course translates into lasting improvement.

Beyond the technical benefits, participants consistently highlight the community aspect—spending a week climbing world-class routes with fellow enthusiasts from around the globe creates lasting connections and a supportive network of climbers with similar goals.

 

Patxi sport climbing & bouldering performance analysis


Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components: mental power, physical power, and technical skills. We will be discussing how big a part each component has in your climbing performance. For a performance climber, the goal is to approach mastery in all these areas to reach their potential. And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer, or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

There is no one better qualified than Patxi Usobiaga to lead this course. Patxi, an ex-world champ and a “training monster”, says that his “talent is to be able to suffer”. He is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods, to name just a few.

Pair up with Patxi for a week of climbing and training sessions, send some cool on-sights, flashes, or red points in his home destination of Oliana, and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance. Simply climb BETTER, HARDER, and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Physical power (maximum power, resistance power, stamina, explosiveness, weaknesses vs strengths, …)

Technical skills (footwork, balance, proper use of techniques as sidestep, drop knee, flagging, resting, breathing, how to grip properly - crimp, open hand, pinch, …)

rows.title: Beginners - Learn to Lead Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and coahing.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Local transport (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for total NOVICES, transitioning from GYM to ROCK. For total beginner to people looking for first rock experience, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 4 - First lead climbs on easy terrain. Cleaning anchors safely.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Rapeling techniques. 

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Beginners - Learn to Lead Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

Guiding and coahing.

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

rows.title: Beginners - Learn to Lead Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

rows.title: Beginners - Learn to Lead Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

Rodellar in Spain is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. Apart from relaxing with a glass of wine, climbing huge overhanging walls of orange limestone is the only thing to do in the sleepy village. The area is known for tufas, huge caves, and long and steep stamina routes, but there are also many vertical crags offering some more technical climbing. Rodellar offers a good grade range from fours all the way up to 9a, but to truly appreciate the area, it is recommended that you climb around f7a. Tufas, slopers, wide pinches, jugs, kneebars, drop knees, heel hooks, dynos, and a lot of endurance are Rodellar classics.

rows.bodyMore:
Benefits of the Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip

 

Have you ever dreamed of spending two months climbing the most spectacular routes across Europe? The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip offers exactly that—an 8-week journey through the continent’s premier climbing destinations. But this adventure delivers far more than just world-class climbing. Here’s why joining this extraordinary trip could be one of the best decisions for both your climbing career and personal growth.
 

 

Physical Transformation Through Diverse Climbing Environments

 

The Rockbusters trip takes you through eight distinct climbing regions, each offering unique physical challenges. From the sandstone towers of Labské Údoli in the Czech Republic to the Mediterranean limestone of Finale Ligure in Italy, your body adapts to different rock types and climbing styles.

 

Research shows that extended climbing experiences like this provide remarkable physical benefits. The varied terrain ensures full-body muscle engagement, with each location challenging different muscle groups. Your cardiovascular system strengthens as you tackle the 8,000+ bolted routes of Frankenjura, Germany, while your flexibility improves while navigating the technical moves required on the high-quality limestone of Ceüse, France.

 

Unlike gym training that can become repetitive, this trip’s constantly changing environments keep your body guessing and adapting, resulting in more balanced physical development and effective weight management through sustained activity.

 

Mental Growth Backed by Science

 

The mental benefits of this climbing journey are equally impressive—and scientifically proven. Recent studies demonstrate that climbers experience significant reductions in anxiety, with measurable decreases in both Separation Anxiety Disorder and Generalized Anxiety Disorder.

 

Each climbing destination presents new puzzles to solve. The conglomerate rock of Margalef, Spain, demands different problem-solving approaches than the overhanging routes of Rodellar. This constant mental challenge enhances your focus, concentration, and decision-making abilities in ways that extend far beyond climbing.

 

As you progress through increasingly difficult routes across Europe, you’ll build mental resilience that transfers to everyday life challenges. Many climbers report that after extended climbing trips, they approach personal and professional obstacles with newfound confidence and clarity.

 


Skill Acceleration Through Varied Terrain

 

Eight weeks across Europe’s diverse climbing landscapes accelerate your technical development in ways that staying in one location simply cannot match. Each region specializes in different climbing styles:

 

  • Master traditional climbing techniques on Czech sandstone
  • Develop power and finger strength on Frankenjura’s pocketed limestone
  • Perfect your endurance on the long routes of the Gorges du Tarn, France
  • Learn efficient movement on the technical faces of Zillertal, Austria

 

This exposure to varied climbing styles forces rapid adaptation and prevents the development of technique gaps that often occur when climbing exclusively in one area. By the trip’s end, you’ll possess a well-rounded skill set that would take years to develop otherwise.

 

Cultural Immersion and Lasting Friendships

The program emphasizes respectful engagement with local communities, giving you authentic cultural experiences that typical tourists miss. From sampling regional cuisines to learning about the climbing history of each area, you’ll gain a richer understanding of Europe’s diverse climbing heritage.

rows.itineraryText:
We think you’ll agree that our itinerary is pretty spectacular. Here’s where the tour stops:

Labské údolí - Czech republic

The Elbe Mountains are without doubt one of the best sandstone areas in Europe, forming the border between the Czech Republic and Germany. The River Elbe carves its way through the soft sandstone creating steep sided gorges and crags that are begging to be climbed. It’s very challenging for technical sport climbing and generally considered suitable for climbers capable of leading 6a’s and harder. If you’ve got a bit of experience under your belt then this is a great place to improve your technique and mental control – becoming a Zen climbing master.

Fly via Prague, arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday. 

Frankenjura - Germany

One of the biggest and best climbing spots in Germany and probably Europe too. Located between Nuremberg, Bamberg and Bayreuth there are about 1,000 crags to explore in the area, which is enough to keep anyone busy. Most routes are short, powerful single pitch sport climbs on limestone with plenty of finger pockets. With around 10,000 routes, this is perfect for climbers of all levels. It’s also family-friendly and a top spot to start leading or to do your first outdoor climbs all backdropped by the beautiful forests of Bavaria. There’s accommodation to suit most needs and budgets in campsites or guesthouses.

Fly via Nürnberg, Germany: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.  

Zillertal - Austria

The undisputed best granite climbing spot in the Tirol, bar none. There are around 700 routes to climb, seven via ferratas, climbing gardens and lots of pitch tours. With so many options you can climb here until your fingers bleed (hopefully not of course!). We usually say that some outdoor climbing experience and leading may be relevant but not essential, and there are plenty of routes for all abilities. We love this stop on the tour and think you will too. Accommodation is in a local campsite.

Fly to München, Germany. Fly from Milano, Italy: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Monday to Friday.  

Finale Ligure - Italy

With the Czech Republic, Germany and Austria done, Italy is the next logical stop. And what a stop it is. The climbing at Finale Ligure is stunning. With around 2,700 routes to choose on white limestone rocks in an area of about 10 square kilometres, this is one of the best climbing areas in Italy. The deep green landscape can be harsh and wild, and it’s not your usual climbing area, but then again, this is not your usual climbing tour either. It’s the perfect place for experienced climbers to go hard and beginners to bag their first crags. The free camping area is a nice bonus too.

Fly to Milano, Italy. Fly from Torino, Italy: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Ceüse – France

The best sports climbing crag in France and maybe even the world, this is a no brainer stop off point for our tour. Blessed with beautifully pocketed limestone, amazing lines and a truly stunning location, this is a climbing nivannah that is not to be missed. Most routes are single pitch and the climbing is really varied, ranging from overhangs to steep technical walls. The routes are renowned for being tough and requiring plenty of stamina so they are mostly suitable for climbers with some outdoor climbing experience and good fitness. Leading experience is also relevant but not essential. Accommodation in Ceüse is in a campsite.

Fly into Torino, Italy. Fly back from Montpellier, France:  arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Gorge du Tarn - France

Situated in the south-west of France in the Pyrenees, this is a well-known spot for bouldering and sports climbing. The rock here is good and well-bolted with the Gorge du Tarn offering excellent steep overhangs that will test the stamina of even experienced climbers. There’s a good spread of grades so something for all ability levels to get stuck into. Some routes are up to 150m long. Again, it’s suitable for sport climbers with at least some outdoor climbing experience and being able to lead climb is relevant but not essential. Accommodation is also in a campsite.

Fly via Montpelliere, France: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Margalef – Spain

Considered a climbing paradise by some, Margalef in Spain is located near to Montsant and Siurana. With more than 500 routes of all types, quality and grades. There’s big overhangs, small pockets, tufas, boulder routes and plenty more to try out. It’s all found in nearly 50 crags spread over two valleys, with climbs of all grades including slabs, overhangs and vertical walls. It’s an incredibly beautiful place too. It’s suitable for sport climbers with at least some outdoor climbing experience. Leading is helpful but not essential. Accommodation is in a local campsite.

Fly via Barcelona/Llerida, Spain: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Rodellar - Spain

The last stop on the tour is appropriately one of the world's best climbing areas. We’ll take on athletic, long stamina climbs in huge caves and there’s another chance to improve your tufa technique. This is mostly advanced sport climbing and suitable for climbers with outdoor climbing experience although there are plenty of easy routes to enjoy if you are less experienced. But by this time on the tour, you should be able to take on the challenge. Leading experience is not essential, but very welcome. Accommodation is in an excellent refuge within walking distance of the crags.

Fly via Barcelona, Spain: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

 

So, as you can see, this is a pretty comprehensive European tour stopping at many of Europe’s legendary climbing spots. Join the crew from the start and travel the whole way or pick your favorite destination and we’ll meet you there. However you do it, being part of our European tour you’ll become part of the Rockbusters family, live the life and become a better climber. What’s not to like?

rows.description: Finding it hard to bring your climbing to the next level? Join us to find out what sport climbing means to those who live it. Become one of the family.
rows.accommodation:
There is a basic shared accommodation organized by Rockbusters. Our main goal is to integrate you into the local climbing communities and for these purposes, we use local climbing hostels, cottages, campsites, or places run by local climbers. Feel free to reach out to adjust these settings to your personal satisfaction. 

For accommodation of higher standards please make a personal inquiry through email/WhatsApp

In Labske Udoli, Frankenjura, Finale Ligure, Zillertal, Margalef, and Rodellar we stay in hostels or campsites bungalows with bunk beds. In Gorges du Tarn we use permanent caravans which belong to the campsite and in Ceuse we stay in campsites with hot showers, wi-fi, a restaurant, ..., we provide tents so you will need to bring a sleeping bag and foam pad.
rows.food:
Upon arrival, we will take you to the store to shop for breakfast and lunch food for the week. Refrigerators are provided by the campsite, and we will return to the store once more during the week to replenish supplies.

There are options to cook individually, in groups or eat outside.

rows.body:
Master the art of sport climbing with our intensive course. Join us on a thrilling European road trip, where you'll tackle some of the best crags on the continent. With expert coaching and guidance, you'll push your limits, boost your technique, and enhance your strength. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced climber, this course is designed to elevate your skills and maximize your climbing time. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to become a true rock legend.

 

Margalef Rock is a conglomerate, not too solid but great anyway. Climbing here is quite peculiar as you mostly move between one, two, or three-finger pockets. There are great lines of all difficulties from f5 to f9, which is one of the reasons for Margalef’s popularity. It is superb, fun climbing in great scenery, where everybody can find what they need. Margalef offers mostly slightly overhanging or vertical lines as well as slabs, very steep overhangs, and even some tufas. Climbing here is varied enough to satisfy every climber.

 

 

This trip is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique, and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • The best crags and the best routes in Europe
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended, minimum grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

 

Detailed technical specifications of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every
  • day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

SCHEDULE OF DESTINATIONS:  
 

Week 1 - Labské Údolí / Czech Republic

Week 2 - Frankenjura / Germany

Week 3 - Zillertal / Austria

Week 4 - Finale Ligure - Oltre Finale / Italy

Week 5 - Céüse / France

Week 6 - Georges du Tarn / France

Week 7 - Margalef / Spain

Week 8 - Rodellar / Spain

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
Climbing Eurotrip is Rockbusters favourite time of the year. How could it not be? We’re driving across the continent, stopping at all of the most iconic crags and any other you want to visit. You can focus on climbing as much as possible, while experiencing the freedom of the ultimate climbing road trip. We love it and our guests love it, so we do it year after year!

The nature of the Climbing Eurotrip allows you to dip in and out of it as you wish. You can join us for the whole duration (8 weeks) or join us for your favourite locations. The atmosphere of the Rockbusters Eurotrip is legendary. Everyone quickly becomes a part of the Rockbusters family. After weeks on the road, it’s always hard to say goodbye and you’re likely to come back for more next year!

We’ll introduce you to many of Europe’s best climbing locations, like the Frankenjura, Margalef or Ceuse.

You will experience sport climbing at its best, receive expert coaching and guidance, as well as have the most fun you ever have while rock climbing!

Join us for the whole duration of the trip or just choose the destinations or dates that work for you.ome along for as long or short as you want - we’ll even pick you up from the airport.

Our performance coaching is ongoing throughout the tour. Below are the examples of topics covered:

  • Choosing the most suitable climbing gear for your needs and how to use it safely

  • Belaying, lead belaying, setting up top-ropes and lead climbing in the way that’s most conducive to learning new rock climbing skills

  • Standard climbing calls and best communication practice to ensure safety wherever you go

  • Using guidebooks so that you can become a confident, independent climber

  • Understanding of objective outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day

  • Cleaning the anchors and routes so you can retrieve all your gear safely

  • Movement skills (technique) for more efficient climbing

  • Footwork on slabs and vertical faces, using balance and correct feet placements to maximise your efficiency on the rock (for climbers leading f5 or harder)

  • Steep climbing techniques (overhangs), resting and saving energy (for climbers leading f6c or harder)

 

The trip is suitable for climbers of all levels as our experienced team of instructors and guides will plan the itinerary to suit the needs of the whole group. Everybody gets to climb as much as they can, receiving as much coaching as they need.

Our main focus is having long, epic climbing days (without having an epic!). You can tackle many routes each day and spend plenty of time on the rock.  

SCHEDULE OF DESTINATIONS:  

Week 1 - Labské Údolí / Czech Republic

Week 2 - Frankenjura / Germany

Week 3 - Zillertal / Austria

Week 4 - Finale Ligure / Italy

Week 5 - Céüse / France

Week 6 - Georges du Tarn / France

Week 7 - Margalef / Spain

Week 8 - Rodellar / Spain

  • Develop power and finger strength on Frankenjura’s pocketed limestone

The program emphasizes respectful engagement with local communities, giving you authentic cultural experiences that typical tourists miss. From sampling regional cuisines to learning about the climbing history of each area, you’ll gain a richer understanding of Europe’s diverse climbing heritage.

The physical strength, mental resilience, technical skills, cultural experiences, and friendships gained during these eight weeks create value that extends far beyond the price tag. Many climbers describe their European climbing trips as pivotal life experiences that fundamentally changed their approach to both climbing and personal challenges.

 

The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip isn’t just a vacation—it’s an investment in yourself as both a climber and a person. The question isn’t whether you can afford to go, but whether you can afford to miss this life-changing opportunity.

This conglomerate paradise demands mastery of pocket pulling in its most extreme form—from shallow monos to deep three-finger jugs—all set against a backdrop of olive groves and ancient hermitages. The distinctly Catalan climbing culture adds passion and pride to this unique Mediterranean experience.

Fly into Torino, Italy. Fly back from Montpellier, France:  arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Situated in the south-west of France in the Pyrenees, this is a well-known spot for bouldering and sports climbing. Fly via Barcelona/Llerida, Spain: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Rodellar - Spain

The last stop on the tour is appropriately one of the world's best climbing areas. We’ll take on athletic, long stamina climbs in huge caves and there’s another chance to improve your tufa technique. rows.accommodation:
There is a basic shared accommodation organized by Rockbusters. Our main goal is to integrate you into the local climbing communities and for these purposes, we use local climbing hostels, cottages, campsites or places run by local climbers. Feel free to reach out to adjust these settings to your personal satisfaction. 

In Labske Udoli, Frankenjura, Finale Ligure, Zillertal, Margalef, and Rodellar we stay in hostels or campsites bungalows with bunk beds. In Gorges du Tarn we use permanent caravans which belongs to the campsite and in Ceuse we stay in campsites with hot showers, wi-fi, restaurant, ..., we provide tents so you will need to bring a sleeping bag and foam pad.
rows.food:
Upon arrival, we will take you to the store to shop for breakfast and lunch food for the week. Refrigerators are provided by the campsite, and we will return to the store once more during the week to replenish supplies.

Communal Spanish-inspired dinners prepared by a professional chef are offered every night for €15. They include an entree, salad, dessert, and wine. Dietary restrictions and allergies can be accommodated with advanced notice. 

We may also decide to plan a night out at a restaurant in one of the many nearby towns.

rows.body:
Master the art of sport climbing with our intensive course. Join us on a thrilling European road trip, where you'll tackle some of the best crags on the continent. With expert coaching and guidance, you'll push your limits, boost your technique, and enhance your strength. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced climber, this course is designed to elevate your skills and maximize your climbing time. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to become a true rock legend.

 

Gorges du Tarn is one of the most iconic French sport climbing venues. It is beautifully set and is home to more than 400 classic routes of great quality. The rock is often overhanging limestone full of pockets and crimps. Climbing here usually requires more stamina than power, but there are sectors (Gullich) that offer short and bouldery climbs as well. The local specialty is incredible pumpy stamina climbs such as those in the popular Tennessee sector.

 

 

This trip is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique, and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • The best crags and the best routes in Europe
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.eventText:
Climbing Eurotrip is Rockbusters favourite time of the year. How could it not be? We’re driving across the continent, stopping at all of the most iconic crags and any other you want to visit. You can focus on climbing as much as possible, while experiencing the freedom of the ultimate climbing road trip. We love it and our guests love it, so we do it year after year!

The nature of the Climbing Eurotrip allows you to dip in and out of it as you wish. You can join us for the whole duration (8 weeks) or join us for your favourite locations. The atmosphere of the Rockbusters Eurotrip is legendary. Everyone quickly becomes a part of the Rockbusters family. After weeks on the road, it’s always hard to say goodbye and you’re likely to come back for more next year!

We’ll introduce you to many of Europe’s best climbing locations, like the Frankenjura, Margalef or Ceuse.

You will experience sport climbing at its best, receive expert coaching and guidance, as well as have the most fun you ever have while rock climbing!

Join us for the whole duration of the trip or just choose the destinations or dates that work for you.ome along for as long or short as you want - we’ll even pick you up from the airport.

Our performance coaching is ongoing throughout the tour. Below are the examples of topics covered:

  • Choosing the most suitable climbing gear for your needs and how to use it safely

  • Belaying, lead belaying, setting up top-ropes and lead climbing in the way that’s most conducive to learning new rock climbing skills

  • Standard climbing calls and best communication practice to ensure safety wherever you go

  • Using guidebooks so that you can become a confident, independent climber

  • Understanding of objective outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day

  • Cleaning the anchors and routes so you can retrieve all your gear safely

  • Movement skills (technique) for more efficient climbing

  • Footwork on slabs and vertical faces, using balance and correct feet placements to maximise your efficiency on the rock (for climbers leading f5 or harder)

  • Steep climbing techniques (overhangs), resting and saving energy (for climbers leading f6c or harder)

 

The trip is suitable for climbers of all levels as our experienced team of instructors and guides will plan the itinerary to suit the needs of the whole group. Everybody gets to climb as much as they can, receiving as much coaching as they need.

Our main focus is having long, epic climbing days (without having an epic!). You can tackle many routes each day and spend plenty of time on the rock.  

SCHEDULE OF DESTINATIONS:  

Week 1 - Labské Údolí / Czech Republic

Week 2 - Frankenjura / Germany

Week 3 - Zillertal / Austria

Week 4 - Finale Ligure / Italy

Week 5 - Céüse / France

Week 6 - Georges du Tarn / France

Week 7 - Margalef / Spain

Week 8 - Rodellar / Spain
rows.bodyMore:
Benefits of the Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip

 

Have you ever dreamed of spending two months climbing the most spectacular routes across Europe? The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip offers exactly that—an 8-week journey through the continent’s premier climbing destinations. But this adventure delivers far more than just world-class climbing. Here’s why joining this extraordinary trip could be one of the best decisions for both your climbing career and personal growth.
 

 

Physical Transformation Through Diverse Climbing Environments

 

The Rockbusters trip takes you through eight distinct climbing regions, each offering unique physical challenges. From the sandstone towers of Labské Údoli in the Czech Republic to the Mediterranean limestone of Finale Ligure in Italy, your body adapts to different rock types and climbing styles.

 

Research shows that extended climbing experiences like this provide remarkable physical benefits. The varied terrain ensures full-body muscle engagement, with each location challenging different muscle groups. Your cardiovascular system strengthens as you tackle the 8,000+ bolted routes of Frankenjura, Germany, while your flexibility improves while navigating the technical moves required on the high-quality limestone of Ceüse, France.

 

Unlike gym training that can become repetitive, this trip’s constantly changing environments keep your body guessing and adapting, resulting in more balanced physical development and effective weight management through sustained activity.

 

Mental Growth Backed by Science

 

The mental benefits of this climbing journey are equally impressive—and scientifically proven. Recent studies demonstrate that climbers experience significant reductions in anxiety, with measurable decreases in both Separation Anxiety Disorder and Generalized Anxiety Disorder.

 

Each climbing destination presents new puzzles to solve. The conglomerate rock of Margalef, Spain, demands different problem-solving approaches than the overhanging routes of Rodellar. This constant mental challenge enhances your focus, concentration, and decision-making abilities in ways that extend far beyond climbing.

 

As you progress through increasingly difficult routes across Europe, you’ll build mental resilience that transfers to everyday life challenges. Many climbers report that after extended climbing trips, they approach personal and professional obstacles with newfound confidence and clarity.

 


Skill Acceleration Through Varied Terrain

 

Eight weeks across Europe’s diverse climbing landscapes accelerate your technical development in ways that staying in one location simply cannot match. Each region specializes in different climbing styles:

 

  • Master traditional climbing techniques on Czech sandstone
  • Develop power and finger strength on Frankenjura’s pocketed limestone
  • Perfect your endurance on the long routes of the Gorges du Tarn, France
  • Learn efficient movement on the technical faces of Zillertal, Austria

 

This exposure to varied climbing styles forces rapid adaptation and prevents the development of technique gaps that often occur when climbing exclusively in one area. By the trip’s end, you’ll possess a well-rounded skill set that would take years to develop otherwise.

 

Cultural Immersion and Lasting Friendships

 

Beyond the climbing itself, the Rockbusters trip offers deep cultural immersion across multiple European countries. You’ll interact with local climbing communities, experience diverse traditions, and support sustainable tourism practices that benefit mountain regions.

 

The shared experience of traveling through Prague, Nuremberg, Munich, Milan, Barcelona, and other European cities creates bonds that often last a lifetime. Many past participants report that the friendships formed during these 8 weeks become their core climbing network for years afterward.

 

The program emphasizes respectful engagement with local communities, giving you authentic cultural experiences that typical tourists miss. From sampling regional cuisines to learning about the climbing history of each area, you’ll gain a richer understanding of Europe’s diverse climbing heritage.

 


Is the Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip Right for You?

 

If you can lead routes at 6a indoor grade or 5 outdoor grade, this trip offers an unparalleled opportunity to transform your climbing while experiencing the best of European culture. For 5500€, you receive 57 days of climbing across eight world-class destinations with accommodation included.

 

The physical strength, mental resilience, technical skills, cultural experiences, and friendships gained during these eight weeks create value that extends far beyond the price tag. Many climbers describe their European climbing trips as pivotal life experiences that fundamentally changed their approach to both climbing and personal challenges.

 

The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip isn’t just a vacation—it’s an investment in yourself as both a climber and a person. The question isn’t whether you can afford to go, but whether you can afford to miss this life-changing opportunity.

 

The next Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip runs from August 16 to October 11, 2025. Spaces are limited to ensure quality experiences for all participants.
rows.perex: GORGES DU TARN: Descend into a magical limestone canyon where emerald waters have sculpted a pocket-puller's paradise of perfectly formed divots in every imaginable size. Between powerful moves on vertical walls, cool off with refreshing swims in the crystal-clear river that winds through this fairy tale setting, then experience authentic southern French culture—local wines, regional delicacies, and the relaxed pace that makes Tarn the perfect blend of challenge and charm.

It’s very challenging for technical sport climbing and generally considered suitable for climbers capable of leading 6a’s and harder. If you’ve got a bit of experience under your belt then this is a great place to improve your technique and mental control – becoming a Zen climbing master.

Fly via Prague, arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday. 

Frankenjura - Germany

One of the biggest and best climbing spots in Germany and probably Europe too. It’s also family-friendly and a top spot to start leading or to do your first outdoor climbs all backdropped by the beautiful forests of Bavaria. There’s accommodation to suit most needs and budgets in campsites or guesthouses.

Fly via Nürnberg, Germany: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.  

Zillertal - Austria

The undisputed best granite climbing spot in the Tirol, bar none. There are around 700 routes to climb, seven via ferratas, climbing gardens and lots of pitch tours. rows.description: Finding it hard to bring your climbing to the next level? Join us to find out what sport climbing means to those who live it. Become one of the family.
rows.pageTitle: Sport Climbing with Rockbusters: Skills, Routines and Loads of Rock
rows.accommodation:
There is a basic shared accommodation organized by Rockbusters. Our main goal is to integrate you into the local climbing communities and for these purposes, we use local climbing hostels, cottages, campsites or places run by local climbers. Feel free to reach out to adjust these settings to your personal satisfaction. 

In Labske Udoli, Frankenjura, Finale Ligure, Zillertal, Margalef, and Rodellar we stay in hostels or campsites bungalows with bunk beds. In Gorges du Tarn we use permanent caravans which belongs to the campsite and in Ceuse we stay in campsites with hot showers, wi-fi, restaurant, ..., we provide tents so you will need to bring a sleeping bag and foam pad.
rows.food:
Upon arrival, we will take you to the store to shop for breakfast and lunch food for the week. Refrigerators are provided by the campsite, and we will return to the store once more during the week to replenish supplies.

Communal Spanish-inspired dinners prepared by a professional chef are offered every night for €15. They include an entree, salad, dessert, and wine. Dietary restrictions and allergies can be accommodated with advanced notice. 

We may also decide to plan a night out at a restaurant in one of the many nearby towns.
rows.included:
• Individualized coaching
  • Guiding and local knowledge
  • Climbing safety equipment & gear 
  • Accommodation (basic shared accommodation)

rows.excluded:
