rows.title: Sport climbing performance, technique & mental coaching (2 weeks) (Cloned)
rows.body:
Rockbusters have joined forces with one of the world's best climbers Klemen Bečan to help you climb BETTER and HARDER. This camp is specially tailored for those searching for a big push to speed up their progress towards a better climbing technique, a more efficient mindset, and a harder grade. There is no better way to do so than in a group of motivated climbers sharing the same goals and being helped out by professional coaches and guides led by one of the best climbers in the world. Our team will make sure everybody gets what they need, not only through intensive one on one coaching on the crag but also through recording and analyzing your climbing performance.

 

Sport climbing performance & mental coaching takes place in Rodellar, one of the world's best sport climbing venues and Rockbusters' top destinations. Rodellar in Spain is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. During this two-week stretch, we welcome all motivated climbers searching to progress, from beginners to experts. With two guides/coaches, we are able to adjust our approach and coaching individually to your needs and will.

 

We decided to set up Klemen's coaching camp in Rodellar so that everybody (no matter the level) can push their climbing to another level. Rodellar mekka of sport climbing in Aragon, Spain. It is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. During this two-week stretch, we welcome all motivated climbers searching to progress, from beginners to experts. With two guides/coaches, we are able to adjust our approach and coaching individually to your needs and will. 

 

Climbing course highlights:

 

Maximum quality and quantity of climbing.

  • 12 full days of intensive climbing with Klemen Becan, a professional climber, guide, and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 
Physical & technical requirements:

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. RP grade 6b/6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
rows.eventText:
There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

Our course will offer you the opportunity to maximise your potential and develop your climbing skills at a very high pace. During the trip we will help you push your grade while teaching you how to maintain sustainable, long-term progress beyond our time together.

Klemen Becan’s coaching focuses on balance and movement, which will help both your physical and mental development as a climber. Whether you are a complete rookie or an experienced cranker, analyzing your movement patterns and attitude will instantaneously boost your skills and help you break through any plateau.

Whatever your level, with plenty of time to practice newly learned techniques, you will increase your confidence and perform better than ever. After just one week of coaching you to head home with a completely new, advanced skillset. The aim of our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop is to allow you to learn from the best and use their well tested techniques to progress your climbing.

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join our Klemen Becan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop:

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn to find balance and use the most efficient and effective ways to propel your body up the rock without wasting energy. You will learn how to work with friction, make delicate steps and calculated, technical moves.

Overhangs

You’ll develop and practise skills to help you handle climbing steeper rock faces. We will cover footwork and techniques such as drop knees, heel and toe hooks. A lot of time will be dedicated to the fine art of resting while climbing, as well as fighting “the pump”, both mentally and physically.

Onsight vs redpoint techniques

Climbing onsight and projecting more difficult lines differs both physically and mentally. Klemen Bečan will cover the most effective strategies for success while onsighting or working a route over many days. You will have plenty of time to practice these and internalise the new skills.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

Maximum 4 clients per instructor!

rows.bodyMore:
Camp Format


Each day combines:


Full days climbing at world-class sport climbing crags

 

  • Technique workshops and drills on the wall
  •  Video analysis and movement feedback
  •  Mental performance exercises
  •  Individual coaching and group discussions


The focus is on deep learning and real climbing progress.

 

Locations


Rodellar, Spain

One of Europe’s most iconic sport climbing areas with steep limestone caves and endurance routes. Perfect for improving power endurance and advanced movement.

 

Kyparissi, Greece

A spectacular seaside climbing destination with technical vertical and slightly overhanging limestone routes. Ideal for precision movement and technical climbing.

Both locations provide excellent rock quality, inspiring scenery, and great climbing communities.

 

 

ELEVATE YOUR CLIMBING: WHY THE PERFORMANCE LAB IS YOUR GAME-CHANGER

 

Are you a dedicated climber who's hit that frustrating plateau? The Performance Lab by Rockbusters offers a rare opportunity to transform your climbing under the expert guidance of professional climber Klemen Becan and visionary founder Jany Novotny. Here's why this event is worth your time and investment:


EXPERT-LEVEL COACHING ACCELERATES PROGRESS

 

Working with Klemen Becan—who has conquered multiple 9a+ routes—gives you direct access to elite-level insights you simply can't get elsewhere. Rather than spending months or years figuring out technical issues through trial and error, you'll receive immediate feedback on subtle movement inefficiencies that are holding you back.

 

MENTAL TRAINING CREATES BREAKTHROUGH MOMENTS

 

The Performance Lab doesn't just focus on physical technique—it addresses the psychological barriers that often cause the biggest limitations. You'll develop structured approaches to manage fear, build confidence, and maintain focus during crucial climbing moments. These mental skills transfer beyond climbing into all aspects of life.

 

PERSONALIZED ANALYSIS REVEALS HIDDEN POTENTIAL

 

Unlike generic training programs, The Performance Lab provides an individualized assessment of your unique climbing style. Jany and Klemen will identify your specific energy leaks, movement patterns, and mental blocks, then create tailored solutions that work specifically for your body type and climbing approach.

 

COMMUNITY OF LIKE-MINDED CLIMBERS

 

You'll join a select group of motivated climbers facing similar challenges, creating an environment of shared learning and mutual support. This community aspect accelerates growth as you witness breakthroughs and share insights with peers who understand your journey.

Don't just train harder—train smarter. The Performance Lab offers the technical refinement, mental fortitude training, and personalized coaching that transform frustrating plateaus into exciting breakthroughs. Your next grade is waiting!

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

This course is suitable for climbers who are confident leading around f6b level. From intermediate to advanced climbers, our experienced team will plan each day so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from the airport at a time to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about people's abilities, ambitions, and the week ahead.

Day 2 - Introduction to the local style of climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

Day 4 - Discussion and practice on redpointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing with their technique.

Day 5 - Refinement of newly learnt techniques, including video analysis. Finding and working onsight and redpoint projects.

Day 6 - Focus on achieving projects. Additional personal coaching from Klemen.

Day 7 - Consolidation of the week’s work. Finishing projects and locking in new skills. Finally, a farewell dinner and a party for those with any remaining energy!

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport and we say goodbye. Until next time!

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. We invite you to listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: KNOTS & STONE: Czech Climbing Tradition
rows.bodyMore:
Why Join Our Tower Craft: Czech Sandstone Mastery Course

 
 

Experience Europe’s Most Unique Climbing Tradition

 

In the heart of Europe lies a climbing experience unlike any other in the world. Czech sandstone climbing represents one of the purest, most traditional forms of the sport—a living heritage that has influenced generations of climbers for over a century. Our Tower Craft course offers you a rare opportunity to immerse yourself in this extraordinary tradition under expert guidance.

 

A Climbing Style That Time Forgot

 

Czech sandstone climbing is not simply another style of ascent—it’s a philosophical approach to the vertical world that has remained largely unchanged for over 100 years. When you join our course, you’re not just learning techniques; you’re becoming part of a storied tradition where:

 

  • Metal protection is forbidden - Instead of modern cams and nuts, you’ll master the art of placing knotted slings and textile protection in cracks

  • Chalk use is restricted - Experience climbing in its purest form, developing sensitivity and technique rather than relying on grip enhancers

  • Ethics matter as much as achievement - Learn the strict local climbing code that prioritizes rock preservation and traditional methods

 

As Tom Randall of the Wide Boyz once described it: “It is, completely, a new style of climbing; I climb almost as if I am soloing. The head must be as strong as the hands.”

 

Towers That Inspire Awe

 

The sandstone formations of Bohemian Switzerland and Adršpach-Teplice are nothing short of magical—slender spires and labyrinthine walls rising from misty forests like something from a fantasy landscape. These aren’t just climbing routes; they’re monuments to an evolving philosophy that has survived wars, political changes, and generations of climbers.

 

Many of these towers were first climbed in the early 1900s, with some routes dating back to 1905. When you summit one of these spires using the same techniques as the pioneers, you create a direct connection to climbing history that few other experiences can offer.

 

Technical Skills You Won’t Learn Elsewhere

 

Our course teaches specialized skills that have nearly disappeared from modern climbing:

 

  • Knotted Protection Techniques - Learn to create and place monkey fists (knotted ropes of varying thickness) and UFOs (specialized webbing chocks)

  • Delicate Footwork - Master the precise movement required on fragile sandstone, where the rock “has the consistency of compressed sugar”

  • Mental Fortitude - Develop the psychological strength needed for climbing with minimal protection and occasional long runouts

  • Traditional Summiting - Experience the unique joy of topping out on freestanding towers, a practice often missing from modern sport climbing

 

Learn From Those Who Live the Tradition

 

Our instructors aren’t just guides—they’re keepers of a climbing heritage. They understand both the technical aspects and the philosophical underpinnings of Czech sandstone climbing. They’ll share stories of legendary first ascents, explain the historical context of the climbing ethics, and help you navigate the complex cultural aspects of climbing in this region.

 

More Than Just a Climbing Trip

 

Joining our Tower Craft course offers benefits beyond the climbing itself:

 

  • Cultural Immersion - Experience authentic Czech cuisine, local traditions, and the unique climbing culture of the region

  • Historical Connection - Climb in the birthplace of free climbing in continental Europe, where techniques developed over a century ago still influence modern climbing

  • Environmental Awareness - Learn climbing approaches that preserve fragile environments for future generations

  • Mental Challenge - Push yourself in ways that modern, well-protected climbing rarely demands

 

A Rare Opportunity in Modern Climbing

 

In today’s world of increasingly homogenized climbing experiences, Czech sandstone offers something genuinely different. As climbing areas worldwide adopt similar protection standards and styles, the Czech tradition stands apart—a reminder of climbing’s diverse heritage and the different paths its development has taken.

 

Adam Ondra, perhaps the world’s greatest climber, still honors these traditions when establishing new routes on Czech sandstone—all must be climbed ground-up, respecting the country’s century-old climbing ethics.

 

Join Us for an Unforgettable Adventure

 

The Tower Craft: Czech Sandstone Mastery course isn’t just another climbing trip—it’s a journey into climbing’s soul, a chance to connect with its history, and an opportunity to develop skills and perspectives that will enrich your climbing forever.

Whether you’re seeking to expand your technical repertoire, challenge yourself mentally, or simply experience one of climbing’s most unique traditions, our course offers an adventure that will transform how you think about climbing.

“The Czech sandstone experience transformed my climbing. There’s nothing quite like the feeling of summiting these towers using traditional methods that have remained unchanged for over a century.” – Previous Course Participant

 

Limited to just 4 participants per course—secure your spot today and become part of a tradition that has shaped climbing for over 100 years.

rows.body:
EXPERIENCE THE LEGENDARY CZECH SANDSTONE TOWERS

 

Duration: 6 Days
Location: Bohemian Switzerland & Adršpach-Teplice Rocks
Difficulty: Intermediate to Advanced
Group Size: Maximum 4 participants
Price: €1150 per person 

 

 

COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable adventure on the legendary sandstone towers of the Czech Republic. This specialized course introduces climbers to the unique ethics, techniques, and traditions of Czech sandstone climbing – a distinctive style that has influenced generations of climbers worldwide.

 

Czech sandstone climbing represents one of the purest forms of traditional climbing, where metal protection is forbidden, and climbers rely on knotted slings, textile rings, and occasional fixed rings for protection. With routes dating back to the early 1900s, you’ll be participating in a climbing tradition with deep historical roots.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL LEARN

 

  • Specialized Protection Techniques: Master the art of placing knotted slings and textile protection

  • Delicate Footwork: Develop precise movement on the fragile, sometimes crumbly sandstone

  • Route Finding: Navigate complex tower systems with minimal marking

  • Traditional Ethics: Understand and practice the strict local climbing code

  • Tower Summiting: Experience the unique joy of topping out on freestanding sandstone spires

  • Rope Management: Learn efficient systems for the unique multi-pitch environment

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE

 

Day 1: Introduction
Introduction to Czech sandstone ethics and history. Equipment check and basic techniques practice on smaller formations.

 

Day 2-5: Progressive Climbing
Daily excursions to different climbing areas with increasing difficulty. Morning technique workshops followed by guided climbs on selected routes.

 

Day 6: Challenge Day
Attempt a classic multi-pitch route on one of the iconic towers. Farewell dinner.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Experience: Minimum 1 year of outdoor climbing experience

  • Technical Ability: Confident leading trad routes at UIAA VI (5.10a)

  • Fitness Level: Good overall fitness for approaches and full days of climbing

  • Equipment: Standard trad rack plus specialized equipment (rental available)

 

 

WHY CLIMB CZECH SANDSTONE WITH ROCKBUSTERS?

 

  • Expert Local Guides: All our instructors are certified with deep knowledge of local ethics and routes

  • Historical Immersion: Visit the birthplace of free climbing in continental Europe

  • Small Groups: Maximum 6 participants ensure personalized instruction

  • All-Inclusive: Accommodation, meals, transportation, and equipment rental included

  • Environmental Approach: Learn climbing techniques that preserve the fragile sandstone

 

 

 

“The Czech sandstone experience transformed my climbing. There’s nothing quite like the feeling of summiting these towers using traditional methods that have remained unchanged for over a century.” – Previous Course Participant

rows.body:
Yo, rock junkies! Ready to get your climb on? Join our badass sport climbing course and push your limits on Europe's TOP crags. We're talking finger-shredding action, top-notch coaching, and a chance to level up your skills like never before.

 

Our motto? CLIMB OR DIE. Okay, not literally, but you get the idea. We're all about MAXING OUT YOUR ROCK TIME. No boring lectures here - just pure, unadulterated climbing. You'll be scaling walls like a pro before you know it.

 

This ain't your grandma's climbing course. It's perfect for anyone looking to refresh their safety game, nail that leading technique, and become a total rock star. Trust us, you'll be itching to book your spot.

 

So what are you waiting for? Get ready to eat, sleep, and breathe climbing. Your fingers won't know what hit 'em!

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.

Whether you're looking to lead your first outdoor routes or push your climbing to new heights, our professional guides will help you climb better, harder, and more—all while enjoying the camaraderie of fellow rock enthusiasts in this UNESCO World Heritage setting.

 

Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 4:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.
rows.perex:
CONQUER THE VERTICAL PARADISE: DOLOMITES SPORT CLIMBING HOLIDAY

 

Scale the dramatic limestone peaks of the Italian Dolomites on our week-long Sport Climbing Holiday! Perfect your technique with expert coaching while conquering breathtaking routes in one of Europe's most spectacular mountain ranges. Whether you're looking to lead your first outdoor routes or push your climbing to new heights, our professional guides will help you climb better, harder, and more—all while enjoying the camaraderie of fellow rock enthusiasts in this UNESCO World Heritage setting.

 

Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (Cloned) (Cloned) (Cloned) (Cloned) (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 4:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.bodyMore:
5 Key Benefits of Joining Rockbusters' Winter Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio

 

Are you looking for the perfect winter climbing escape? Rockbusters' January 2026 Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio, Greece, offers an unbeatable combination of benefits that make it worth booking now. Here's why this event should be at the top of your climbing wish list:

 

1. Ideal Winter Climbing Conditions

 

While northern Europe shivers under winter's grip, Leonidio offers mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C) and abundant sunshine. The region's famous limestone dries quickly after rain, ensuring maximum climbing time even during the Mediterranean winter. This perfect weather window lets you climb comfortably when most European crags are too cold or wet.

 

2. World-Class Limestone Variety

 

Leonidio's vibrant red and orange limestone cliffs offer over 1,000 routes across multiple sectors, from gentle slabs to challenging overhangs. The course takes you to the area's best sectors like Twin Caves, Hot Rock, and Mars, where you'll experience diverse climbing styles including pockets, tufas, and crimps. Whatever your climbing preference or level, Leonidio delivers.

 

3. Expert Coaching to Elevate Your Skills

 

The true value of this course lies in the expert coaching from Rockbusters' international team, including world-renowned climber Klemen Bečan. Their "Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!" philosophy translates to personalized instruction that addresses your specific needs. With a small group size (maximum 8 climbers), you'll receive individualized attention to help break through plateaus and master new techniques.

 

4. Authentic Greek Cultural Experience

 

January offers the unique opportunity to experience Leonidio at its most authentic. Beyond the climbing, you'll immerse yourself in genuine Greek culture, cuisine, and hospitality away from the tourist crowds. The course includes welcome dinners, local recommendations, and rest-day cultural excursions that add a rich cultural dimension to your climbing trip.

 

5. Community and Connection

 

Perhaps the most unexpected benefit is the sense of community. Sharing this winter climbing adventure creates lasting connections with like-minded climbers from around the world. The course culminates in a celebration with the local climbing community, fostering international friendships that extend far beyond your week in Greece.

 

Don't miss this opportunity to transform your climbing while escaping winter's chill in one of Europe's most spectacular settings. Early booking is recommended as winter courses in Leonidio tend to fill quickly!

rows.bodyMore:
5 Key Benefits of Joining Rockbusters' Winter Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio

 

Are you looking for the perfect winter climbing escape? Rockbusters' January 2026 Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio, Greece, offers an unbeatable combination of benefits that make it worth booking now. Here's why this event should be at the top of your climbing wish list:

 

1. Ideal Winter Climbing Conditions

 

While northern Europe shivers under winter's grip, Leonidio offers mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C) and abundant sunshine. The region's famous limestone dries quickly after rain, ensuring maximum climbing time even during the Mediterranean winter. This perfect weather window lets you climb comfortably when most European crags are too cold or wet.

 

2. World-Class Limestone Variety

 

Leonidio's vibrant red and orange limestone cliffs offer over 1,000 routes across multiple sectors, from gentle slabs to challenging overhangs. The course takes you to the area's best sectors like Twin Caves, Hot Rock, and Mars, where you'll experience diverse climbing styles including pockets, tufas, and crimps. Whatever your climbing preference or level, Leonidio delivers.

 

3. Expert Coaching to Elevate Your Skills

 

The true value of this course lies in the expert coaching from Rockbusters' international team, including world-renowned climber Klemen Bečan. Their "Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!" philosophy translates to personalized instruction that addresses your specific needs. With a small group size (maximum 8 climbers), you'll receive individualized attention to help break through plateaus and master new techniques.

 

4. Authentic Greek Cultural Experience

 

January offers the unique opportunity to experience Leonidio at its most authentic. Beyond the climbing, you'll immerse yourself in genuine Greek culture, cuisine, and hospitality away from the tourist crowds. The course includes welcome dinners, local recommendations, and rest-day cultural excursions that add a rich cultural dimension to your climbing trip.

 

5. Community and Connection

 

Perhaps the most unexpected benefit is the sense of community. Sharing this winter climbing adventure creates lasting connections with like-minded climbers from around the world. The course culminates in a celebration with the local climbing community, fostering international friendships that extend far beyond your week in Greece.

 

Don't miss this opportunity to transform your climbing while escaping winter's chill in one of Europe's most spectacular settings. Early booking is recommended as winter courses in Leonidio tend to fill quickly!

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Istrian Easter Ascent (Cloned)
rows.body:
Experience Spring Climbing in the Mediterranean Paradise

 

Escape the ordinary this Easter and join Rockbusters for an unforgettable sport climbing adventure in the stunning limestone paradise of Istria, Croatia. With perfect spring temperatures, blooming landscapes, and routes for every ability level, our Easter climbing holiday offers the ideal combination of skill development, adventure, and relaxation.

 

WHY ISTRIA FOR EASTER?

 

Easter is the perfect time to visit Istria - the Mediterranean spring brings pleasant temperatures (16-22°C) ideal for climbing, with nature in full bloom creating a spectacular backdrop for your climbing experience. The limestone formations offer exceptional grip, and the holiday period means you can enjoy longer days on the rock without the summer crowds.

 

CLIMBING LOCATIONS

 

Our Easter holiday takes you to Istria’s premier climbing spots:

  • Rovinj - Charming coastal crags with routes ranging from 4a to 7c, offering stunning Adriatic Sea views
  • Limski Kanal - The impressive limestone fjord featuring both vertical and slightly overhanging walls with routes for all levels
  • Vela Draga - Hidden in Učka Nature Park, this secluded canyon offers unique formations and breathtaking views
  • Buzet - Technical limestone climbing with a range of difficulties in a picturesque inland setting

 

WHO IS THIS HOLIDAY FOR?

 

Our Easter climbing holiday is designed for:

 

  • Climbers looking to kick-start their outdoor season after winter
  • Those seeking to improve their technical skills and grade progression
  • Anyone wanting to explore new climbing destinations with expert guidance
  • Climbers of all levels, from motivated beginners (5a) to advanced (7c+)
  • Solo travelers, couples, or groups looking for a climbing-focused holiday

 

BEYOND THE ROCK

 

While climbing is our primary focus, Istria offers much more to enhance your Easter break:

 

  •     Traditional Easter celebrations in local villages
  •     Exploration of medieval hilltop towns
  •     Coastal walks along the crystal-clear Adriatic
  •     Sampling award-winning olive oils and truffles
  •     Local wine tasting experiences
  •     Rest day visits to historical sites like Pula’s Roman amphitheater


THE ROCKBUSTERS DIFFERENCE

 

At Rockbusters, we believe in maximum time on rock, pushing your limits, and 100% fun! Our experienced coaches are dedicated to helping you improve, reach your individual climbing goals, and pursue your climbing dreams in one of Europe’s most beautiful coastal regions.

 

Join us this Easter for an unforgettable climbing experience that combines skill development, exploration, and the joy of climbing in good company amidst Istria’s stunning landscapes.

 

“Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE with Rockbusters!”

 
 
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

Join us this Easter for an unforgettable climbing experience that combines skill development, exploration, and the joy of climbing in good company amidst Istria’s stunning landscapes.

 

“Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE with Rockbusters!”

 
 
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.perex:
EASTER SPORT CLIMBING HOLIDAY IN ISTRIA, CROATIA

Escape to sun-soaked limestone this Easter! Join Rockbusters in Croatia’s stunning Istria peninsula for the perfect spring climbing getaway. Enjoy perfect temperatures on world-class routes, expert coaching, and Mediterranean charm – all while others are still hunting eggs. Level up your climbing in paradise!
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: The Sharp End - Fear Management & Mental Coaching
rows.bodyMore:
The Climbing Area: Margalef

 

Margalef is one of the most famous sport climbing areas in Europe, known for its unique conglomerate rock and an incredible variety of routes.

 

The area offers:

 

• Hundreds of sport routes
• All styles of climbing
• Grades from beginner to elite
• Perfect terrain for practicing mental techniques on real routes

 

Margalef provides the perfect environment for working on confidence, commitment, and focus while climbing outdoors.

 

 

Course Format

 

The Sharp End course combines mental coaching with practical climbing sessions.

 

Each day includes a mix of:

 

• Climbing sessions on carefully selected routes
• Practical exercises to manage fear
• Falling practice and commitment drills
• Mental coaching discussions
• Individual feedback from the coaches

 

Participants apply the techniques immediately during climbing, which makes the learning process much more effective.

 

 

Typical Day

 

Morning
Briefing, goal setting, and mental preparation.

 

Daytime
Climbing sessions focused on applying mental techniques on real routes.

 

Afternoon
Coaching feedback, analysis of climbing situations, and discussion of mental strategies.

 

Evening
Optional discussion sessions and planning for the following day.

 

 

Coaches

 

Hugo Meir

Professional climbing coach and experienced guide specializing in performance coaching and mental training for climbers.

Hugo focuses on helping climbers unlock their potential through better movement, improved decision-making, and stronger mental skills.

 

 

Jany Novotny

Founder of Rockbusters and an experienced climbing coach with decades of climbing and coaching experience across Europe.

Jany has helped hundreds of climbers improve their performance through structured coaching and mental training.

 

 

What We Expect From You

 

Participants should:

 

• Have previous outdoor lead climbing experience
• Be comfortable climbing in the 6a–7c range
• Be motivated to work on their mental game
• Be open to practicing falling and commitment exercises
• Be respectful toward other participants and the climbing environment

 

A positive attitude and willingness to learn are essential.

 

 

Limitations

 

Climbing always involves inherent risks.

 

Participants must understand that:

 

• Outdoor climbing conditions may vary
• Weather may affect the climbing schedule
• Some exercises involve controlled falling practice
• Progress depends on individual engagement and motivation

 

Our coaches will always prioritize safety and responsible climbing practices.

 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

 

Do I need to be able to lead climb?

Yes. Participants must already have lead climbing experience.

 

Do I need my own climbing equipment?

Yes. Participants should bring their own personal climbing gear.

 

Is accommodation included?

Yes. We provide basic shared accommodation in Margalef. For private room, or higher standard please reach out

 

Can I join if I climb below 6a?

This course is designed for climbers who already climb around 6a or harder. 

 

 

Ready to Break Through Your Mental Barriers?

 

Fear is one of the biggest obstacles in climbing — but it can be trained and managed.

 

Join us in Margalef and learn how to climb with confidence, commitment, and control.

 

>> Reserve Your Spot <<

rows.body:
Rockbusters have joined forces with one of the world's best climbers Klemen Bečan to help you climb BETTER and HARDER. This camp is specially tailored for those searching for a big push to speed up their progress towards a better climbing technique, a more efficient mindset, and a harder grade. There is no better way to do so than in a group of motivated climbers sharing the same goals and being helped out by professional coaches and guides led by one of the best climbers in the world. Our team will make sure everybody gets what they need, not only through intensive one on one coaching on the crag but also through recording and analyzing your climbing performance.

 

Sport climbing performance & mental coaching takes place in Rodellar, one of the world's best sport climbing venues and Rockbusters' top destinations. Rodellar in Spain is a tufa-climbing paradise, a perfect destination for both chilled sport climbing holidays and for pushing your grade. During this two-week stretch, we welcome all motivated climbers searching to progress, from beginners to experts. With two guides/coaches, we are able to adjust our approach and coaching individually to your needs and will.

 

We decided to set up Klemen's coaching camp in Rodellar so that everybody (no matter the level) can push their climbing to another level. Rodellar mekka of sport climbing in Aragon, Spain. rows.eventText:
There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

Our course will offer you the opportunity to maximise your potential and develop your climbing skills at a very high pace. During the trip we will help you push your grade while teaching you how to maintain sustainable, long-term progress beyond our time together.

Klemen Becan’s coaching focuses on balance and movement, which will help both your physical and mental development as a climber. Whether you are a complete rookie or an experienced cranker, analyzing your movement patterns and attitude will instantaneously boost your skills and help you break through any plateau.

Whatever your level, with plenty of time to practice newly learned techniques, you will increase your confidence and perform better than ever. After just one week of coaching you to head home with a completely new, advanced skillset. The aim of our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop is to allow you to learn from the best and use their well tested techniques to progress your climbing.

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join our Klemen Becan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop:

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn to find balance and use the most efficient and effective ways to propel your body up the rock without wasting energy. You will learn how to work with friction, make delicate steps and calculated, technical moves.

Overhangs

You’ll develop and practise skills to help you handle climbing steeper rock faces. We will cover footwork and techniques such as drop knees, heel and toe hooks. A lot of time will be dedicated to the fine art of resting while climbing, as well as fighting “the pump”, both mentally and physically.

Onsight vs redpoint techniques

Climbing onsight and projecting more difficult lines differs both physically and mentally. Klemen Bečan will cover the most effective strategies for success while onsighting or working a route over many days. You will have plenty of time to practice these and internalise the new skills.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

Maximum 4 clients per instructor!

rows.bodyMore:
Camp Format


Each day combines:


Full days climbing at world-class sport climbing crags

 

  • Technique workshops and drills on the wall
  •  Video analysis and movement feedback
  •  Mental performance exercises
  •  Individual coaching and group discussions


The focus is on deep learning and real climbing progress.

 

Locations


Rodellar, Spain

One of Europe’s most iconic sport climbing areas with steep limestone caves and endurance routes. Perfect for improving power endurance and advanced movement.

 

Kyparissi, Greece

A spectacular seaside climbing destination with technical vertical and slightly overhanging limestone routes. Ideal for precision movement and technical climbing.

Both locations provide excellent rock quality, inspiring scenery, and great climbing communities.

 

 

ELEVATE YOUR CLIMBING: WHY THE PERFORMANCE LAB IS YOUR GAME-CHANGER

 

Are you a dedicated climber who's hit that frustrating plateau? The Performance Lab by Rockbusters offers a rare opportunity to transform your climbing under the expert guidance of professional climber Klemen Becan and visionary founder Jany Novotny. Here's why this event is worth your time and investment:


EXPERT-LEVEL COACHING ACCELERATES PROGRESS

 

Working with Klemen Becan—who has conquered multiple 9a+ routes—gives you direct access to elite-level insights you simply can't get elsewhere. Rather than spending months or years figuring out technical issues through trial and error, you'll receive immediate feedback on subtle movement inefficiencies that are holding you back.

 

MENTAL TRAINING CREATES BREAKTHROUGH MOMENTS

 

The Performance Lab doesn't just focus on physical technique—it addresses the psychological barriers that often cause the biggest limitations. You'll develop structured approaches to manage fear, build confidence, and maintain focus during crucial climbing moments. These mental skills transfer beyond climbing into all aspects of life.

 

PERSONALIZED ANALYSIS REVEALS HIDDEN POTENTIAL

 

Unlike generic training programs, The Performance Lab provides an individualized assessment of your unique climbing style. Jany and Klemen will identify your specific energy leaks, movement patterns, and mental blocks, then create tailored solutions that work specifically for your body type and climbing approach.

 

COMMUNITY OF LIKE-MINDED CLIMBERS

 

You'll join a select group of motivated climbers facing similar challenges, creating an environment of shared learning and mutual support. This community aspect accelerates growth as you witness breakthroughs and share insights with peers who understand your journey.

Don't just train harder—train smarter. The Performance Lab offers the technical refinement, mental fortitude training, and personalized coaching that transform frustrating plateaus into exciting breakthroughs. Your next grade is waiting!
