rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Designed for women who are ready to stop being "the passenger" and start leading with confidence, our camp combines world-class sport climbing with an unrivaled supportive environment. Under the guidance of our elite coaching team, you’ll dive deep into movement efficiency, learning to utilize flexibility and balance to outsmart the rock rather than out-muscle it. Surrounded by a motivated community of like-minded women, you’ll find the perfect balance of high-performance training and infectious sisterhood.

Why Join Rockbusters' Women-Only Sport Climbing Course: Empowerment on the Rock

 

Looking to push your climbing skills in a supportive environment? Rockbusters' Women-Only Sport Climbing Course offers a unique opportunity to develop your abilities while surrounded by like-minded female climbers. Located in Cuenca, Spain—one of Europe's premier sport climbing destinations with over 1,000 routes—this course delivers both technical excellence and personal growth.

 

The course is specifically designed to address women's unique strengths and approaches to climbing. Rather than focusing solely on raw power, you'll learn how precise footwork, increased flexibility, and mental control can dramatically improve your climbing technique. Professional female guides create a comfortable, safe, and encouraging space where you can tackle challenges without judgment.

 

During six full days of intensive climbing, you'll receive personalized coaching tailored to your skill level, allowing you to progress at your own pace while consistently pushing your boundaries. The comprehensive technical instruction covers everything from equipment selection and proper belaying to advanced climbing techniques like side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, and heel hooking.

 

Perhaps most importantly, the women-only environment fosters a special community atmosphere. As previous participants have noted, the connections made extend beyond the course, creating lasting friendships and climbing partnerships. Many climbers report significant improvements in their abilities—some even jumping an entire grade with each course they take.

 

With upcoming courses scheduled in October and November 2025 in Cuenca,rockbusters.net this is your chance to experience climbing growth in a uniquely supportive setting. Join Rockbusters to climb better, harder, and more—all while surrounded by a community of women who share your passion.

The ultimate vertical adventure across Spain's most legendary limestone playgrounds. The Rockbusters 4-week Sport Climbing Road Trip takes you on an epic journey from the sun-drenched walls of Sella to the dramatic columns of Chulilla, before conquering the technical faces of Siurana and the powerful pockets of Margalef. Whether you're looking to break into your next grade or simply immerse yourself in Spain's rich climbing culture, our expert coaches will personalize your experience, transforming your technique, mental game, and confidence on the rock. This isn't just a climbing trip—it's a full transformation of how you approach the vertical world.

 

Join our tight-knit climbing community for an unforgettable month of sending projects, sharing beta, and creating memories that extend far beyond the crag. By day, you'll tackle world-class routes perfectly matched to your ability level, with personalized coaching to help you crush your climbing goals. By night, unwind in authentic Spanish climbing cottages, sharing stories and tapas with fellow climbers who share your passion. With flexible options to join for a single week or the entire month-long adventure, this road trip offers the perfect blend of serious skill development and pure climbing joy. Come experience why Spain remains the ultimate pilgrimage for sport climbers worldwide—where perfect limestone, ideal weather, and the Rockbusters approach combine to create your most productive and memorable climbing experience yet.

The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' 4-Week Spanish Climbing Adventure

 

Joining Rockbusters' 4-week sport climbing road trip across Spain offers climbers a transformative experience that goes far beyond ordinary climbing vacations. The journey through Spain's premier climbing destinations—Sella, Chulilla, Siurana, and Margalef—provides unparalleled access to diverse limestone routes perfectly suited to challenge and develop your skills.

 

The personalized coaching is perhaps the most valuable aspect of the trip, with expert guides helping you climb "BETTER, HARDER & MORE" through individualized instruction tailored to your specific needs. Many participants report dramatic improvements, with some advancing from feeling intimidated on 6a routes to confidently tackling 7a climbs within just weeks.

 

The trip's flexible format allows you to join for a single week or the entire month-long adventure, making it accessible regardless of your schedule constraints. Beyond technical skills, you'll gain invaluable mental training—overcoming fear of falling, building endurance for longer routes, and developing strategies for resting effectively during climbs.

 

Perhaps most uniquely, Rockbusters offers an authentic community experience rather than a typical commercial climbing package. The relaxed, organic approach creates deep connections among participants, with many returning for multiple trips. This supportive environment accelerates your progression while creating lasting friendships with fellow climbers who share your passion.

rows.title: SPORT CLIMBING ROCK TRIP in Spain / Sella (Cloned)
rows.body:
Welcome to Week 1 of your Rockbusters adventure, where your Spanish climbing odyssey begins in the sun-drenched limestone paradise of Sella. Nestled at the foot of the impressive Sella Penya (1,100m) in the heart of Costa Blanca, this charming Mediterranean village provides the perfect basecamp to ease into your month-long climbing transformation. Here, steep limestone cliffs rise dramatically above narrow village streets, offering an incredible diversity of routes across all difficulty levels. From the technical face climbing of Pared de Rosalia to the challenging overhangs at Techo del Rino, Sella's exceptional rock quality and generous pocketing will allow you to build fundamental skills while adapting to the unique Spanish limestone that will become your vertical playground for the coming month.

 

As you settle into the rhythm of climbing days and relaxed evenings in this authentic Spanish village of just 650 inhabitants, you'll discover why Costa Blanca has earned its reputation as one of Europe's premier winter climbing destinations. Your Rockbusters coaches will guide you through Sella's most iconic sectors, carefully selecting routes that match your current ability while gently pushing your boundaries. The perfect Mediterranean climate, with comfortable climbing temperatures even in winter, combined with short approaches to the crags, makes Sella the ideal location to build your technical foundation, establish climbing partnerships with fellow travelers, and prepare your body and mind for the increasingly challenging venues awaiting you in the weeks ahead.

 

Trip Highlights:

  • Sample the best sport climbing spots in Spain: Sella, Chulilla, Margalef, and Siurana
  • Flexible duration: Choose 1 week to 1 month, or join the whole trip
  • Improve your climbing performance, technique & mental game
  • Climb the best routes in your grade with expert guidance
  • Experience an awesome climbing community and vibe

  • Climbers with previous outdoor sport climbing experience
  • Min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, 15 years and up
  • Physical intensity: medium/high

 

What You'll Get:

  • Expert knowledge of the area's best routes and crags
  • Personalized coaching to help you climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
  • Flexible itinerary to suit your preferences and skill level
  • Unforgettable memories and new climbing buddies

 

Whether you're looking to level up your climbing game or just crush some world-class routes, our SPORT CLIMBING ROCK TRIP in SPAIN is your ticket to an unforgettable vertical adventure. Don't miss out on this chance to push your limits and experience the best of Spanish sport climbing!

  • Week 1: 21.02.2026 - 28.02.2026 / Sella, Spain

All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit, such as:

  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes
  • Lead climbing techniques
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

Joining Rockbusters' 4-week sport climbing road trip across Spain offers climbers a transformative experience that goes far beyond ordinary climbing vacations. The journey through Spain's premier climbing destinations—Sella, Chulilla, Siurana, and Margalef—provides unparalleled access to diverse limestone routes perfectly suited to challenge and develop your skills.

 

The personalized coaching is perhaps the most valuable aspect of the trip, with expert guides helping you climb "BETTER, HARDER & MORE" through individualized instruction tailored to your specific needs. Many participants report dramatic improvements, with some advancing from feeling intimidated on 6a routes to confidently tackling 7a climbs within just weeks.

The relaxed, organic approach creates deep connections among participants, with many returning for multiple trips. This supportive environment accelerates your progression while creating lasting friendships with fellow climbers who share your passion.

Welcome to Week 2 of your Rockbusters expedition, where your climbing journey advances to the spectacular limestone canyon of Chulilla. After building your foundation in Sella, you'll now immerse yourself in this dramatic river gorge north of Valencia, home to some of Spain's most picturesque and distinctive climbing. Chulilla's towering walls rise majestically above the crystalline waters of the Turia River, offering over 900 routes characterized by their impressive length, technical vertical faces, and subtle tufa formations. The climbing here represents a perfect progression from Week 1, while Sella introduced you to Spanish limestone, Chulilla challenges you with longer endurance routes on slightly overhanging walls that demand refined technique, strategic resting, and mental stamina as you climb up to 40 meters on a single pitch.

 

As you settle into the charming medieval village of Chulilla, with its narrow cobblestone streets winding beneath a 13th-century castle, you'll experience the authentic rhythm of rural Spanish life while pushing your climbing to new heights. Your Rockbusters coaches will guide you through iconic sectors like El Balcón, La Muela, and El Oasis, helping you apply the technical skills from Week 1 to these more sustained challenges. The increased route length at Chulilla naturally builds your endurance and forces efficient movement, crucial skills for the weeks ahead. Evening analysis sessions in local cafés will deepen your understanding of movement efficiency and energy conservation, while rest days offer opportunities to explore thermal springs, hiking trails through the gorge, or simply soak in the tranquil atmosphere of this climbing paradise that perfectly balances challenge with inspiration.

rows.title: SPORT CLIMBING ROCK TRIP in Spain / Siurana (Cloned)
rows.body:
Week 3 of your Rockbusters odyssey transports you to the hallowed grounds of Siurana, a legendary climbing destination perched atop a dramatic limestone ridge in Catalonia. After building endurance in Chulilla, you're now ready to tackle the technical masterpieces that have made Siurana a pilgrimage site for sport climbers worldwide. The compact, feature-rich limestone here demands precision footwork, subtle body positioning, and creative problem-solving on routes characterized by crimpy faces, technical corners, and delicate sequences. Nestled around a perfectly preserved medieval village with cobblestone streets and commanding views across the Priorat wine region, Siurana offers an intoxicating blend of climbing history, technical challenge, and cultural richness that epitomizes the Spanish climbing experience.

 

As you settle into the rhythm of Siurana's unique climbing style, your Rockbusters coaches will guide you through iconic sectors like L'Olla, El Pati, and La Siuranella, carefully selecting routes that build upon your growing technical repertoire while introducing new movement patterns that will transform your climbing efficiency. The compact nature of Siurana's rock rewards thoughtful climbing over brute strength, making this the perfect venue to refine your technique regardless of the grade you're pushing. Between climbing sessions, you'll savor locally produced olive oil and wines in the village's stone-walled cafés, discuss beta with international climbers drawn to these storied walls, and perhaps witness elite athletes working projects that have defined generations of sport climbing—all while your climbing continues its steady transformation under the skilled guidance of your coaches and the magical influence of Siurana's perfect limestone.

 

Trip Highlights:

  • Sample the best sport climbing spots in Spain: Sella, Chulilla, Margalef, and Siurana
  • Flexible duration: Choose 1 week to 1 month, or join the whole trip
  • Improve your climbing performance, technique & mental game
  • Climb the best routes in your grade with expert guidance
  • Experience an awesome climbing community and vibe

  • Flexible itinerary to suit your preferences and skill level
  • Unforgettable memories and new climbing buddies

 

Whether you're looking to level up your climbing game or just crush some world-class routes, our SPORT CLIMBING ROCK TRIP in SPAIN is your ticket to an unforgettable vertical adventure. Don't miss out on this chance to push your limits and experience the best of Spanish sport climbing!

WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Your Rockbusters journey culminates in Week 4 at the pocket-riddled paradise of Margalef, where three weeks of technical progression prepare you to embrace the unique physical challenges of this conglomerate wonderland. Nestled in a serene valley carved by the Montsant River, Margalef presents a striking contrast to previous destinations with its distinctive orange and gray walls punctuated by thousands of pockets of every imaginable size and depth. The climbing here demands creative thinking, exceptional finger strength, and the confidence to commit to powerful movements between sometimes dubious holds. With over 1,600 routes spread across dozens of sectors ranging from gently overhanging to wildly steep caves, Margalef offers the perfect finale to test your transformed climbing abilities, regardless of the grade you're pushing.

 

As you settle into the rhythm of life in this tiny Catalonian village, your coaches will guide you through legendary sectors like Laboratori, Tenebres, and Espadelles, where you'll apply all the skills developed over the previous weeks while adapting to Margalef's unique style. The physical nature of the climbing here rewards the endurance built in Chulilla and the technical precision honed in Siurana, creating the perfect synthesis of your month-long progression. Between climbing sessions, you'll recharge in the tranquil atmosphere of this remote climbing hamlet, sharing tapas and stories with fellow athletes at the climber-owned Refugi, perhaps glimpsing world-class climbers working projects on the same walls where you're experiencing your breakthroughs. As your four-week Rockbusters adventure concludes in this pocket paradise, you'll return home not just with significantly improved climbing abilities but with unforgettable experiences and connections that will continue to inspire your vertical pursuits for years to come.

rows.body:
Experience Greece’s Premier Winter Climbing Destination with Expert Guides

 

Dates: January 17-24, 2026 | All Skill Levels Welcome | Limited Spots Available

 

Escape to the Mediterranean Climbing Paradise

 

Discover why Leonidio has quickly become one of Europe’s most sought-after winter climbing destinations. While northern Europe shivers, you’ll be scaling sun-drenched limestone cliffs overlooking the sparkling Myrtoan Sea. This hidden gem in the Peloponnese combines world-class climbing with authentic Greek culture for an unforgettable winter climbing retreat.

Our 7-day sport climbing course offers the perfect blend of technical instruction, guided climbing, and cultural immersion in one of Greece’s most spectacular climbing regions.

 

Why Choose Leonidio in January?

 

✅ Perfect Winter Climbing Conditions: Enjoy mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C/57-64°F) and abundant sunshine - ideal for tackling Leonidio’s legendary limestone

✅ Crowd-Free Experience: Beat the spring rush and enjoy uncrowded crags and peaceful climbs

✅ Spectacular Mediterranean Setting: Climb against a backdrop of azure waters and dramatic mountain landscapes

✅ Over 1,000 Routes: Access a diverse range of climbing styles and difficulties on Leonidio’s pristine limestone cliffs

✅ Authentic Greek Culture: Immerse yourself in local life, cuisine, and hospitality when the town is at its most authentic

 

Course Highlights: What You’ll Experience


Daily Guided Climbing at Premium Sectors

  • Twin Caves: Perfect for warming up with routes from 5a to 6c
  • Hot Rock: Home to the famous “Mamma Mia” (7b+) and numerous quality routes
  • Mars: Challenge yourself on more difficult terrain (up to 9a)
  • Plus: Secret local spots based on conditions and group preferences

 

Technical Skills Development

  • Movement techniques specialized for Mediterranean limestone and tufa formations
  • Mental training for pushing your grade and managing fear
  • Efficiency coaching to maximize endurance on longer routes
  • Strategy sessions for projecting routes at your limit

 

More Than Just Climbing

  • Welcome dinner featuring authentic Greek cuisine
  • Rest day excursion to nearby beaches and cultural sites
  • Evening technique workshops and video analysis
  • Final night celebration with the local climbing community

 

Is This Course Right For You?

This sport climbing course is thoughtfully designed to benefit climbers across experience levels:

  • Beginner Sport Climbers (5a-6a): Master fundamental techniques and gain confidence on real rock
  • Intermediate Climbers (6a-7a): Refine your movement efficiency and mental approach to break into harder grades
  • Advanced Climbers (7a+): Work with our coaches on specific projects and advanced techniques

All participants should have basic belay skills and some indoor or outdoor climbing experience.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
5 Key Benefits of Joining Rockbusters' Winter Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio

 

Are you looking for the perfect winter climbing escape? Rockbusters' January 2026 Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio, Greece, offers an unbeatable combination of benefits that make it worth booking now. Here's why this event should be at the top of your climbing wish list:

 

1. Ideal Winter Climbing Conditions

 

While northern Europe shivers under winter's grip, Leonidio offers mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C) and abundant sunshine. The region's famous limestone dries quickly after rain, ensuring maximum climbing time even during the Mediterranean winter. This perfect weather window lets you climb comfortably when most European crags are too cold or wet.

 

2. World-Class Limestone Variety

 

Leonidio's vibrant red and orange limestone cliffs offer over 1,000 routes across multiple sectors, from gentle slabs to challenging overhangs. The course takes you to the area's best sectors like Twin Caves, Hot Rock, and Mars, where you'll experience diverse climbing styles including pockets, tufas, and crimps. Whatever your climbing preference or level, Leonidio delivers.

 

3. Expert Coaching to Elevate Your Skills

 

The true value of this course lies in the expert coaching from Rockbusters' international team, including world-renowned climber Klemen Bečan. Their "Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!" philosophy translates to personalized instruction that addresses your specific needs. With a small group size (maximum 8 climbers), you'll receive individualized attention to help break through plateaus and master new techniques.

 

4. Authentic Greek Cultural Experience

 

January offers the unique opportunity to experience Leonidio at its most authentic. Beyond the climbing, you'll immerse yourself in genuine Greek culture, cuisine, and hospitality away from the tourist crowds. rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep, and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique, and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
5 Key Benefits of Joining Rockbusters' Winter Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio

 

Are you looking for the perfect winter climbing escape? Rockbusters' January 2026 Sport Climbing Course in Leonidio, Greece, offers an unbeatable combination of benefits that make it worth booking now. Here's why this event should be at the top of your climbing wish list:

 

1. Ideal Winter Climbing Conditions

 

While northern Europe shivers under winter's grip, Leonidio offers mild daytime temperatures (14-18°C) and abundant sunshine. The region's famous limestone dries quickly after rain, ensuring maximum climbing time even during the Mediterranean winter. This perfect weather window lets you climb comfortably when most European crags are too cold or wet.

 

2. World-Class Limestone Variety

 

Leonidio's vibrant red and orange limestone cliffs offer over 1,000 routes across multiple sectors, from gentle slabs to challenging overhangs. The course takes you to the area's best sectors like Twin Caves, Hot Rock, and Mars, where you'll experience diverse climbing styles including pockets, tufas, and crimps. Whatever your climbing preference or level, Leonidio delivers.

 

3. Expert Coaching to Elevate Your Skills

 

The true value of this course lies in the expert coaching from Rockbusters' international team, including world-renowned climber Klemen Bečan. Their "Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE!" philosophy translates to personalized instruction that addresses your specific needs. With a small group size (maximum 8 climbers), you'll receive individualized attention to help break through plateaus and master new techniques.

January offers the unique opportunity to experience Leonidio at its most authentic. Beyond the climbing, you'll immerse yourself in genuine Greek culture, cuisine, and hospitality away from the tourist crowds. 5. Community and Connection

 

Perhaps the most unexpected benefit is the sense of community. Sharing this winter climbing adventure creates lasting connections with like-minded climbers from around the world. The course culminates in a celebration with the local climbing community, fostering international friendships that extend far beyond your week in Greece.

 

Don't miss this opportunity to transform your climbing while escaping winter's chill in one of Europe's most spectacular settings. Early booking is recommended as winter courses in Leonidio tend to fill quickly!

rows.title: Tech & Mind – Climbing Performance Camp (2 weeks) (Cloned)
rows.body:
BOOK NOW, 950€

 

 

Why This Camp


Many climbers reach a point where strength alone is no longer enough to progress.


The Performance Lab is designed for climbers who want to break through performance plateaus by combining advanced technique coaching with mental performance training.


This is not just a climbing trip — it is a performance program where you analyze your climbing, identify weaknesses, and develop the skills needed to climb harder.


What makes this camp truly exceptional is the opportunity to train alongside one of Europe’s most respected climbers and coaches:


Climbing with Klemen Becan


Klemen Becan is known for his deep understanding of movement efficiency, route strategy, and high‑level climbing performance. His coaching blends analytical precision with real‑world climbing insight — helping climbers understand why certain techniques work, not just how to perform them.

 

 

What Makes The Performance Lab Unique


✔ Advanced technical coaching on real routes
✔ Mental performance training for climbers
✔ Individualized feedback and progression plans
✔ Video analysis and movement breakdown
✔ Tactical strategies for onsight and redpoint climbing


The goal is to help you understand how you climb and how to improve efficiently.

 

 

 

What You Will Learn


During the week, or two you will work on:


• Movement efficiency and advanced technique
• Route reading and sequencing strategies
• Redpoint tactics and projecting strategies
• Managing fear, pressure, and mental fatigue
• Energy management and climbing economy


Each climber receives individual feedback tailored to their climbing style and goals.

 

 

Who This Camp Is For


Perfect for climbers who:


✔ Already lead climb regularly
✔ Want to break through a performance plateau
✔ Are motivated to train and improve
✔ Appreciate detailed coaching and technical analysis


Typical climbing level: Outdoor lead climbing around 6b – 8a

 

 

BOOK NOW, 950€
rows.eventText:
There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

This course is suitable for climbers who are confident leading around f6b level. From intermediate to advanced climbers, our experienced team will plan each day so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from the airport at a time to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about people's abilities, ambitions, and the week ahead.

Day 2 - Introduction to the local style of climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

Day 4 - Discussion and practice on redpointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing with their technique.

Day 5 - Refinement of newly learnt techniques, including video analysis. Finding and working onsight and redpoint projects.

Day 6 - Focus on achieving projects. Additional personal coaching from Klemen.

Day 7 - Consolidation of the week’s work. Finishing projects and locking in new skills. Finally, a farewell dinner and a party for those with any remaining energy!

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport and we say goodbye. Until next time!

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. We invite you to listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Climbing with Klemen Becan


Klemen Becan is known for his deep understanding of movement efficiency, route strategy, and high‑level climbing performance. His coaching blends analytical precision with real‑world climbing insight — helping climbers understand why certain techniques work, not just how to perform them.

✔ Advanced technical coaching on real routes

✔ Video analysis and movement breakdown
✔ Tactical strategies for onsight and redpoint climbing


The goal is to help you understand how you climb and how to improve efficiently.

During the week, or two you will work on:


• Movement efficiency and advanced technique
• Route reading and sequencing strategies

• Managing fear, pressure, and mental fatigue

Each climber receives individual feedback tailored to their climbing style and goals.

 

 

Who This Camp Is For


Perfect for climbers who:


✔ Already lead climb regularly

✔ Are motivated to train and improve
✔ Appreciate detailed coaching and technical analysis


Typical climbing level: Outdoor lead climbing around 6b – 8a

rows.eventText:
There is nothing like learning from the best which is why we have added Klemen Bečan to the Rockbusters coaching program. Well known for onsight climbing, new-routing and his ability to perform extremely technical moves, Klemen now climbs for enjoyment rather than achievement, but no long ago he was the first to realise some of the world’s most difficult sport routes, including Joe Mama (9a+/5.15a), as well as a great number of extremely hard bouldering lines.

Now Rockbusters can offer you the unique opportunity to benefit from Klemen’s knowledge, enthusiasm and attitude during our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop. Spaces are limited and we can invite only eight climbers to join the trip as this ensures that everybody receives enough one-to-one, personalised coaching from Klemen Bečan.

You will spend plenty of time on the rock, as well as listen to short, informal talks by Klemen. We will also film your climbing so that you can analyse the footage with Klemen in order to identify weaknesses and help you take your climbing to the next level.

The Klemen Bečan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop follows the traditional Rockbusters format of informal masterclasses. Led by Klemen as the head coach, our experienced team will ensure that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

--------------------

Our course will offer you the opportunity to maximise your potential and develop your climbing skills at a very high pace. During the trip we will help you push your grade while teaching you how to maintain sustainable, long-term progress beyond our time together.

Klemen Becan’s coaching focuses on balance and movement, which will help both your physical and mental development as a climber. Whether you are a complete rookie or an experienced cranker, analyzing your movement patterns and attitude will instantaneously boost your skills and help you break through any plateau.

Whatever your level, with plenty of time to practice newly learned techniques, you will increase your confidence and perform better than ever. After just one week of coaching you to head home with a completely new, advanced skillset. The aim of our Sport Climbing Performance Workshop is to allow you to learn from the best and use their well tested techniques to progress your climbing.

Here’s a little look at what to expect when you join our Klemen Becan Sport Climbing Performance Workshop:

Slab/vertical ground

Focusing on footwork, you will learn to find balance and use the most efficient and effective ways to propel your body up the rock without wasting energy. You will learn how to work with friction, make delicate steps and calculated, technical moves.

Overhangs

You’ll develop and practise skills to help you handle climbing steeper rock faces. We will cover footwork and techniques such as drop knees, heel and toe hooks. A lot of time will be dedicated to the fine art of resting while climbing, as well as fighting “the pump”, both mentally and physically.

Onsight vs redpoint techniques

Climbing onsight and projecting more difficult lines differs both physically and mentally. Klemen Bečan will cover the most effective strategies for success while onsighting or working a route over many days. You will have plenty of time to practice these and internalise the new skills.

As well as building confidence, strength and taking on some tough climbs, this is a Rockbusters course, so you can also expect a hefty dose of fun! We love what we do and that really comes across in all of our trips and programmes. And… we like to party almost as much as we like to climb, so get ready to have a blast on and off the rock. The informal, fun atmosphere of our courses is famous, but we never let this distract us from your climbing progression.

Maximum 4 clients per instructor!

Locations

One of Europe’s most iconic sport climbing areas with steep limestone caves and endurance routes. Perfect for improving power endurance and advanced movement.

A spectacular seaside climbing destination with technical vertical and slightly overhanging limestone routes. Ideal for precision movement and technical climbing.

Both locations provide excellent rock quality, inspiring scenery, and great climbing communities.

 

 

ELEVATE YOUR CLIMBING: WHY THE PERFORMANCE LAB IS YOUR GAME-CHANGER

 

Are you a dedicated climber who's hit that frustrating plateau? The Performance Lab by Rockbusters offers a rare opportunity to transform your climbing under the expert guidance of professional climber Klemen Becan and visionary founder Jany Novotny. Here's why this event is worth your time and investment:


EXPERT-LEVEL COACHING ACCELERATES PROGRESS

 

Working with Klemen Becan—who has conquered multiple 9a+ routes—gives you direct access to elite-level insights you simply can't get elsewhere. Rather than spending months or years figuring out technical issues through trial and error, you'll receive immediate feedback on subtle movement inefficiencies that are holding you back.

 

MENTAL TRAINING CREATES BREAKTHROUGH MOMENTS

 

The Performance Lab doesn't just focus on physical technique—it addresses the psychological barriers that often cause the biggest limitations. You'll develop structured approaches to manage fear, build confidence, and maintain focus during crucial climbing moments. These mental skills transfer beyond climbing into all aspects of life.

 

PERSONALIZED ANALYSIS REVEALS HIDDEN POTENTIAL

 

Unlike generic training programs, The Performance Lab provides an individualized assessment of your unique climbing style. Jany and Klemen will identify your specific energy leaks, movement patterns, and mental blocks, then create tailored solutions that work specifically for your body type and climbing approach.

 

COMMUNITY OF LIKE-MINDED CLIMBERS

 

You'll join a select group of motivated climbers facing similar challenges, creating an environment of shared learning and mutual support. This community aspect accelerates growth as you witness breakthroughs and share insights with peers who understand your journey.

Don't just train harder—train smarter. The Performance Lab offers the technical refinement, mental fortitude training, and personalized coaching that transform frustrating plateaus into exciting breakthroughs. Your next grade is waiting!

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our team.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

--------

Airport transport and transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).  

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

This course is suitable for climbers who are confident leading around f6b level. From intermediate to advanced climbers, our experienced team will plan each day so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from the airport at a time to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about people's abilities, ambitions, and the week ahead.

Day 2 - Introduction to the local style of climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading.

Day 3 - More climbing, now with more technical coaching. For the more advanced climbers, finding and working a redpoint project. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique.

Day 4 - Discussion and practice on redpointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing with their technique.

Day 5 - Refinement of newly learnt techniques, including video analysis. Finding and working onsight and redpoint projects.

Day 6 - Focus on achieving projects. Additional personal coaching from Klemen.

Day 7 - Consolidation of the week’s work. Finishing projects and locking in new skills. Finally, a farewell dinner and a party for those with any remaining energy!

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport and we say goodbye. Until next time!

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. We invite you to listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: A MUERTE: The Patxi Usobiaga Performance Camp (Cloned)
rows.body:
Stop plateauing. Start training like a champion.

 

What happens when you combine the most iconic limestone in Spain with the man who redefined the limits of human endurance? You get A MUERTE: The PUC Performance Camp. This isn't just a climbing course; it’s a systematic dismantling of your weaknesses led by the first person to ever onsight 8c+ and the mastermind behind Adam Ondra’s and Chris Sharma’s training.

 

Patxi Usobiaga doesn't believe in "trying." He believes in a methodical, relentless pursuit of the send. Throughout this intensive week, you will dive deep into the PUC Series method, mastering the cycles of Accumulation, Transformation, and Realization. From frame-by-frame video analysis of your movement to the psychological tactics of a World Champion, Patxi will rebuild your approach to the rock.

 

If you are ready to trade your excuses for a "Beast Mode" mindset and break through the 7a/8a barrier, your mission starts here.

 

Mission Highlights:

 

  • World Champion Coaching: 6 days of intensive 1-on-1 instruction from the first man to onsight 8c+.
  • The PUC Method: Exclusive access to Patxi’s systematic training cycles (Accumulation, Transformation, Realization).
  • Video Analysis Lab: Frame-by-frame breakdown of your movement, balance, and center of gravity.
  • Elite 7:1 Ratio: Small group settings ensuring personalized route selection for your specific weaknesses.
  • The Projecting Strategy: Learn how to "work" a route, find hidden beta, and manage the mental pressure of the send.

 

Detailed Technical Pillars:

 

  • PUC Movement Mechanics: Mastering advanced flags, drop-knees, and heel-hooks at your limit.
  • Mental Fortitude: Specific seminars on managing fear, frustration, and switching into "Beast Mode."
  • Projecting Logic: The tactical side of redpointing—clipping strategies, resting positions, and sequence linking.
  • Conditioning & Power: Training drills for explosiveness, resistance, and finger strength based on Patxi’s personal regimen.

 

Who This Mission Is For?

 

This is a high-intensity camp for those already established in the sport:

 

  • The Requirement: Minimum lead grade of 6c/7a.
  • The Mindset: You are stuck at a grade plateau and need a professional "diagnostic" of your climbing.
  • The Commitment: You are ready for high-volume, high-intensity days on the world-class limestone of Margalef or Oliana.

 

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.
rows.eventText:
For those who do not know, Patxi Usobiaga is Spanish pro climber who has as a first ever won two overall Lead Climbing World Cups in row. In 2009 he won the  Lead Climbing World Championships in Qinghai and is very well known as a master of unbelievably hard training methods. Patxi was the first climber ever to on-sight 8c+ and red-pointed various 9a and 9a+. Do you know anybody better to coach this Advance Sport Climbing Course?

 

To the pack of all the tricks and mental skills how to approach, project and climb hard routes above your limits, how to handle mental pressure, fears and stress, Patxi will also measure your pure strength, point out your strong point and weaknesses and suggest a plan for training with possibility to lead you through your progress in long term.

 

Of course as on any Rockbusters climbing trips and courses we bring our philosophy to "LEARN by DOING" so  you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters we think only practice makes you better so the goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

 
Sport climbing course highlights
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with Patxi professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed, min. RP grade 6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: high
 
 
Detailed technical specification of this climbing course
 
All necessary skills and knowledge to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • Analysis of your strength and weaknesses + basic training plan proposal
  • Choosing the right hard project and strategy for it
  • Working through the moves and getting the best beta
  • Linking the right sequences together
  • Art of mental preparation, handling the frustration, concentration, ...
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip first quickdraw
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side stepping, drop
  • knee, flagging, heel hooking, knee bars, ...)
  • Red point and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers
  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
rows.bodyMore:
Elevate Your Climbing: The Transformative Benefits of Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience

 

Are you stuck at a plateau in your climbing journey? Rockbusters' Advanced Sport Climbing Experience with Patxi Usobiaga might be exactly what you need to break through to the next level.

Training with Patxi Usobiaga — a World Champion and the first climber to onsight 8c+ — offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from one of the sport's greatest talents. What makes this experience exceptional isn't just Patxi's impressive resume, but his methodical approach to climbing improvement.

The program begins with a comprehensive assessment at Patxi's climbing gym in Coll de Nargo, where he analyzes your strengths and weaknesses. This personalized approach ensures that every participant receives tailored guidance, whether you need to improve power, endurance, technique, or mental focus.

Unlike basic climbing courses, this advanced experience is designed for climbers comfortable with at least 6c routes who are looking to push beyond their current limits. Participants receive individualized attention as Patxi carefully selects routes that challenge your specific weaknesses while building on their strengths.

Perhaps most valuable is the mental training aspect. As one participant noted, "Improving your mental game is low-hanging fruit" when physical gains become harder to achieve. This course helps you realize "that the impossible is possible, but only if you push yourself to your limits, and beyond."

The benefits extend beyond the week-long experience itself. Participants receive a free one-month training plan designed by Patxi, with options for long-term follow-up coaching. This continued support helps ensure that the progress made during the course translates into lasting improvement.

Beyond the technical benefits, participants consistently highlight the community aspect—spending a week climbing world-class routes with fellow enthusiasts from around the globe creates lasting connections and a supportive network of climbers with similar goals.

 

Patxi sport climbing & bouldering performance analysis


Climbing performance is defined by the combination of these three components: mental power, physical power, and technical skills. We will be discussing how big a part each component has in your climbing performance. For a performance climber, the goal is to approach mastery in all these areas to reach their potential. And it doesn’t matter if you are a sport climber, boulderer, or you aim for hard big wall climbs.

There is no one better qualified than Patxi Usobiaga to lead this course. Patxi, an ex-world champ and a “training monster”, says that his “talent is to be able to suffer”. He is one of the world’s best climbers and has coached pros like Chris Sharma, Adam Ondra, and Daniel Woods, to name just a few.

Pair up with Patxi for a week of climbing and training sessions, send some cool on-sights, flashes, or red points in his home destination of Oliana, and find out where your main limitation is and how to improve your overall climbing performance. Simply climb BETTER, HARDER, and MORE!

Mental power (fear, concentration, motivation, frustration, …)

Physical power (maximum power, resistance power, stamina, explosiveness, weaknesses vs strengths, …)

Technical skills (footwork, balance, proper use of techniques as sidestep, drop knee, flagging, resting, breathing, how to grip properly - crimp, open hand, pinch, …)

rows.eventText:
Is fear of falling or leading ruining your climbing experience? Is it holding back your performance? Do you want to take the challenge? Challenge your fear in this course!  Transform your climbing by training the mental muscle. This specialised rock climbing course goes beyond physical techniques to address the psychological barriers that often limit climbers of all levels.

 


In this course, we’ll teach you to recognise, understand, and channel it into focused performance. We will use evidence-based techniques drawn from (sports) psychology. The coaching will be conducted by a coach with in-depth personal experience in overcoming debilitating fear and how to work with it. You'll develop mental resilience that translates both on and off the wall.

 


What to expect from us?

 

  • Save the learning environment, both physical and psychological.
  • A balanced and personal approach to address your fear of falling.
  • The tools to train your mental muscle after this course.
  • Mental recovery strategies after falls or setbacks

 


What we expect from you!

 

  • An open mind to be able to discuss and explore fear and growth.
  • Being competent in lead climbing and belaying. 
  • Confidentiality of information from other participants 

 


What are the limitations?

 

  • Expect the first big step into a climbing life, where you train your mental muscle. Mental training IS training and takes more than just a week. Don’t expect to be Alex Honnold after this course.
  • We are not psychologists; if you have a (diagnosed) anxiety disorder, this course might not be for you. Discuss with your therapist and us if this course is right for you. 

 

What will you gain?

 

  • Tools to manage fear responses during crucial climbing moments
  • Confidence to push your grade while maintaining safety
  • Focus techniques to stay present during challenging sequences
  • Mental recovery strategies after falls or setbacks
  • Visualization practices to prepare for routes and problems

 

Whether you're a beginner struggling with height anxiety or an advanced climber hitting performance plateaus, this course provides personalized strategies to break through mental barriers. Our experienced coaches combine practical climbing scenarios with targeted mental exercises to create lasting change in your climbing psychology.


Conquer your mind, conquer the rock!
rows.bodyMore:
The Climbing Area: Margalef

 

Margalef is one of the most famous sport climbing areas in Europe, known for its unique conglomerate rock and an incredible variety of routes.

 

The area offers:

 

• Hundreds of sport routes
• All styles of climbing
• Grades from beginner to elite
• Perfect terrain for practicing mental techniques on real routes

 

Margalef provides the perfect environment for working on confidence, commitment, and focus while climbing outdoors.

 

 

Course Format

 

The Sharp End course combines mental coaching with practical climbing sessions.

 

Each day includes a mix of:

 

• Climbing sessions on carefully selected routes
• Practical exercises to manage fear
• Falling practice and commitment drills
• Mental coaching discussions
• Individual feedback from the coaches

 

Participants apply the techniques immediately during climbing, which makes the learning process much more effective.

 

 

Typical Day

 

Morning
Briefing, goal setting, and mental preparation.

 

Daytime
Climbing sessions focused on applying mental techniques on real routes.

 

Afternoon
Coaching feedback, analysis of climbing situations, and discussion of mental strategies.

 

Evening
Optional discussion sessions and planning for the following day.

 

 

Coaches

 

Hugo Meir

Professional climbing coach and experienced guide specializing in performance coaching and mental training for climbers.

Hugo focuses on helping climbers unlock their potential through better movement, improved decision-making, and stronger mental skills.

 

 

Jany Novotny

Founder of Rockbusters and an experienced climbing coach with decades of climbing and coaching experience across Europe.

Jany has helped hundreds of climbers improve their performance through structured coaching and mental training.

 

 

What We Expect From You

 

Participants should:

 

• Have previous outdoor lead climbing experience
• Be comfortable climbing in the 6a–7c range
• Be motivated to work on their mental game
• Be open to practicing falling and commitment exercises
• Be respectful toward other participants and the climbing environment

 

A positive attitude and willingness to learn are essential.

 

 

Limitations

 

Climbing always involves inherent risks.

 

Participants must understand that:

 

• Outdoor climbing conditions may vary
• Weather may affect the climbing schedule
• Some exercises involve controlled falling practice
• Progress depends on individual engagement and motivation

 

Our coaches will always prioritize safety and responsible climbing practices.

 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

 

Do I need to be able to lead climb?

Yes. Participants must already have lead climbing experience.

 

Do I need my own climbing equipment?

Yes. Participants should bring their own personal climbing gear.

 

Is accommodation included?

Yes. We provide basic shared accommodation in Margalef. For private room, or higher standard please reach out

 

Can I join if I climb below 6a?

This course is designed for climbers who already climb around 6a or harder. 

 

 

Ready to Break Through Your Mental Barriers?

 

Fear is one of the biggest obstacles in climbing — but it can be trained and managed.

 

Join us in Margalef and learn how to climb with confidence, commitment, and control.

 

>> Reserve Your Spot <<

rows.title: Women-Only Sport Climbing Course (Cloned)
rows.body:
Level up your climbing game with this intensive 1-week sport climbing course designed exclusively for women. Whether you're looking to push your limits or refine your technique, this course is your ticket to climbing harder, better, and more.

 

  • Boost Your Performance: Improve your climbing technique, mental game, and overall performance
  • Women-Focused Environment: Learn and grow in a supportive, women-only setting
  • Intensive Training: Pack a month's worth of progress into one action-packed week
  • Grade-Appropriate Challenges: Tackle the best routes in your grade, perfect for climbers leading outdoor f6a (US 5.10) and up
  • Expert Guidance: Benefit from professional coaching tailored to your skill level
  • Vibrant Community: Connect with like-minded women climbers and build lasting friendships

 

This course is your fast track to becoming the climber you've always wanted to be. With a perfect blend of intensive training, personalized coaching, and an awesome climbing community, you'll leave with enhanced skills, newfound confidence, and a passion to keep pushing your limits. Don't just climb – conquer with the Woman Only Sport Climbing Course!

 

Climbing course highlights:

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing.
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a female professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 

Physical & technical requirements:

 

  • Previous indoor/outdoor climbing experience is needed, with minimal grade leading f5/ f6a  (US 5.9/5.10)
  • Suitable ONLY for women or girls from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high 

 

Detailed technical specifications of the climbing course:

 

  • Choosing the right necessary equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes
  • Lead climbing techniques (efficient clipping, cleaning anchors, …)
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Why Join Rockbusters' Women-Only Sport Climbing Course: Empowerment on the Rock

 

Looking to push your climbing skills in a supportive environment? Rockbusters' Women-Only Sport Climbing Course offers a unique opportunity to develop your abilities while surrounded by like-minded female climbers. Located in Cuenca, Spain—one of Europe's premier sport climbing destinations with over 1,000 routes—this course delivers both technical excellence and personal growth.

 

The course is specifically designed to address women's unique strengths and approaches to climbing. Rather than focusing solely on raw power, you'll learn how precise footwork, increased flexibility, and mental control can dramatically improve your climbing technique. Professional female guides create a comfortable, safe, and encouraging space where you can tackle challenges without judgment.

 

During six full days of intensive climbing, you'll receive personalized coaching tailored to your skill level, allowing you to progress at your own pace while consistently pushing your boundaries. The comprehensive technical instruction covers everything from equipment selection and proper belaying to advanced climbing techniques like side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, and heel hooking.

 

Perhaps most importantly, the women-only environment fosters a special community atmosphere. As previous participants have noted, the connections made extend beyond the course, creating lasting friendships and climbing partnerships. Many climbers report significant improvements in their abilities—some even jumping an entire grade with each course they take.

 

With upcoming courses scheduled in October and November 2025 in Cuenca,rockbusters.net this is your chance to experience climbing growth in a uniquely supportive setting. Join Rockbusters to climb better, harder, and more—all while surrounded by a community of women who share your passion.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

As much coaching and guiding as you want and need, from our all female team.
All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.
--------
Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).
--------
Airport transport and transport between crags will be organized with rental cars (FREE CHARGE).  

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are organized in local restaurants/bars on request at a cost more or less 15€ each. 

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Suitable for people with some CLIMBING EXPERIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at a time suitable to the group as a whole. Welcome dinner and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing on the amazing limestone tufas of Rodellar. Getting a taste for the rock on some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belaying, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with ambitious goals.

Day 3 - More climbing and top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced climbers learn good lead belaying and dynamic falls control.

Day 5 - Time to throw some technical coaching into the mix. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice of red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidating our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. Maybe meet the boys?

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound, and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.body:
ROCK & ROAD: The Ultimate European Sport Climbing Adventure


Embark on the climbing journey of a lifetime with Rockbusters' ROCK & ROAD European Tour – where the send is just the beginning. This nomadic climbing adventure takes you on a meticulously crafted circuit of Europe's most spectacular limestone crags, from the pocket-riddled walls of Frankenjura to the sun-drenched faces of Rodellar. Wake up to fresh coffee with your crew, crush world-class routes all day with pro coaching at your back, and fall asleep under European skies dreaming of tomorrow's sends. This isn't just about ticking routes – it's about embracing the full climbing lifestyle while following perfect conditions across the continent.


Experience the authentic van-life vibe as you journey through diverse climbing landscapes, mastering different rock types and techniques along the way. Our expert guides don't just show you the classics – they transform your climbing through personalized coaching tailored to elevate your performance on every type of terrain Europe has to offer. With local knowledge opening doors to both hidden gems and iconic test-pieces, you'll climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE than you ever thought possible.

 


Course Highlights:

 

 

  • Hand-picked circuit of Europe's finest sport crags with 12,000+ routes
  • Six full days of intensive climbing at each location with professional guides
  • Personalized performance coaching, adapting to each destination's unique style
  • Authentic community experience with like-minded climbers
  • Maximum climbing time with minimal logistical hassles
  • Follow optimal conditions across the continent for perfect sending weather
  • Local knowledge accessing both classic routes and hidden gems

 


This Trip Is Perfect For:

 

 

  • Sport climbers who can lead 6b (5.10c) indoor or 6a (5.10a) outdoor, who want to level up
  • Adventure seekers looking to combine world-class climbing with European travel
  • Climbers eager to develop a well-rounded skill set across diverse rock types
  • Those seeking a community-focused experience rather than a solo climbing trip
  • Anyone looking to transform both their climbing abilities and mental approach
  • Climbers who value quality routes, authentic experiences, and expert guidance
  • Those ready to embrace the nomadic climbing lifestyle and make lifelong connections

 


Detailed technical specifications of Rockbusters' coaching

 

All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do single pitch sport climbs and to attack routes on or beyond your limit, such as:

 

  • Choosing the right equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying  lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques such as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)

rows.eventText:
Climbing Eurotrip is Rockbusters favourite time of the year. How could it not be? We’re driving across the continent, stopping at all of the most iconic crags and any other you want to visit. You can focus on climbing as much as possible, while experiencing the freedom of the ultimate climbing road trip. We love it and our guests love it, so we do it year after year!

The nature of the Climbing Eurotrip allows you to dip in and out of it as you wish. You can join us for the whole duration (8 weeks) or join us for your favourite locations. The atmosphere of the Rockbusters Eurotrip is legendary. Everyone quickly becomes a part of the Rockbusters family. After weeks on the road, it’s always hard to say goodbye and you’re likely to come back for more next year!

We’ll introduce you to many of Europe’s best climbing locations, like the Frankenjura, Margalef or Ceuse.

You will experience sport climbing at its best, receive expert coaching and guidance, as well as have the most fun you ever have while rock climbing!

Join us for the whole duration of the trip or just choose the destinations or dates that work for you.ome along for as long or short as you want - we’ll even pick you up from the airport.

Our performance coaching is ongoing throughout the tour. Below are the examples of topics covered:

  • Choosing the most suitable climbing gear for your needs and how to use it safely

  • Belaying, lead belaying, setting up top-ropes and lead climbing in the way that’s most conducive to learning new rock climbing skills

  • Standard climbing calls and best communication practice to ensure safety wherever you go

  • Using guidebooks so that you can become a confident, independent climber

  • Understanding of objective outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day

  • Cleaning the anchors and routes so you can retrieve all your gear safely

  • Movement skills (technique) for more efficient climbing

  • Footwork on slabs and vertical faces, using balance and correct feet placements to maximise your efficiency on the rock (for climbers leading f5 or harder)

  • Steep climbing techniques (overhangs), resting and saving energy (for climbers leading f6c or harder)

 

The trip is suitable for climbers of all levels as our experienced team of instructors and guides will plan the itinerary to suit the needs of the whole group. Everybody gets to climb as much as they can, receiving as much coaching as they need.

Our main focus is having long, epic climbing days (without having an epic!). You can tackle many routes each day and spend plenty of time on the rock.  

SCHEDULE OF DESTINATIONS:  

Week 1 - Labské Údolí / Czech Republic

Week 2 - Frankenjura / Germany

Week 3 - Zillertal / Austria

Week 4 - Finale Ligure / Italy

Week 5 - Céüse / France

Week 6 - Georges du Tarn / France

Week 7 - Margalef / Spain

Week 8 - Rodellar / Spain
rows.bodyMore:
Benefits of the Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip

 

Have you ever dreamed of spending two months climbing the most spectacular routes across Europe? The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip offers exactly that—an 8-week journey through the continent’s premier climbing destinations. But this adventure delivers far more than just world-class climbing. Here’s why joining this extraordinary trip could be one of the best decisions for both your climbing career and personal growth.
 

 

Physical Transformation Through Diverse Climbing Environments

 

The Rockbusters trip takes you through eight distinct climbing regions, each offering unique physical challenges. From the sandstone towers of Labské Údoli in the Czech Republic to the Mediterranean limestone of Finale Ligure in Italy, your body adapts to different rock types and climbing styles.

 

Research shows that extended climbing experiences like this provide remarkable physical benefits. The varied terrain ensures full-body muscle engagement, with each location challenging different muscle groups. Your cardiovascular system strengthens as you tackle the 8,000+ bolted routes of Frankenjura, Germany, while your flexibility improves while navigating the technical moves required on the high-quality limestone of Ceüse, France.

 

Unlike gym training that can become repetitive, this trip’s constantly changing environments keep your body guessing and adapting, resulting in more balanced physical development and effective weight management through sustained activity.

 

Mental Growth Backed by Science

 

The mental benefits of this climbing journey are equally impressive—and scientifically proven. Recent studies demonstrate that climbers experience significant reductions in anxiety, with measurable decreases in both Separation Anxiety Disorder and Generalized Anxiety Disorder.

 

Each climbing destination presents new puzzles to solve. The conglomerate rock of Margalef, Spain, demands different problem-solving approaches than the overhanging routes of Rodellar. This constant mental challenge enhances your focus, concentration, and decision-making abilities in ways that extend far beyond climbing.

 

As you progress through increasingly difficult routes across Europe, you’ll build mental resilience that transfers to everyday life challenges. Many climbers report that after extended climbing trips, they approach personal and professional obstacles with newfound confidence and clarity.

 


Skill Acceleration Through Varied Terrain

 

Eight weeks across Europe’s diverse climbing landscapes accelerate your technical development in ways that staying in one location simply cannot match. Each region specializes in different climbing styles:

 

  • Master traditional climbing techniques on Czech sandstone
  • Develop power and finger strength on Frankenjura’s pocketed limestone
  • Perfect your endurance on the long routes of the Gorges du Tarn, France
  • Learn efficient movement on the technical faces of Zillertal, Austria

 

This exposure to varied climbing styles forces rapid adaptation and prevents the development of technique gaps that often occur when climbing exclusively in one area. By the trip’s end, you’ll possess a well-rounded skill set that would take years to develop otherwise.

 

Cultural Immersion and Lasting Friendships

 

Beyond the climbing itself, the Rockbusters trip offers deep cultural immersion across multiple European countries. You’ll interact with local climbing communities, experience diverse traditions, and support sustainable tourism practices that benefit mountain regions.

 

The shared experience of traveling through Prague, Nuremberg, Munich, Milan, Barcelona, and other European cities creates bonds that often last a lifetime. Many past participants report that the friendships formed during these 8 weeks become their core climbing network for years afterward.

 

The program emphasizes respectful engagement with local communities, giving you authentic cultural experiences that typical tourists miss. From sampling regional cuisines to learning about the climbing history of each area, you’ll gain a richer understanding of Europe’s diverse climbing heritage.

 


Is the Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip Right for You?

 

If you can lead routes at 6a indoor grade or 5 outdoor grade, this trip offers an unparalleled opportunity to transform your climbing while experiencing the best of European culture. For 5500€, you receive 57 days of climbing across eight world-class destinations with accommodation included.

 

The physical strength, mental resilience, technical skills, cultural experiences, and friendships gained during these eight weeks create value that extends far beyond the price tag. Many climbers describe their European climbing trips as pivotal life experiences that fundamentally changed their approach to both climbing and personal challenges.

 

The Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip isn’t just a vacation—it’s an investment in yourself as both a climber and a person. The question isn’t whether you can afford to go, but whether you can afford to miss this life-changing opportunity.

 

The next Rockbusters Europe Rock Trip runs from August 16 to October 11, 2025. Spaces are limited to ensure quality experiences for all participants.
