rows.itineraryText:
We think you’ll agree that our itinerary is pretty spectacular. Here’s where the tour stops:

Labské údolí - Czech republic

The Elbe Mountains are without doubt one of the best sandstone areas in Europe, forming the border between the Czech Republic and Germany. The River Elbe carves its way through the soft sandstone creating steep sided gorges and crags that are begging to be climbed. It’s very challenging for technical sport climbing and generally considered suitable for climbers capable of leading 6a’s and harder. If you’ve got a bit of experience under your belt then this is a great place to improve your technique and mental control – becoming a Zen climbing master.

Fly via Prague, arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday. 

Frankenjura - Germany

One of the biggest and best climbing spots in Germany and probably Europe too. Located between Nuremberg, Bamberg and Bayreuth there are about 1,000 crags to explore in the area, which is enough to keep anyone busy. Most routes are short, powerful single pitch sport climbs on limestone with plenty of finger pockets. With around 10,000 routes, this is perfect for climbers of all levels. It’s also family-friendly and a top spot to start leading or to do your first outdoor climbs all backdropped by the beautiful forests of Bavaria. There’s accommodation to suit most needs and budgets in campsites or guesthouses.

Fly via Nürnberg, Germany: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.  

Zillertal - Austria

The undisputed best granite climbing spot in the Tirol, bar none. There are around 700 routes to climb, seven via ferratas, climbing gardens and lots of pitch tours. With so many options you can climb here until your fingers bleed (hopefully not of course!). We usually say that some outdoor climbing experience and leading may be relevant but not essential, and there are plenty of routes for all abilities. We love this stop on the tour and think you will too. Accommodation is in a local campsite.

Fly to München, Germany. Fly from Milano, Italy: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Monday to Friday.  

Finale Ligure - Italy

With the Czech Republic, Germany and Austria done, Italy is the next logical stop. And what a stop it is. The climbing at Finale Ligure is stunning. With around 2,700 routes to choose on white limestone rocks in an area of about 10 square kilometres, this is one of the best climbing areas in Italy. The deep green landscape can be harsh and wild, and it’s not your usual climbing area, but then again, this is not your usual climbing tour either. It’s the perfect place for experienced climbers to go hard and beginners to bag their first crags. The free camping area is a nice bonus too.

Fly to Milano, Italy. Fly from Torino, Italy: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Ceüse – France

The best sports climbing crag in France and maybe even the world, this is a no brainer stop off point for our tour. Blessed with beautifully pocketed limestone, amazing lines and a truly stunning location, this is a climbing nivannah that is not to be missed. Most routes are single pitch and the climbing is really varied, ranging from overhangs to steep technical walls. The routes are renowned for being tough and requiring plenty of stamina so they are mostly suitable for climbers with some outdoor climbing experience and good fitness. Leading experience is also relevant but not essential. Accommodation in Ceüse is in a campsite.

Fly into Torino, Italy. Fly back from Montpellier, France:  arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Gorge du Tarn - France

Situated in the south-west of France in the Pyrenees, this is a well-known spot for bouldering and sports climbing. The rock here is good and well-bolted with the Gorge du Tarn offering excellent steep overhangs that will test the stamina of even experienced climbers. There’s a good spread of grades so something for all ability levels to get stuck into. Some routes are up to 150m long. Again, it’s suitable for sport climbers with at least some outdoor climbing experience and being able to lead climb is relevant but not essential. Accommodation is also in a campsite.

Fly via Montpelliere, France: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Margalef – Spain

Considered a climbing paradise by some, Margalef in Spain is located near to Montsant and Siurana. With more than 500 routes of all types, quality and grades. There’s big overhangs, small pockets, tufas, boulder routes and plenty more to try out. It’s all found in nearly 50 crags spread over two valleys, with climbs of all grades including slabs, overhangs and vertical walls. It’s an incredibly beautiful place too. It’s suitable for sport climbers with at least some outdoor climbing experience. Leading is helpful but not essential. Accommodation is in a local campsite.

Fly via Barcelona/Llerida, Spain: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

Rodellar - Spain

The last stop on the tour is appropriately one of the world's best climbing areas. We’ll take on athletic, long stamina climbs in huge caves and there’s another chance to improve your tufa technique. This is mostly advanced sport climbing and suitable for climbers with outdoor climbing experience although there are plenty of easy routes to enjoy if you are less experienced. But by this time on the tour, you should be able to take on the challenge. Leading experience is not essential, but very welcome. Accommodation is in an excellent refuge within walking distance of the crags.

Fly via Barcelona, Spain: arrive Saturday and depart Saturday allowing 6 days climbing Sunday to Friday.

 

So, as you can see, this is a pretty comprehensive European tour stopping at many of Europe’s legendary climbing spots. Join the crew from the start and travel the whole way or pick your favorite destination and we’ll meet you there. However you do it, being part of our European tour you’ll become part of the Rockbusters family, live the life and become a better climber. What’s not to like?

rows.accommodation:
There is a basic shared accommodation organized by Rockbusters. Our main goal is to integrate you into the local climbing communities and for these purposes, we use local climbing hostels, cottages, campsites or places run by local climbers. Feel free to reach out to adjust these settings to your personal satisfaction. 

In Labske Udoli, Frankenjura, Finale Ligure, Zillertal, Margalef, and Rodellar we stay in hostels or campsites bungalows with bunk beds. In Gorges du Tarn we use permanent caravans which belongs to the campsite and in Ceuse we stay in campsites with hot showers, wi-fi, restaurant, ..., we provide tents so you will need to bring a sleeping bag and foam pad.
rows.food:
Upon arrival, we will take you to the store to shop for breakfast and lunch food for the week. Refrigerators are provided by the campsite, and we will return to the store once more during the week to replenish supplies.

Communal Spanish-inspired dinners prepared by a professional chef are offered every night for €15. They include an entree, salad, dessert, and wine. Dietary restrictions and allergies can be accommodated with advanced notice. 

We may also decide to plan a night out at a restaurant in one of the many nearby towns.

rows.title: PROJECT X – Climb & Work Camp
rows.bodyMore:
What You’ll Master: The Projecting Blueprint

 

This camp is about moving past "just climbing" and mastering the specific tactics needed to crush routes at—and beyond—your current limits. Over two weeks, we will break down and rebuild your approach to hard sport climbing:

 

  • Project Selection & Strategy: Learn how to analyze your specific strengths and weaknesses to pick the perfect line, mapping out a bulletproof campaign to send it.

  • Beta Breakdown & Sequencing: Stop wasting energy. We’ll show you how to section a route, unlock the optimal sequences for your height and style, and link complex moves efficiently.

  • The Technical Arsenal: Dial in advanced, three-dimensional movement—including drop-knees, aggressive heel/toe hooks, flagging, and the precise kneebar tactics essential for surviving Rodellar’s steep limestone.

  • Precision Footwork & Core Tension: Refine your center of gravity, learn to trust microscopic footholds on steep terrain, and keep your body tension high when the pump sets in.

  • The Mental Game & Headwork: Master the art of razor-sharp focus, learn how to handle the inevitable frustration of the redpoint process, and break through the mental barriers holding you back from the send.

  • Tactical Safety & Efficiency: Perfect the use of clip-sticks and pre-clipping tactics to manage risk and save energy on hard starts.

  • Dynamic Belaying & Fall Management: Refine advanced lead belaying, master the art of the soft catch, and learn how to safely take and manage high-consequence falls on steep terrain.

  • Performance Gear Optimization: Get expert insight into selecting, utilizing, and maintaining high-performance gear tailored for maximum safety and efficiency on hard redpoint burns.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.title: PROJECT X – Climb & Work Camp (Cloned)
rows.body:
Stop chasing random mileage and start hunting milestones. If you’ve been stuck at the gates of the 7s or staring down your first 8a, a standard week-long holiday isn't going to cut it. To break through, you need total immersion, focused coaching, and time to let the muscle memory sink in. Welcome to PROJECT X.

 

We’re taking over Rodellar—the steep, overhanging capital of Spanish sport climbing—for two weeks of relentless redpointing, remote work, and deep-dive coaching. With 10 to 12 full climbing days, you’ll have the luxury of time: time to blow a redpoint burn, dial the micro-beta, rest your skin, analyze the video, and ultimately clip the chains on the hardest route of your life.

 

By day, you’ll be firing or belaying under the massive limestone arches of the Mascún canyon. In the afternoons and rest days, you’ll plug into your laptop, crush your remote work, and recharge your body. It’s a dedicated ecosystem designed for one specific outcome: sending.

 

PROJECT X Highlights

 

  • The 10-12 Day Sweet Spot: One week lets you try a project; two weeks lets you own it. This extended timeline gives you the vital mental and physical buffer needed to work through the redpoint process without the pressure of a ticking clock.
  • Pro Beta & Video Analysis: We don’t just say "allez." Our elite coaches will climb your route with you, dissect your movement, optimize your resting positions on knee-bars and tufas, and film your burns to fix the micro-errors holding you back.
  • Tactical Redpoint Strategy: Learn the art of the project. We’ll teach you how to section hard routes efficiently, mentally break down complex cruxes, handle the pressure of the "send go," and manage your energy across a multi-week campaign.
  • Built for Remote Workers: Fast Wi-Fi, optimized schedules, and built-in recovery windows mean you can keep your career moving smoothly while your climbing level takes a massive leap forward.
  • Rodellar’s Steep Masterclass: The perfect arena for breaking barriers. Rodellar’s physical, athletic style rewards good tactics, solid headgames, and efficient resting—making it the ultimate training ground to unlock your first 7a, 7b, or 8a.

 

Physical & Technical Requirements

 

  • Minimum Entry Grade: This camp is for established sport climbers. You must have a baseline redpoint grade of at least 6c to get the most out of this terrain. Get in touch if you have doubts.
  • Who It’s For: Open to motivated men and women, as well as young guns aged 15 and up who are ready to push their limits.
  • Booking Options: Roll solo and feed off the crew's energy, or book as a couple or crew of friends to hunt down your projects together.
  • Physical Intensity: Medium to High. Expect steep, athletic climbing that will test your power-endurance, paired with structured recovery to keep you firing.
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

Our expert coaches will guide you to the best climbing routes while our reliable internet connection keeps you connected to your work. Maximize your climbing time and reach new heights in your career.

 

CLIMB & WORK is the perfect solution for climbers looking for a productive work-life balance. With our expert coaching and guidance, you can maximize your climbing time and enjoy the thrill of conquering new routes. Let us help you send those projects while staying connected with our reliable internet connection.

 

Don't settle for average climbs. With Rockbusters' guiding and coaching, you can push yourself further, tackle harder routes, and improve your skills. Our experts will show you the best routes, provide valuable beta, and coach you to conquer challenging climbs. Reach new heights and become a better climber with Rockbusters' CLIMB & WORK.

 

With our Starling internet connection, you can stay connected and productive while enjoying the great outdoors. Work remotely, find the best routes, and receive expert coaching to make the most of your climbing time.

 

CLIMB & WORK highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 or more days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  

 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience needed min. RP grade 6c
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.
rows.bodyMore:
What You’ll Master: The Projecting Blueprint

 

This camp is about moving past "just climbing" and mastering the specific tactics needed to crush routes at—and beyond—your current limits. Over two weeks, we will break down and rebuild your approach to hard sport climbing:

 

  • Project Selection & Strategy: Learn how to analyze your specific strengths and weaknesses to pick the perfect line, mapping out a bulletproof campaign to send it.

  • Beta Breakdown & Sequencing: Stop wasting energy. We’ll show you how to section a route, unlock the optimal sequences for your height and style, and link complex moves efficiently.

  • The Technical Arsenal: Dial in advanced, three-dimensional movement—including drop-knees, aggressive heel/toe hooks, flagging, and the precise kneebar tactics essential for surviving Rodellar’s steep limestone.

  • Precision Footwork & Core Tension: Refine your center of gravity, learn to trust microscopic footholds on steep terrain, and keep your body tension high when the pump sets in.

  • The Mental Game & Headwork: Master the art of razor-sharp focus, learn how to handle the inevitable frustration of the redpoint process, and break through the mental barriers holding you back from the send.

  • Tactical Safety & Efficiency: Perfect the use of clip-sticks and pre-clipping tactics to manage risk and save energy on hard starts.

  • Dynamic Belaying & Fall Management: Refine advanced lead belaying, master the art of the soft catch, and learn how to safely take and manage high-consequence falls on steep terrain.

  • Performance Gear Optimization: Get expert insight into selecting, utilizing, and maintaining high-performance gear tailored for maximum safety and efficiency on hard redpoint burns.

 

Minimum of 3 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value or issue a full refund.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (2 weeks) (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 7:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.

CONQUER THE VERTICAL PARADISE: DOLOMITES SPORT CLIMBING HOLIDAY

 

Scale the dramatic limestone peaks of the Italian Dolomites on our week-long Sport Climbing Holiday! Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 7:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 7:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.
rows.perex:
CONQUER THE VERTICAL PARADISE: DOLOMITES SPORT CLIMBING HOLIDAY

 

Scale the dramatic limestone peaks of the Italian Dolomites on our week-long Sport Climbing Holiday! Perfect your technique with expert coaching while conquering breathtaking routes in one of Europe's most spectacular mountain ranges. Whether you're looking to lead your first outdoor routes or push your climbing to new heights, our professional guides will help you climb better, harder, and more—all while enjoying the camaraderie of fellow rock enthusiasts in this UNESCO World Heritage setting.

 

Climb BETTER, HARDER & MORE
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: The Dolomite Dolce Vita (Cloned)
rows.body:
VERTICAL PARADISE IN THE ITALIAN ALPS

 

Duration: 6 Climbing Days
Location: Cortina d’Ampezzo & Val Gardena, Italian Dolomites
Difficulty: All Levels (Beginner to Advanced)
Group Size: Maximum 12 participants

 

 

TRIP/COURSE OVERVIEW

 

Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable week of sport climbing in the spectacular Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its dramatic limestone peaks and world-class climbing routes. Based in the charming towns of Cortina d’Ampezzo and Val Gardena, this climbing holiday offers access to hundreds of high-quality sport routes on some of the most beautiful rock formations in Europe.

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible diversity of climbing experiences, from single-pitch sport routes perfect for beginners to challenging multi-pitch adventures for the more experienced. With an average of 21 days of sunshine per month during summer, the Dolomites provide reliable climbing conditions in a breathtaking alpine setting.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE

 

  • Diverse Climbing Terrain: Access hundreds of sport routes on pristine limestone with grades ranging from 5 (5.9) to 8c (5.14b)

  • Stunning Locations: Climb against the backdrop of the Dolomites’ iconic pale mountains and lush green valleys

  • Professional Guidance: Receive instruction from IFMGA-certified guides who know the area intimately

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the unique blend of Italian and Tyrolean culture, cuisine, and hospitality

  • Flexible Itinerary: Climb in areas suited to your ability level with options for progression throughout the week

  • Small Groups: Enjoy personalized attention with a maximum 7:1 climber-to-guide ratio

 

 

DAILY SCHEDULE 

 

Day 1: Arrival & Welcome
Arrival in Cortina d’Ampezzo, welcome dinner, and trip briefing. Equipment check and discussion of individual goals and experience levels.

 

Days 2-3: Cortina Area Climbing
Climb at the best crags around Cortina, including Cinque Torri and other accessible sport climbing areas. Focus on technique development and acclimatization to the limestone.

 

Day 4: Rest & Transfer Day
Morning cultural excursion, followed by a scenic transfer to Val Gardena. Optional light climbing in the afternoon at a local crag.

 

Days 5-6: Val Gardena Area Climbing
Explore the excellent sport climbing areas around Sella Pass and Val Gardena, with options for single or multi-pitch routes depending on group preferences and abilities.

 

Day 7: Final Climbing & Departure
Morning climbing session followed by farewell lunch and departures.

 

 

CLIMBING AREAS

 

The Dolomites offer an incredible variety of sport climbing venues. Depending on weather conditions and group preferences, we may visit:

 

  • Cinque Torri: Iconic five towers with routes of all grades

  • Sella Towers: Classic limestone climbing with spectacular views

  • Piz Ciavazes: Home to both sport and traditional routes

  • Frea & Passo Gardena: Excellent single and multi-pitch sport climbs

  • Traumpfeiler: Accessible sport climbing close to our Val Gardena base

  • Falzarego Pass: High-altitude climbing with breathtaking panoramas

 

 

SUITABLE FOR

 

  • Beginners: Comfortable climbing at 5+ (5.9) indoors who want to transition to outdoor limestone

  • Intermediate: Leading 6a - 6c (5.10-5.11) who want to improve technique and climb classic routes

  • Advanced: Climbers at 7a+ (5.12+) looking to push their grade on quality limestone

  • All Ages: Participants typically range from 18-65 years old

 

 

 

 

BEST TIME TO CLIMB

 

The Dolomites offer excellent climbing conditions from June through September:

 

  • June: Fewer tourists, fresh conditions, occasional afternoon showers

  • July: Warmest temperatures, longest days, ideal for high-altitude routes

  • August: Peak tourist season, but reliable weather

  • September: Cooler temperatures, beautiful autumn colors, quieter crags

 

Our scheduled trips are timed to offer the best balance of good weather, optimal climbing conditions, and fewer crowds.

 

 

“The Dolomites offer some of the most spectacular sport climbing in Europe. The combination of quality limestone, breathtaking scenery, and Italian hospitality makes for an unforgettable climbing holiday.” – Previous Participant
rows.eventText:
Eat, sleep and breathe climbing on this killer sport climbing coaching course. Join the team for a week or two on one of Europe’s best crags and test your fingers to the limit. With top coaching and advice to boost technique and strength.

 

With our approach "LEARN by DOING" you get all the coaching when actually climbing the best routes at the crag and spending as much time on the rock as you possibly can. Here at Rockbusters, we think only practice makes you better so goal number one is MAXIMIZING YOUR CLIMBING TIME.

 

This course is an ideal choice for climbers looking to refresh their sport climbing safety skills, master the leading technique and improve their overall rock climbing performance.

 

 

Sport climbing course highlights

 

  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • Individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 7:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 5 to 15 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
  • Video analysis  
 

Physical & technical requirements

 

  • Previous outdoor sport climbing experience is highly recommended min. grade: indoor leading 6a / outdoor leading 5
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
rows.bodyMore:
WHY CLIMBERS ARE RAVING ABOUT OUR DOLOMITES EXPERIENCE

 

  • World-Class Routes For Every Level - From friendly 5s to challenging 8s, find your perfect climb

  • Expert Coaching That Transforms - Return home climbing two grades harder

  • Luxury Mountain Accommodation - Rest well, climb better

  • Small Groups, Massive Adventures - Maximum 6 climbers per guide

  • Local Knowledge, Hidden Gems - Access routes tourists never find

  • Italian Food & Culture - Because rest days should be legendary too

 

 

WHAT CLIMBERS ARE SAYING

“I came for the climbing, but found something more profound. The Dolomites changed my relationship with the rock forever.” - Alex K.

“Three days in, I sent my hardest route ever. By the end of the week, I’d broken through two plateaus I’d been stuck on for years.” - Sarah M.

 

 

MASTER THE ROCK WITH ROCKBUSTERS’ ELITE COACHING

 

At Rockbusters, we don’t just take you climbing—we transform how you climb. Our comprehensive coaching program covers everything you need to become a confident, skilled sport climber capable of tackling routes at or beyond your current limit.

 

TECHNICAL MASTERY

Learn to select, use, and care for the perfect gear for each climb while maintaining maximum safety. Our guides will teach you proper lead belaying with dynamic fall catching, efficient top-rope setup, and the crucial skill of cleaning anchors to retrieve all your gear—techniques that separate novices from experienced climbers.

 

SAFETY FIRST, ALWAYS

Develop a fundamental understanding of outdoor risk assessment that ensures you’ll return home safely after every adventure. Master essential climbing calls and clear communication techniques that could make all the difference on challenging routes.

 

MOVEMENT SCIENCE

Transform your climbing efficiency through advanced movement skills coaching. Perfect your balance by learning to properly support your center of gravity, develop impeccable footwork that builds true confidence in your feet, and master specialized techniques for conquering overhangs—including side-stepping, drop knees, flagging, heel hooking, and kneebars.

 

MENTAL GAME ELEVATION

Break through performance plateaus with our approach to redpoint and on-sight attempts. Each climber receives personalized coaching designed to shatter mental barriers that may be holding you back from reaching your true potential on the rock.

 

PRO TRICKS OF THE TRADE

Discover when and how to effectively use clipsticks and other professional techniques to pre-clip that crucial first quickdraw. These insider methods aren’t just for the pros—they’re essential tools for any serious climber looking to progress safely.

Our coaches don’t just teach—they analyze your unique climbing style, identify improvement opportunities, and provide tailored guidance that will elevate your climbing to levels you never thought possible. This isn’t about quick fixes; it’s about building a rock-solid foundation of skills that will serve you on every climb you attempt for years to come.

 

 

LIMITED SPACES, UNLIMITED MEMORIES

 

The mountains have stood for millennia. Your chance to experience them with us won’t.

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

rows.title: Sport Climbing Basics – Learn to Lead & Climb Outdoors (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

rows.title: Sport Climbing Basics – Learn to Lead & Climb Outdoors (Cloned)
rows.body:
Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.

rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.
rows.perex:
From Gym to Rock. From Top Rope to Lead. Climb with Confidence.

 

Transition from the gym to the rock and learn to lead climbing with confidence. In this hands-on outdoor climbing course, you’ll master the core skills of a lead climbing course — lead belay, safe clipping, cleaning anchors, and climbing independently on sport routes.

 

  • Location: Margalef, Spain
  • Level: Beginner - Intermediate
  • Type: Sport Climbing
  • Duration: 5/6 days of climbing days
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and coahing.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Local transport (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for total NOVICES, transitioning from GYM to ROCK. For total beginner to people looking for first rock experience, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and leading belay technique.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 4 - First lead climbs on easy terrain. Cleaning anchors safely.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Rapeling techniques. 

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Take your first rock climbing steps with us. In this intensive beginner's course, we will teach you all the basic sport climbing skills so that when you are finished, you will be able to pack your climbing gear and go to practice sport climbing anywhere on your own. You will be able to climb sport routes safely using both top-roping and leading techniques.

 

This course is an ideal choice for beginners as a transition from climbing gyms to rocks, and for a bit more experienced climbers aiming to learn how to lead climb.

 
 
 

Climbing course highlights

 
  • Maximum quality and quantity of climbing
  • 6 full days of intensive climbing with a professional guide and coach
  • An individual approach to your needs and level
  • Maximum 5:1 client/coach ratio
  • Group courses for 2 to 12 participants
  • One-on-one coaching
 
 
 

Physical & technical requirements

 
  • Minimum of 2-3 months of regular indoor climbing and basic safety top-rope skills
  • Suitable for women and men, children from 15 years old
  • The course can be purchased by individuals, couples, or groups of friends
  • Physical intensity: medium/high
 
 

Detailed technical specification of this climbing course

 
All necessary skills and knowledge to become an independent and self-confident climber on single pitch sport climbs, such as:
 
  • Choosing the right essential equipment for the best climbing experience while staying safe, and how to treat and store it
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks (so you can make it home safely every day)
  • Proper belaying, lead belaying techniques, catching falls dynamically
  • Setting up top-ropes 
  • Lead climbing techniques 
  • Cleaning the anchors - retrieve all your gear
  • How and when to use clipstick & other techniques to pre-clip the first quickdraw
  • Climbing calls and communication - get your message across 
  • Movement skills - climb more efficiently
  • Perfect balance - support your center of gravity
  • Proper footwork - trust in your feet
  • Special climbing techniques (overhang techniques as side-stepping, drop knee, flagging, heel hooking, kneebars, ...)
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts, so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Minimum of 2 participants. In other cases, we will offer different trips/courses of the same or higher value, or issue a full refund.
