rows.bodyMore:
Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.
rows.perex:
From Gym to Rock. From Top Rope to Lead. Climb with Confidence.

 

Transition from the gym to the rock and learn to lead climbing with confidence. In this hands-on outdoor climbing course, you’ll master the core skills of a lead climbing course — lead belay, safe clipping, cleaning anchors, and climbing independently on sport routes.

 

  • Location: Frankenjura, Germany
  • Level: Beginner - Intermediate
  • Type: Sport Climbing
  • Duration: 5/6 days of climbing days
rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and coahing.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

Local transport (FREE CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in climbing hostals, camps (FREE CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for total NOVICES, transitioning from GYM to ROCK. For total beginner to people looking for first rock experience, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from closest airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and leading belay technique.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 4 - First lead climbs on easy terrain. Cleaning anchors safely.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Rapeling techniques. 

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsite methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Unlocking New Heights: The Best Gains from Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course

 

Moving from indoor climbing walls to the raw challenge of outdoor rock faces is a significant milestone for any climber. The Rockbusters Beginner Learn to Lead Climbing Course offers this transition in a structured, supportive environment that delivers lasting benefits beyond just technical skills. If you’ve been contemplating taking your climbing journey to the next level, here’s what you stand to gain from this unique program.

 

Master Essential Technical Skills in Real-World Settings

 

The 6-day intensive format of the Rockbusters course provides ample time to develop and refine crucial lead climbing techniques. Unlike weekend workshops that barely scratch the surface, this program takes you through setting up top ropes, advanced belaying methods, including dynamic fall catching, and efficient route cleaning.

 

You’ll learn these skills on actual rock in premier climbing destinations like Frankenjura, Germany or Sella, Spain – places where the techniques you’re learning were practically born. This real-world application means you’re not just theoretically prepared but practically experienced in various climbing scenarios and rock types.

 

Build Genuine Confidence Through Expert Guidance

 

With a maximum 5:1 client-coach ratio, the personalized attention you receive transforms how quickly you progress. This isn’t about false confidence – it’s about earned trust in your abilities through proper training and practice.

 

As one participant, Miha Popovic, shared: “Even though I was there only for a couple of days, I came out with a set of new tips on how to become better, how to actually train, and more importantly, what to train on more.”

 

The course’s rigorous safety protocols – including mandatory partner checks, systematic safety procedures, and clear communication protocols – ensure you’re not just climbing boldly but climbing smartly. You’ll develop risk assessment skills that become second nature, allowing you to make sound decisions in various climbing situations.

 

Join a Community of Like-Minded Climbers

 

One often overlooked benefit is the relationships formed during these intensive six days. The small group size (2-12 participants) creates an intimate learning environment where you’ll connect with fellow climbers who share your passion and challenges.

 

These connections often extend beyond the course, giving you potential climbing partners for future adventures and a network to continue sharing knowledge. The shared experiences of learning, failing, trying again, and succeeding create bonds that enhance your climbing journey long after the course ends.

 

Experience Premium Climbing Destinations with Local Knowledge

 

Learning to lead climb at world-class destinations adds another dimension to your training. The course locations aren’t chosen randomly – they offer diverse climbing experiences that broaden your skills in ways a single location cannot.

 

The professional guides bring extensive local knowledge, introducing you to routes perfectly suited to your developing abilities. This exposure to different rock types, climbing styles, and environments accelerates your learning curve and versatility as a climber.

 

Take the Next Step in Your Climbing Journey

 

The Rockbusters Beginner Lead Climbing Course offers more than just technical instruction – it provides a transformative experience that elevates your entire approach to climbing. From technical proficiency to safety awareness, from community connections to exposure to world-class climbing locations, the benefits extend far beyond the six-day program.

 

If you’re ready to move beyond the plastic holds of indoor gyms and test yourself against the natural challenges of rock, this course offers the perfect balance of challenge, support, and expert guidance to help you make that transition safely and confidently.

 

Whether you choose the summer sessions in Frankenjura or the fall opportunities in Sella, you’re not just signing up for a course – you’re investing in skills that will enhance your climbing experiences for years to come.

rows.body:
Imagine scaling breathtaking limestone cliffs with nothing but crystal-clear Mediterranean waters below to catch your fall. Rockbusters' Deep Water Solo Mallorca course invites you to experience the purest form of climbing freedom in what locals call "psicobloc" – psycho-bouldering at its finest. In the very paradise made famous by climbing legend Chris Sharma, you'll conquer mental barriers, perfect your technique, and access secret spots others only dream of climbing.

 

Whether you're new to DWS or looking to push your limits, our expert coaches will guide you through Mallorca's stunning coastline – the undisputed world capital of deep water soloing. Feel the unique rush of climbing without ropes as warm turquoise waters replace crash pads, and discover why climbers worldwide make their pilgrimage to these iconic cliffs. This isn't just a climbing course; it's an unforgettable adventure that combines skill development, mental mastery, and the raw beauty of Mallorca's hidden gems.

 

Why Deep Water Solo with Rockbusters?

 

  • World's Best Venue: Experience the thrill of climbing in Mallorca, the undisputed 100% Deep Water Solo paradise!
  • Exclusive Access: Climb routes that others only dream of – our secret spots are waiting for you!
  • Level Up Your Skills: Boost your climbing performance and conquer your mental game with our expert coaching.
  • Maximize Your Time: We know all the best routes, so you spend more time climbing and less time searching.
  • Safety First: Learn all the ins and outs of Deep Water Solo safety from the pros.
  • Vibe Check: Immerse yourself in the coolest climbing atmosphere you've ever experienced!

 

What to Expect on Your Deep Water Solo Adventure

 

  • Expert Guidance: Our pro coaches will help you push your limits and climb harder than ever before.
  • Tailored Experience: Whether you're a DWS newbie or a seasoned pro, we've got routes that'll challenge and excite you.
  • Mental Mastery: Develop the confidence to tackle those high, exposed routes with our mental game coaching.
  • Technique Refinement: Learn the unique skills required for Deep Water Solo success.
  • Epic Locations: Discover hidden gems and iconic spots around Mallorca's stunning coastline.

 

 

Who Is This Course For?

 

  • The Experience: You are a confident outdoor climber with a lead grade of 6a/6b or higher
  • The Requirement: You must be a strong and confident swimmer, comfortable in open water
  • The Vibe: You want to experience climbing in its most aesthetic form—free from gear and high above the sea
 

"Rockbusters' Deep Water Solo course was a game-changer! I've never felt so confident on the rock. The coaches are incredible, and the locations... just wow!" - Alex, DWS Convert

 

Are You Ready to Redefine Your Climbing Limits? Join Rockbusters for an unforgettable Deep Water Solo adventure in Mallorca. Climb better, harder, and more while experiencing the pure freedom of DWS in the world's best venue. Don't let this opportunity slip through your fingers! Spaces are limited, and the ocean is calling.

rows.bodyMore:
Detailed technical specifications of this climbing course

 
 
All necessary skills and knowledge to be able to do DWS and to attack routes on or beyond your limit such as:
 
  • What equipment do you need and how to choose it so you have the best climbing experience while staying safe
  • Safety assessment for DWS (landing, escape, behavior, ...)
  • Climbing calls and communication so that you can get your message across to climbing buddies
  • Movement skills to help you climb more efficiently
  • Basic understanding of outdoor risks so you can make it home safely every day
  • Work on balance so that you climb in a more efficient way
  • Time on slab and vertical ground to improve footwork for better climbing
  • Overhang work to build strength and confidence so you can take on tougher climbing challenges
  • Redpoint and on-sight attempts so you can tackle new climbs more easily
  • Personalized coaching to break through mental barriers

 

Among climbers, Mallorca is known as a mecca for Deep Water Solo climbing. It is undoubtedly the top destination in the world to enjoy this pure style of climbing, and every October Rockbusters host this trip to share their psych for DWS. The best conditions are in October and early November as the sun stays low in the sky and dries the moisture out of the coastal caves. The temperature isn’t too hot or cold at this time, and the sea is still warm from the hot summer months. In recent years loads of new crags have been bolted on the island, and on overcast or cooler days we will spend our time exploring these lesser-known sport-climbing areas, making for a varied and exciting tour.

 

Climbing isn’t the only thing that makes people love this trip; Mallorca also offers breathtaking scenery. You’ll spend your week hanging from cliffs rising from the turquoise-blue water of the Mediterranean, hiking through secluded beaches and coves, relaxing between climbs amongst the pine trees, and sharing well-earned beers on the beach at local chiringuitos.

 

Deep Water Soloing (DWS) is known in Spanish as psicobloc, which directly translates to “psycho-bouldering.” It involves climbing cliffs without a rope, but the warm, blue waters of the Mediterranean are ready to catch your fall.

 

Majorca, the birthplace of hard DWS, was made famous as a world-class climbing destination by Chris Sharma. In 2007, he ascended the iconic Es Pontas arch, putting up a “king line” potentially as hard as 9a+/b. Since then, climbers from all over the globe have made their pilgrimage to the Majorcan cliffs to test their endurance and mettle!

 

The limestone cliffs offer test pieces for every level, starting with easier grades (5+) and low heights.

 

Deep-water soloing can be a little intimidating at first, but with the help and instruction of our experienced guides, you will quickly gain confidence and get to fully enjoy this beautiful, pure style of climbing. The Majorca DWS trip is all about new experiences, adventure, and simply having fun in the great outdoors, but with Rockbusters coaching you might also surprise yourself with some hard sends!

 

Majorca also offers many world-class sport climbing crags which have been bolted in recent years. They are worth visiting not only when the seas are rough! We will show you the best, secret locations, often not featured in any guidebooks.

 

With innumerable quality lines available on the coast and throughout the island, you will experience a great climbing adventure while constantly improving your technique and performance. You will immerse yourself in the local climbing culture and enjoy the famous, Rockbusters community spirit. Climbing with us is like climbing with friends - very resourceful, experienced friends, who have everything planned and focus on your climbing throughout the trip! 

 

The trip is suitable for anyone with basic climbing skills, such as belaying and tying on. Our team can accommodate every level, from beginners to pros. One-to-one coaching sessions and a friendly, relaxed atmosphere guarantee an unforgettable, amazing trip. If you’re a confident swimmer hungry for new experiences, this trip is perfect for you.

rows.whatToBring:
To prepare for Deep Blue, you need gear for the salt and sea, as well as a backup kit for sport climbing in case the weather turns.

 

1. The Deep Blue Kit (DWS)

  • 2+ Pairs of Climbing Shoes: It takes some time to dry the rubber. Bring an older backup pair.
  • Liquid Chalk: Use as a base layer so you don't need a chalk bag over the water.
  • 20L–30L Dry Bag: To keep your towel and snacks dry during boat approaches.
  • Snorkeling Goggles: Vital for checking water depth and hazards before you jump.

 

2. Sport Climbing Backup (Rainy Days)

In case the conditions are not favorable for DWS, we head to sport crags. Bring your personal "redpoint" gear:

  • Harness & Helmet: Ensure your harness has adjustable leg loops for comfort.
  • Chalk Bag: For longer pitches where liquid chalk isn't enough.
  • Belay Device: An assisted-braking device (like a Grigri) is best for long sessions.

 

Other recommended gear: a down jacket, a hat, a rain jacket, a pair of comfortable approach shoes, 2 bathing suits or quick-drying clothing, a towel, a headlamp, and a backpack big enough for carrying lunch and gear to the crag.

Have you ever dreamed of scaling the sun-drenched limestone walls of Spain, testing your skills on the technical routes of Germany’s Frankenjura, or experiencing the thrill of deep water soloing in Mallorca? For climbers looking to take their skills to new heights while exploring Europe’s most stunning crags, Rockbusters offers an unmatched opportunity to transform both your climbing ability and your life perspective.

 

Expert Coaching That Propels Your Progress

 

At the heart of Rockbusters’ success is their distinctive “Learn by Doing” approach. Unlike programs that overwhelm you with theory before letting you touch rock, Rockbusters gets you climbing immediately while providing real-time guidance from world-class coaches. Their team includes elite climbers like Patxi Usobiaga, whose expertise is available during specialized advanced courses in locations like Rodellar, Spain.


The coaching methodology begins with a personalized assessment of your current abilities, identifying both strengths to leverage and weaknesses to address. This individualized attention ensures that whether you’re a beginner learning to lead in Frankenjura or an advanced climber pushing grades in Spain, you receive precisely the guidance needed for your next breakthrough.


Benjamin M’s experience exemplifies the effectiveness of this approach: “The best 3 climbing weeks ever! I progressed from 6A to 7A… received a lot of advice and encouragement that helped me get mentally more endurant.” This remarkable grade progression demonstrates how Rockbusters’ coaching accelerates skill development far beyond what most climbers achieve on their own.

 

Europe’s Premier Climbing Destinations at Your Fingertips

 

One of Rockbusters’ most compelling advantages is their carefully curated selection of European climbing destinations. Their 2025 calendar features courses in locations chosen not just for their world-class routes but for their optimal learning environments.
The flagship Europe Rock Trip 2025 represents the ultimate climbing journey, spanning from August to October and covering five countries:

rows.itineraryText:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN PRICE

Guiding and Coaching.

All safety equipment including quick draws, ropes, harness , helmet - but feel free to bring your own.

------

Airport pick up and drop off is organize with shared rental cars (FREE of CHARGE).

Transport between crags (FREE of CHARGE).

Shared accommodation in mountain cottage (FREE of CHARGE).

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE

Flights, travel, climbing insurance and food are not included. You will also need to BRING YOUR OWN CLIMBING SHOES

ANY EXTRAS

Evening group meals are provided on request at a cost of 15€ each. There will normally be 2 dishes on offer and you can go for both. We also include wine .. in reasonable quantities !

WHAT YOU NEED

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.

Climbing shoes, harness, helmet, belay device, 60cm sling with screw gate carabiner, sleeping bag, foam pad, good approach shoes, back pack, warm light jacket, headlamp.

DIFICULITY

Siutable for people with some CLIMBING EXPRIENCE (belay, lead belay, top rope, lead, ...). From sporty beginners through to experts leading at F8, our experienced team will plan the days so that everyone climbs as much they can and gets all the coaching they need.

EXAMPLE ITINERARY

Day 1 - Pick up from airport at times to suit the group as a whole. Common dinner on the first night and a relaxed discussion about the week ahead, people's abilities and ambitions for the week.

Day 2 - Introduction to climbing. Getting a taste for the rock and some warm-up routes. Reviewing safe belay, top-roping and a refresher on leading for those with goals.

Day 3 - More climbing, top-roping on some trickier routes for the beginners. Gaining confidence and improving lead climbing technique for intermediates and advanced.

Day 4 - First lead climbs for the beginner group on easy terrain. Advanced belaying and controlling falls dynamically.

Day 5 - Time to add some technical coaching. Finding and working a red-point project for the advanced.

Day 6 - Discussion and practice on red-pointing, flash, and onsight methods. Making sure everyone is having fun and progressing their technique on the rock.

Day 7 - Consolidate our weeks work. Finish those projects we started and lock in the skills we learned. It's time for the farewell dinner and party for those with some energy. 

Day 8 - Everyone gets back to the bus station or airport safe and sound and we say goodbye - until next time.

Note: Everyone needs a rest day but we don't fix these into the itinerary. Listen to your body and take break when you need it.
